chapters.title: Chapter 401 - Surprise
paragraphs: In the morning, Osborne went to the medicinal ingredients warehouse to inspect as usual.
He noticed a big truck parked at the entrance of the warehouse.
Several members of the Scavenger Army were helping to move the big boxes from the truck.
The big boxes were piled at the entrance of the warehouse, taking up a lot of space.
Osborne frowned and walked up, asking, “What’s with the truck? Where did these goods come from? Why are they piled in this warehouse? ”
“It’s Fang Heng. He said that part of the supplementary medicinal ingredients needed to make the potion has been used up, so he got a batch of them himself. ”
Osborne was stunned when he heard that.
“Used up? So fast? How? Did he eat the medicinal ingredients for his meal? ” Osborne was puzzled as he thought.
Just then, he saw Roche coming over with a group of Scavenger Army NPCs not far away.
“Roche? ”
“Osborne, is Fang Heng in your warehouse? ” Roche looked into the warehouse and said, “I’m looking for him. He said he would give me a surprise today. ”
“Yeah, I’m looking for him too. ” Osborne nodded.
While the two conversed, a guard hurried over from the side. He whispered into Osborne’s ear and told him in detail about Fang Heng summoning the zombie team in the warehouse last night.
“Zombie Recruitment? Fang Heng’s special ability? The guards didn’t guard the warehouse last night? ” Osborne frowned as questions filled his mind. “Fang Heng’s really a worrisome fellow! ”
Just then, another truck full of medicinal ingredients drove over from a distance and stopped outside the warehouse.
“Hi, Roche, Osborne. ” Fang Heng jumped down from the truck and waved at the two of them.
Osborne asked in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, what’s with these medicinal ingredients? I heard that you used up the medicinal ingredients in the warehouse? ”

“Indeed, there weren’t enough medicinal ingredients. In the end, we still lacked a type of supplementary medicinal ingredient, so we had no choice but to stop the potion production. ” Fang Heng’s tone carried some regret.
Osborne was even more puzzled. He felt that Fang Heng wasn’t telling the truth. “These medicinal ingredients were all obtained by you alone? ”
“Of course. It took me quite a bit of effort. ”

“Hmph! ” Roche snorted heavily, interrupting the conversation. His patience had already been worn to the limit. “You two, let’s talk about these details later. Fang Heng, where’s the surprise you promised me? ”
“It’s ready. Please follow me, Roche, ” Fang Heng said as he took the lead and walked toward the warehouse at the back.
Osborne and Roche followed him into the warehouse.
The former was stunned when he saw the scene in the warehouse.
In the warehouse, a few potioneers who were originally in charge of making potions looked exhausted as they busily sorted the ingredients for the making the warlord potion.
Boxes of finished products of the warlord potion were packed at the edge of the warehouse.

“What’s going on? It’s only been one night. When did so many finished products of the warlord potion become available? Is it really as Fang Heng said? Have all the medicinal ingredients in the warehouse been used up and made into potions? ” Osborne inwardly thought in shock.
Roche was also shocked, and joy flashed across his face. “Fang Heng, you said that these potions are all warlord potions? ”
“They’re the real deal. ”
Osborne couldn’t believe what he was seeing. He suddenly turned around and looked at Fang Heng. “You made them alone? ”
Fang Heng had a smile on his face, and he pointed at the potioneers who were living a life worse than death.
“It’s not just me. They helped me a lot. ”
Osborne turned his head to look at the potioneers.
The potioneer NPCs each revealed a smile that was uglier than a crying face.
“How did he do it? It’s impossible to complete so many potions in one night even with the help of other people! ” mused Osborne.

He was very clear about the standards of the potioneers present. It was already extraordinary for them to complete 50 bottles in a day. 1000 bottles of potions were a tall order for them even if he threatened their lives.
“Could there be a problem with the potions? ! ” Osborne realized the possibility, and his heart skipped a beat.
Face darkened, he walked to a filled box at the side and picked up a bottle of potion to examine.
As he opened the bottle cap, a familiar smell entered his nose.
Osborne took a small sip.

“Huh? There’s no problem with the potion. It’s indeed an E-grade warlord potion! The quality’s not considered high, but it’s definitely decent! Still... How can this be? How could he produce so many decent products in one night? ”
Osborne picked up another bottle and yet another bottle, both of which were decent products.
He took a few steps to the side, opened another box, and took out a bottle.
It was also a decent product!
The situation before Osborne was beyond his understanding.
Reason told him that there was definitely a problem with the products that had been produced in such large quantities overnight. However, he couldn’t figure out the problem.
Osborne’s expression was a little scary.
Roche looked at Osborne checking the boxes one by one and could not help but walk to Osborne’s side. “After checking for so long, how is it? Are the potions considered decent enough? ”
Osborne stopped his movement and remained silent. He turned around to look at Fang Heng.

“Damn it! Speak! ” Upon seeing that Osborne was dawdling and not speaking, Roche felt anger rise in his heart. He could not hold it in any longer. Without saying anything, he casually picked up a bottle of warlord potion from the box and poured it into his mouth.
As the potion flowed into his mouth, a familiar coolness flowed through his body. It was as refreshing as drinking a big mouthful of bubbly ice cola on a hot day!
Bang!
Roche crushed the bottle in his hand by exerting a little strength. “Hahaha! It’s really a warlord potion! ”
He turned back to look at Fang Heng, his eyes burning. “Good, Fang Heng! You didn’t disappoint me! Your contribution to this mission will not be forgotten! ”
“Thank you for your trust. ” Fang Heng smiled and nodded to Roche.
Osborne recounted the boxes piled up in the warehouse with an incredulous expression.
There were thousands of bottles of warlord potions in the warehouse!
“How did he make this many overnight? It’s theoretically impossible! ” Osborne wondered.
He then looked at Fang Heng, “Fang Heng, how did you do it? ”

“In the apocalyptic world, people like us have to have some skills to survive, don’t we? ” Fang Heng said and gestured to the potioneers in the room with his eyes. “I will continue to make more warlord potions. I’ll be temporarily commanding them. They can help me. ”
“Sure, ” Osborne immediately agreed to Fang Heng’s request. His initial shock and disbelief turned into ecstasy.
No matter how Fang Heng did it, he was definitely a genius in potion making!

With such efficiency in producing potions, the Scavenger Army would be able to supply warlord potions to the few areas near Edge Creek Town. The biggest problem that Scavenger Army had been facing could then be considered solved!
More importantly, Fang Heng actually had a way to procure a large amount of medicinal ingredients!

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - Quickly Farming Contribution Points
paragraphs: It meant that they could still concoct more warlord potions.
From a certain point of view, the amount of warlord potions determined the overall combat strength of the Scavenger Army.
Compared to Fang Heng’s powerful potion making skill, nothing else was important!
No matter what secrets Fang Heng had, as long as he could make the warlord potion, everything would be done to satisfy him!
Roche did not understand what Fang Heng and Osborne were talking about.
He only knew that their entire team could have a large amount of warlord potions now! They no longer had to search high and low for the potions or drink a bottle only when they had no choice.
They could drink all they want!

Roche licked his lips and picked up another bottle of warlord potion. He lifted the bottle cap and poured the bottle’s contents into his mouth, soon feeling an endless amount of strength in his body. He couldn’t wait to test his strength on a few of those survivors and vent his anger.

“With so many of the potions, wouldn’t it be easy to deal with those stubborn people from the shelter in Edge Creek Town? I’ve had to suffer consecutive defeats the past two days. I’m getting back at them today! ” A fierce light flashed in Roche’s eyes again as he thought.
“Brothers, each of you bring twenty bottles. It’s time to teach those trashes a lesson! ” Roche raised his right hand high. “Follow me! Crush them together! ”
“Rahh! ”
When the members of the Scavenger Army heard that there were sufficient warlord potions to be distributed, they all became excited and roared like wild beasts along with Roche.
For a time, the morale of the Scavenger Army was sky-high!
Fang Heng stood on the side and looked at the excited survivors. A row of game hints rapidly refreshed before him.
“Hint: you have provided 2812 warlord potions to Osborne. ”
“Hint: totaling the warlord potions’ grade points, the Scavenger Army’s points are 3,556,500. Your level in the Scavenger Army has increased to level 14 (Tier 2 Warzone Commander) . ”
“Hint: your favorability rating with Roche has greatly increased. ”
“Hint: your favorability rating with Osborne has greatly increased. ”

“Hint: Roche has distributed the warlord potions to the elite members of the Scavenger Army. The morale of the army’s players has greatly increased. Player has received the special enhancement skill ‘High Fighting Spirit’ (additional increase in combat strength and final damage) . ”
He had directly risen by 8 levels!
Fang Heng licked his lips.
Roche seemed to be a Tier 3 Warzone Commander. Fang Heng was only one level away from being on par with him.
Though quite satisfying to rise so quickly, it was not enough. There was a long way to go before he could reach the top level.
The Federation still had a large batch of medicinal ingredients to be sent over. Fang Heng estimated that he would more or less reach his goal after using all the ingredients to make the potions.
Heart burning with passion, he prepared to continue the hardcore potion-making.

Roche was full of praise as he patted Fang Heng’s shoulder. “Fang Heng, you’ve done very well! I’ll be bringing some people to clean up the remaining few areas of Edge Creek Town. Do you want to continue staying here to produce potions for Osborne, or do you want to come with me and chop off those bastards? ”

“I think I’d better stay. There are still many medicinal ingredients that will be sent over one after another. A few of them have very sensitive time-limited effects. If I delay using them for too long, it’ll be a waste. ”
“That works. ” Roche nodded and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder. “When we come back, we’ll celebrate together. ”

“Also, I heard some rumors that those bastards have gathered a lot of people and want to completely destroy the Scavenger Army. I suggest we start from this place. ” Fang Heng took out a map and pointed out a players’ shelter.
“Heh, they want to destroy us? Fine! Let’s start with them! ”
To Roche, no matter which shelter’s players he chose to kill first, it was the same!
“Brothers! Get ready immediately! We’ll set off in an hour! ”
“Roar! ! ! ”
The Scavenger Army soldiers roared, again and again, unrestrainedly venting their anger.
When Roche left with the group full of fighting spirit, Osborne turned back to look at Fang Heng.

“Fang Heng, I need you to focus on making the warlord potion. You have full authority over everyone here. If you encounter any problems, come to me. I will do my best to help you solve them. In addition, I will urgently gather a new batch of medicinal ingredients. Can you handle things here by yourself? ”
“Of course. ”
Fang Heng thought to himself, “Isn’t it just making potions? That’s easy. The more, the better! ”

The previous night, the first wave of proliferators appeared, and the efficiency of making potions doubled. In the present day’s night, the second and third waves of proliferators would spawn. Only then would the efficiency reach its peak.
Fang Heng copied Osborne’s tone from yesterday and added, “As many medicinal ingredients as you have. ”
“Hahaha! Great! ” Osborne was unusually excited. “When this matter is over, I will personally report your achievements to Lord Cook Barn. ”
Cheng Ya, who was waiting in the truck to unload the goods, heard the noise coming from the warehouse.
What was going on?
Cheng Ya poked her head out of the window and looked at the warehouse outside.
Coincidentally, she saw Roche leading a group of high-spirited members of the Scavenger Army out of the warehouse.
From the looks of it, there was going to be another large-scale operation. Almost the entire team was mobilized.
“What happened in the warehouse? ” wondered Cheng Ya.
After following Fang Heng to the warehouse, the entire Scavenger Army became even more excited.
Cheng Ya had a very bad feeling in her heart.
She frowned slightly and lowered her head to look at the time.
According to the time, the player guilds in District 7 were almost ready to set off.
It was very likely that they would meet them halfway!
“No! I have to report this matter in advance, ” thought Cheng Ya.
“Hey! ”
“Ah? Fang Heng? ”
Fang Heng who appeared at the car window gave Cheng Ya a fright.
“Here, take these. ”
Fang Heng threw a few cans of coffee into the car through the car window.

“Thanks for your hard work. ” Fang Heng waved at Cheng Ya. “There are still a lot of medicinal ingredients left with the Dark Knights. We have limited manpower, so I’m counting on you. I promise to get you the divine potion that I promised you. ”
“Okay, good. ”
After getting a huge number of contribution points, Fang Heng was in a good mood. He hummed a tune and walked straight to the central square of the town.

Cheng Ya picked up one of the cans of coffee and took a sip. She sent a message to the Federation’s contact person through the survival radio, reminding him to pay attention to the unusual movements of the Scavenger Army. Then, she started the truck and continued helping to transport the goods.
In the town’s central square, Fang Heng walked to Yatu.
“Fang Heng, you didn’t lie to me. Your talent in potion making amazes even me. You are indeed a genius. ”
“Ha, I’m not a genius. I’m just lucky. ”
Having earned a large number of contribution points, Fang Heng was ready to see what item Yatu had that was worth exchanging for.
After being promoted to a Warzone Commander, Fang Heng could see a considerable increase in the variety of exchangeable items on Yatu’s exchange column.
Opening the exchange column, Fang Heng was immediately drawn to the purplish-red potion in the first row.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - Ambush
paragraphs: “Item: high-tier divine potion. ”
Description: A special potion made by the Scavenger Army. It is extremely difficult to make and is extremely rare. Only high-tier commanders in the Scavenger Army can exchange for it.

Warning (triggered by low-level game difficulty) : this potion has been determined to be a high-risk potion. After taking it, there is a high probability the player will receive damage. Before using it, the player needs to have taken the middle-tier divine potion and meet a certain physique requirement. Forcefully consuming it may cause irreversible and unknown consequences.

“So... The worm inside the high-tier potion is stronger than the worm inside the low-tier potion? Or is there a special ingredient in this high-tier potion that can allow the worm inside the body to evolve to a higher level? ” Fang Heng pondered and conveniently bought three bottles each of high-tier, middle-tier, and low-tier potions, preparing to bring them back to Qiu Yaokang’s laboratory for research.
High-tier potions were extremely expensive. One bottle alone cost 700,000 contribution points.
Fortunately, he had earned more than three million contribution points through potion making, which was enough to exchange for them.
After purchasing them, Fang Heng continued to browse through the remaining materials.
Besides high-tier potions, there were also many high-tier construction materials in the exchange column.
“Eh? A cart? ” Fang Heng’s gaze focused on the body of the cart on the exchange column.
As the lead organizer of the collective operation, Leftway Gaming Guild had invested a large amount of manpower and resources in the operation.
Most of the guild leaders of the various guilds had elected Tian town as the temporary commander.

The guild leader of the Dragon Country Guild was extremely familiar with the region of Edge Creek Town. The guild leader, Niu Xia, had fought with the Scavenger Army of Edge Creek Town a few times and was very experienced. He had been elected as one of the deputy commanders of the operation.

Niu Xia just received the news that Fang Heng transferred to District 7 not long ago. He immediately thought of the incident where he had been attacked by the Scavenger Army and could neither sleep nor eat well. Even in his dreams, he wanted to find an opportunity to get rid of Fang Heng.
Now, the opportunity had come!
He had to get rid of Fang Heng once and for all!
Half an hour ago, after the players from the various large-sized gaming unions had gathered, they set off for Edge Creek Town.

Halfway there, Tao Yunlei, a captain of Leftway Gaming Guild, who was in charge of scouting ahead, hurriedly walked up and reported, “Boss Tian! The front scouting team has encountered the Scavenger Army! With roughly five to six hundred people, they are about two kilometers away from us and are heading toward our position. ”
Tian Zhen was shocked when he heard that.
“Five to six hundred people? ! The entire Scavenger Army is being mobilized? ”
Niu Xia nodded and said, “Excluding the non-combatants, the actual number of combatants in the Scavenger Army of Edge Creek Town is less than six hundred. It should be all of them. ”
Tian Zhen and the other guild leaders exchanged glances. They could see the excitement in each other’s eyes.
What a good opportunity!

If they attacked Edge Creek Town directly, the Scavenger Army would have the geographical advantage, which would affect their offensive strength. Now, the other side actually took the initiative to leave Edge Creek Town.
Even the heavens were on their side! It would be a perfect ambush!
Tian Zhen could feel the eagerness in the eyes of the commanders of the other guilds.

Taking a deep breath, Niu Xia took the opportunity to suggest, “Edge Creek Town’s Scavenger Army isn’t very strong. Our strength is enough to crush them. Since we’re meeting them outside their home ground this time, we won’t lose. If we launch an attack now, we can minimize the casualties. ”
Tian Zhen nodded and looked at the players. “Where’s Fang Heng? Is he inside? ”
Tao Yunlei replied, “For the time being, our members haven’t seen Fang Heng, so we can’t confirm that. ”
“Okay. Let’s stop where we are and prepare to ambush! Set up a defensive line and completely destroy the Scavenger Army! ”
After making the battle decision, the guild leaders immediately led their subordinate players to prepare for battle in batches and set up a defensive line.
For some reason, Tian Zhen felt a little uneasy.
Could it be that he had seen too much news about Fang Heng recently?
“Niu Xia, based on your understanding of the Scavenger Army, what are our chances of winning? ”

Niu Xia was extremely confident about the upcoming battle. “Even if we forcefully attack Edge Creek Town, we still have a 100% chance of winning. If we’re fighting outside of Edge Creek Town, it’s even more impossible for us to lose! ”
“All right! ”
Just a moment later, the roaring sound of motorcycles came from the front.
“Scavenger Army! ” Tian Zhen’s gaze was fixed on the Scavenger Army that was gradually approaching.
When the other party stepped into the shooting range, Tian Zhen suddenly waved his hand forward. “Begin! Shoot! ! ! ”
Bang, bang, bang! ! ! !
A series of gunshots sounded.
The Scavenger Army, suddenly attacked, immediately fell into chaos.

“F*ck! You still dare to personally offer your lives up to us? ! ” Having encountered a sudden attack halfway, Roche was so angry that he laughed. He raised a huge alloy explosion-proof shield in front of him and poured a bottle of potion into his mouth. “Charge! Crush them! ”
The Scavenger Army NPCs were a little confused at first. However, they soon took out bulletproof shields, hid behind them, and drank bottles of warlord potions.
In an instant, the army soldiers felt as if they had endless strength!
After Roche swallowed a bottle of potion, his body grew by a few times. He held the modified explosion-proof shield in one hand in front of him and rushed toward the enemy’s front line players.
Most of the bullets were blocked by the explosion-proof shield. Occasionally, the bullets passed by Roche’s body, but most of them only grazed his skin slightly.
“How can he be so strong? ”
Tian Zhen stared at the battlefield, his eyes full of fear.
Unlike those in his shelter area, the strength of the Scavenger Army soldiers from Edge Creek Town was shocking and on a completely different level!
The damage caused by ordinary bullets to them was greatly reduced!
Tao Yunlei observed the situation on the field and frowned. Raising his Barrett, he activated his skill “Enhanced Shot. ”
Bang!
He pulled the trigger.
The bullet grazed the arm of a member of the Scavenger Army, and his entire right arm was blown up.
Blood and flesh splattered!

An ordinary person would have fainted from the pain! However, the soldier did not seem to feel any pain. Eyes flashing with madness, he used his left hand to drink a bottle of potion and rushed over with a shield in one hand.
“What’s going on? ” Tao Yunlei was shocked.
Having fought with the Scavenger Army for so long, it was the first time he encountered such a situation.
“A normal low-level member of the Scavenger Army has become so strong? This huge improvement’s terrifying! ” he thought.
Meanwhile, seeing Roche rushing over with the Scavenger Army, Tian Zhen forced himself to remain calm.
“Ambush team, forward! ! ”
As soon as he said that, the players lying in ambush in the woods on both sides of the path revealed themselves and shot at the Scavenger Army soldiers.
The flank was suddenly attacked, and more than ten Scavenger Army members instantly fell, falling into chaos again.
However, in less than half a minute, the situation was reversed.
“Hahaha! Is that all you got? ! ”
Despite having been ambushed, Roche did not have any fear. His eyes flashed with bloodthirsty madness.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - Self-Sacrifice
paragraphs: Roche laughed out loud. He raised his modified shotgun with one hand and fired back at the players in the forest.
The Scavenger Army soldiers were the same as Roche. The pain of being hit by bullets made them even crazier and more fearless. One by one, they raised their guns and fired back.

The two teams that participated in the ambush initially wanted to cooperate with each other to launch an ambush. They did not expect the Scavenger Army to be so tough. Since they lacked suitable cover, they immediately retreated one after another!
In the blink of an eye, the death rate of those that participated in the ambush reached a high point.

The guild leader of the Dragon Country Guild, Niu Xia, kept lying down with cold sweat running down his face. He thought, “What’s going on? ! Something isn’t right! When did the Scavenger Army become so strong? ! It wasn’t like this yesterday! Why did the strength of the Scavenger Army increase so much in just one day? The strength they’re displaying is completely different from yesterday when they attacked the shelter! All the guilds participating in this operation sent high-level players, yet we can’t withstand the Scavenger Army’s attacks! ”

“What the f*ck! What kind of information did you give us? ! ” The deputy commander of Hidden Tiger Gaming Company, Qian Yu, who participated in the ambush, fled back with the defeated soldiers. Their company suffered the most losses! More than half of their men had died in a head-on clash with the Scavenger Army.

Qian Yu’s heart was aching as if it were bleeding. He grabbed Niu Xia’s collar with bloodshot eyes, wishing he could swallow the latter whole. “Didn’t you say that we could completely crush them with our strength? How did this happen? ! Huh? ! Speak! ”
“I... ” Niu Xia was momentarily at a loss for words. “I don’t know what happened either. They weren’t this strong yesterday. ”
“Stop it! Now is not the time to argue. ” Tian Zhen’s face was gloomy.

After the Scavenger Army finished off the ambush players, they continued to approach their enemy’s defensive line. They raised their bulletproof shields to block while striding toward the line’s cover. From time to time, they even used shotguns to fire back.

The most terrifying thing was that despite the Scavenger Army NPCs obviously having had their limbs shot off and bodies hit by bullets, as long as their heads were still there, after drinking a bottle of potion, they could still endure the pain and continue to fight.
Although the Scavenger Army also suffered casualties, it was nothing compared to their enemy’s.
Tian Zhen had thought that victory was within their grasp, but he did not expect the gap to be so huge!

His heart sank. “If this continues, once the Scavenger Army gets close to the cover, they would be within close combat range and be at an even greater advantage! Our team would be completely crushed! ”
The other guild commanders thought the same thing. Their faces darkened, and they hated Dragon Country Guild to death in their hearts.
Tian Zhen took a deep breath, musing, “I’ll have to take one for the team. Survival of the group takes priority over that of the individual! ”
“You Guys retreat first! ” Tian Zhen clenched his fists tightly, his nails almost digging into his flesh. He said in a deep voice, “I’ll bring my people to stay and buy you guys three minutes. ”
At such a critical moment, Tian Zhen chose to stay behind personally.
The commanders of the other player teams all turned to look at Tian Zhen in admiration as they knew they wouldn’t have been able to make the same decision.
Nodding at Tian Zhen with respect, they immediately led their player teams to retreat.
During the day, Fang Heng could move the medicinal ingredients that were stored with the Dark Knights back. At night, he could control the zombies into an assembly line and make the potions.
With everything planned out, Fang Heng went offline to take a nap. He was prepared to stay up late and grind contribution points after he recovered his stamina at night.
When he woke up, it was already past two o’clock in the afternoon. Fang Heng stuffed himself with some food and prepared to return to the game.
“With the warlord potion, it shouldn’t be a problem for Roche to deal with those players. Otherwise, he’s really weak, ” Fang Heng muttered as he walked to the study room in the back garden.

The zombies had finished reading the few books that he previously brought into the game from the study. Since he had nothing to do, he thought he might as well think of a way to bring two more books into the game for the zombies to study.
After all, reading was an important activity.
Butler Sun was arranging for the cleaners to clean the back garden. When he saw Fang Heng, he nodded and greeted him, “Mr. Fang Heng, have you been well these days? ”

“Thank you for taking care of me. This place is very nice, ” Fang Heng said and stretched his body. “I haven’t read for a long time. I’m going to the study to read for a while. Mr. Mo should be back soon, right? ”
“Yes, the family head will be back in two days. I’ll take you to the study. ”
After chatting with Butler Sun for a while and being dragged along to do the registration, Fang Heng entered the study.
“Huh? ”
There was a girl in a white dress in the study. She had shoulder-length black hair and was sitting in front of a small table, holding an ancient book in her hand.
Her skin was fair, her eyes especially big.
At first glance, she looked like a character from a manga.
The girl noticed Fang Heng’s gaze and turned her head.
Meeting his gaze, Xiao Ruoruo felt her heart skip a beat, and she immediately blocked her vision using the book.
Fang Heng took the initiative to greet her. “Hey there. ”
“Hey, I’m Xiao Ruoruo. Are you Fang Heng? I heard Butler Sun mention you before. ”
After Fang Heng closed the study door, he noticed that Xiao Ruoruo was holding a book in her hand.
“Yeah, I’m Fang Heng. Are you also here to read? ”
“Yup. ” Xiao Ruoruo nodded. “Fang Heng, are you studying Occult? I saw the blue crystal raw ores outside. At first, Mr. Sun thought they were just ordinary stone fragments. ”
“No wonder Butler Sun found a large warehouse to store the ores, ” thought Fang Heng.
He then responded, “Yes, I’m studying Occult. Do you also study Occult? ”
Xiao Ruoruo waved her hand repeatedly. “No, no, I study Sealing Alchemy. It’s closely related to Occult. ”
“Sealing Alchemy... ” Fang Heng immediately thought of something. “The advanced game world, Nightmare World. ”
In that world, the dream world and the real world partly intersected, and a monster called the nightmare demon rampaged the world.
In the hundreds of years of battle with the Nightmare Demon, humans mastered the special skill called Sealing Alchemy.
Humans could use Sealing Alchemy to seal demons into Alchemy Sealing Cards.
High-tier alchemists could use summon sealed demons from the cards to fight for them.
“Are you an advanced game world player? ”
“Well, I... ” Xiao Ruoruo felt a little uneasy as she spoke. She avoided Fang Heng’s gaze and stammered, “Y-Yes, sort of. ”
Fang Heng felt strange in his heart, thinking. “Sort of? What kind of answer is that? Why’s it so ambiguous? ”
“Oh, okay. ” Not asking further, he stood up and started to search for Occult books related to potions in the study.

The most important thing at the moment was to increase the success rate of potion making. After reading the relevant books, he had a chance of gaining potionology skill experience points and increasing his potionology level.
Xiao Ruoruo secretly looked at Fang Heng from behind.
After a long time, she mustered up her courage and stood up, carefully asking, “Fang Heng, can you lend me a blue crystal raw ore from the warehouse for research? ”

“Of course. Take whatever’s left in the warehouse for research as you please. Just don’t give the ores to anyone else, ” Fang Heng casually gave consent with his back facing her, still looking for a book. “Oh, right, be careful. Don’t destroy them. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - Secretly Manipulating
paragraphs: “Thank you! ”
Xiao Ruoruo thanked him gratefully.
“Fang Heng, what books are you looking for? I’ve read most of the books here. I can help. ”
Fang Heng was a little surprised. He turned his head to look at Xiao Ruoruo. “Really? You’ve read all of them? ”
“Mhm... ” Xiao Ruoruo lowered her head. “It’s just that I didn’t understand a few... ”
“I’m looking for books related to potionology. Can you help me? ”
“Yes. I remember there are three books related to potionology. ”
“You also know about potionology? ”

“A little. Potionology is a branch of Occult, and it’s also related to the production of alchemy powder. ” Xiao Ruoruo was a little shy. She walked to the other side of the bookshelf. “But potionology and alchemy are two different branches. Alchemy focuses on stimulating the characteristics of a single drug and purifying it. ”
Fang Heng casually agreed, indicating that he didn’t understand it at all.
Xiao Ruoruo walked to the side of the bookshelf, stood on her tiptoes, and took out two books from the bookshelf.
“Strange, there should be another one... why can’t I find it... ” Xiao Ruoruo looked for a while and muttered softly.
Ahem.
“It’s okay. Two books are enough. ”
Fang Heng thought to himself that the remaining book was still in District 8 and he had had no time to bring it back.
Walking forward, Fang Heng took the two books from Xiao Ruoruo’s hands.
With a flick of his wrist, one of the books disappeared without a trace.
“Eh? That’s amazing! How did brother you do that, Fang Heng? ” Xiao Ruoruo widened her eyes, her face full of curiosity.
“Shh. ” Fang Heng raised a finger and carefully looked outside the door. “It’s just a little magic trick. Don’t tell Butler Sun. ”
“The operation was a complete failure. ”
After reading the latest situation report, Kou Huai, the person in charge of District 7 of the Federation, put the report on his hand down and lowered his head to think.
He did consider that Fang Heng might win, but he didn’t expect that Fang Heng would win so easily!
Throughout the entire battle, Fang Heng and his zombies didn’t even show up. They easily defeated the army alliance of District 7’s gaming unions.
The strength of the player guilds in District 7 was definitely not weak!
From the report, the overall strength of the Scavenger Army in Edge Creek Town had increased explosively.
Everything was related to Fang Heng.
Kou Huai was silent.
He felt a huge pressure.
Kou Huai had never thought that he would feel such a huge pressure from a single player.
“I’ll never allow Server 7’s main storyline to be taken away! ” In order to obtain the final ownership of Server 7, Kou Huai had put in over ten years’ worth of effort!
He would never allow anyone to snatch the fruit of victory from his hands.
Kou Huai’s index finger lightly pressed on the table, clearly treating Fang Heng as a true opponent.
“Cheng Ya, you’ve been helping Fang Heng transport medicinal ingredients during the day, right? ”
Cheng Ya was suddenly called to report to her superiors, and she couldn’t help but feel a little nervous.
“Yes, Sir. ”
“What happened after that? What did Fang Heng do after the medicinal ingredients were transported into the warehouse? ”
“The Scavenger Army guards the warehouse very vigilantly. It’s very difficult to go in and investigate... ” Cheng Ya paused for a moment and thought of something.
“Continue. ”

“Yesterday, Roche was preparing to launch a surprise attack on the players’ shelter in Edge Creek Town at night, but was stopped by Fang Heng. In the morning, Roche brought a few people to the warehouse. After coming out, he became very excited and immediately led the Scavenger Army out. ”
Upon hearing that, Kou Huai understood that the key was to cut off the supply of medicinal ingredients.
It was likely that Fang Heng relied on the medicinal ingredients he obtained from the Federation and somehow increased the overall strength of the Scavenger Army using them.
Kou Huai felt a little displeased as he was the one who provided that batch of medicinal ingredients to Fang Heng.
He didn’t expect that Fang Heng would use those very ingredients to deal with the players.
“Indulging in an enemy is indeed asking for trouble! ” he thought.
Kou Huai raised his head and asked, “Ah Chen, how much more ingredients are scheduled for delivery to Fang Heng? ”
The Federation soldier who was recording notes at the side flipped through the list and reported, “Sir, about half of the medicinal ingredients haven’t been delivered yet. ”
“Stop the supply of Fang Heng’s medicinal ingredients immediately. ”
“Yes! ” The soldier asked, “As for the superiors... ”

“Recently, the strength of the Scavenger Army in the game has increased greatly. Division 7 has temporarily entered a state of alert. There is an ingredient shortage. Tell the superiors and Fang Heng that we need more time to prepare this batch of medicinal ingredients. ”
“Understood! ”

Kou Huai looked at Cheng Ya again. “And you, stop helping Fang Heng deliver the medicinal ingredients immediately. In addition, I need you to keep an eye on Fang Heng’s movements 24 hours a day in the game. Report immediately if there are any special situations. ”
“Yes! ”
“Also, tell me the exact coordinates of the place where the Dark Knights have gathered the ingredients at. ”

Cheng Ya was startled. Raising her head and meeting Kou Huai’s gaze, she sensed that Kou Huai must have sensed a threat. She thought, “Now, the Federation also wants us to attack Fang Heng secretly! ”
“Edge Creek Town area 54189, 27111. ”
“Go. Keep an eye on Fang Heng. ”
“Understood! ”

After Cheng Ya left, Kou Huai shifted his gaze to the Federation soldier next to him. “It’s not convenient for us to act. Leak the news of Fang Heng and the Dark Knights to Tao Yunlei. He’ll know what to do. ”

“Fang Heng, I’m sorry. I’m very sorry. We received orders from superiors to stop supplying the medicinal ingredients promised to you for now. The reason is that the Scavenger Army’s strength has greatly increased in a short period of time, hence posing a threat to the safety of the people of District 7, requiring the district to enter a state of emergency. Once things return to normal, we will immediately supply you with medicinal ingredients. ”
“Hmm... Emergency... ” Fang Heng did not doubt it when he heard it, but he was a little apprehensive in his heart.

“Why’s the Federation reacting so quickly this time? Is it because the Federation’s commander-in-chief of District 7 has a very strong operational ability? Without the supply of medicinal ingredients from them, it’s equivalent to missing out on a large number of contribution points I can get from potion making! ” he mused.
“In addition, we need to keep an eye on the Scavenger Army’s movements 24 hours a day. We can’t continue to help you transport the goods. ”
“Oh? Do you not want the divine potion anymore? ”
“We are also in a difficult position because of the orders given by our superiors. ”
“Forget it. ” Fang Heng spread his hands and took out a bottle of low-tier divine potion and threw it to Cheng Ya.
“You’ve worked hard the whole day. I’ll give you the reward. Let’s work together again in the future if there’s a chance to. ”
Cheng Ya and the other two Federation players looked at one another.
They had never thought that Fang Heng would still give them the reward.
“Thank you. ”
“No problem. ” Fang Heng waved his hand.
He did not care about the fact that Cheng Ya and the others could not continue to help.
After all, he could not always rely on Cheng Ya to deliver the potions, and most importantly, Cheng Ya and the other two were not all that efficient.
He had greatly overestimated them. Based on their current efficiency, the three of them would probably need a week to finish delivering the goods.
To improve the situation, Fang Heng had a new plan.
As he was thinking, the sound of a truck horn sounded in the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - Large Trucks
paragraphs: Cheng Ya and the others turned around when they heard the noise. More than a dozen large trucks were heading toward the warehouse.
One truck after another drove past everyone’s front and stopped at the edge of the warehouse.
Osborne walked out from the passenger’s seat, looking travelworn.
“Fang Heng. ”
“Osborne, you’re finally here. I’ve been waiting for you in the cold wind for a long time. ”

“Do you think it’s that easy? ” Osborne said unhappily, “There are a total of 17 large trucks. All the trucks in the nearby area had been mobilized in the first instance. Each truck is equipped with a driver and a low-level army member for you to deploy. ”
Cheng Ya and the other two looked at Fang Heng, who was talking to Osborne.

For a moment, their thoughts were a little messy, and confusion filled their minds. “What the hell? So many huge trucks were all mobilized by Fang Heng alone? Since when did Fang Heng have such a big say in the Scavenger Army? In just a few days, how much has his level increased in the Scavenger Army? Also... What’s the purpose of mobilizing so many huge trucks all at once? It it also to for transporting medicinal ingredients? Is the Scavenger Army now the ones in charge of transporting them? Preparing so many large trucks in advance, could it be that Fang Heng’s already predicted the Federation’s actions? Have the Dark Knights and the Scavenger Army reached an alliance? ”
Fang Heng and Osborne walked to the side of one of the large trucks. As Fang Heng inspected the truck, he praised, “Not bad, 70% of the goods are new. ”

Osborne was exasperated. “Fang Heng, this is the greatest number of trucks that can be mobilized in a short period of time. I’ve already done what I promised you. The rest is up to you. You must ensure an adequate supply of the potions. ”
“Of course. I’ll take care of everything. ”
“Mhm. In addition, you have to be responsible for the truck and the safety of the drivers. If there’s a problem, you have to pay the corresponding contribution points as compensation. ”

“Okay, okay, okay. Leave the rest to me. Just wait patiently for the goods tomorrow morning. ” Fang Heng impatiently waved his hand and walked to the side of the warehouse. He motioned for the two warehouse guards to open the iron door of the large warehouse.
Then, Fang Heng shouted to the drivers on the trucks, “Everyone, drive the truck directly into the warehouse and rest for a while. There are still many goods that need to be moved... ”
The trucks started up again and drove into the warehouse one after another.
“Thanks, Brother! ” Until all the trucks entered the warehouse, Fang Heng waved at Osborne while following him into the warehouse.
“Tch, there’s no sincerity at all. ” Osborne shook his head and signaled the guard at the door to close the warehouse door.
In order to ensure smooth production of the potions, he decided to stand guard there personally.
On the side, Cheng Ya and the other two from the Federation looked at one another.
“Cheng Ya, what is Fang Heng doing this time? Why are there so many trucks all of a sudden? ”
Cheng Ya shook her head, expressing her similar incomprehension.
Wei Chun suggested, “Should we sneak into the warehouse to take a look? ”
Another Federation player asked, “How do we get in? ”
Looking up, they saw Osborne and a few senior members of the Scavenger Army standing guard at the door.
It was impossible to force their way in.
Cheng Ya looked at the tightly shut warehouse door and shook her head. “The higher-ups have told us that we are to continue monitoring Fang Heng’s movements and play by ear. ”
“Let’s take turns to rest. Two people will be here at any one time. Reach out immediately if anything happens... ”
The interior of the warehouse was extremely empty. It was enough for 17 large trucks to stop temporarily.
Driving the large trucks into the warehouse and seeing the scene in the warehouse, the Scavenge Army’s drivers could not help but feel a little scared.
40 tall Tyrant forms with a strong sense of oppression stood in two rows on both sides of the passage, forming two human walls.
The entire warehouse was filled with sizzling sounds.
Scarlet lickers could be seen in plain sight on the ground, the ceiling, and the surrounding walls.
Meanwhile, on the right side of the warehouse, there was a large zombie team!
For a moment, the drivers thought that they had come to the area in Meteorite Company specially designated for zombie team cultivation and not the Scavenger Army’s warehouse.
After parking the 17 trucks in the designated area, the Scavenger Army members got off the trucks one by one.
Even though they had drunk the low-tier divine potion, they still felt stiff being stared at by so many zombies.

“Thank you for your hard work. We will have an operation tonight. During this period of time, go and rest. I will handle the transportation work. ” Fang Heng stood in front of everyone with a smile. “Please don’t wander about during this period of time. Just rest in the warehouse lounge area at the back. ”
While he spoke, the zombie team dispersed into two rows and opened up a small path.
The Scavenger Army members looked at one another.
No matter how they looked at it, they felt that it was a threat.
Choosing to follow Fang Heng’s instructions, they passed through the dense zombie team and went to the lounge at the back of the warehouse to rest.
After everyone entered the lounge, Fang Heng slowly walked to the trailer behind one of the trucks and lowered his head to check it.
“It’s almost done... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself as he controlled the Tyrant forms at the side to walk to the trucks.
Thud! Thud!
The Tyrants each strode to the trailer behind each truck and lay down flatly.

Thereafter, the vine zombies brought some firewood and covered the Tyrants with it. Then, they laid a layer of wooden planks on top of the firewood and stacked the boxes that they had prepared earlier on the topmost layer.
In the end, the Lickers also ran to the large trucks and slipped into the gap between the boxes and the bottom of the truck.
Looking at the fully-equipped large trucks, Fang Heng murmured, “This should be enough... ”
The door to the warehouse opened again when the sun set.
Fang Heng poked his head out of the front passenger seat and greeted Osborne. “I’ll go outside to load some goods. You know what I mean. ”
“Do you need help? ”
“It’s okay. I can do it alone. ”
Osborne curled his lips and nodded. “Hurry back. Keep safe. ”
One truck after another drove out of the warehouse.
Not far away, Cheng Ya and the others who had been monitoring Fang Heng immediately reacted.
“Look! It’s Fang Heng! He’s coming out! He’s on that large truck! ”
Wei Chun carefully counted them one by one.
There were 17 large trucks in total!
“What’s in the back of the trucks? Why does it look so heavy? ”
Cheng Ya also frowned.
She also noticed that there were big boxes in the back of the trucks.

“Strange, wasn’t Fang Heng supposed to transport the ingredients temporarily stored in the Dark Knights’ camp to the Scavenger Army? Looking at him now, is he preparing to send the ingredients back? ”
Cheng Ya was very confused.
She had a strong premonition that Fang Heng must be planning something again.
“Do you want to follow him and take a look? ”
“Let it be. Inform the higher-ups immediately. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Ambush
paragraphs: On the main road leading to the Dark Knights’ camp, the guild leader of Leftway Gaming Guild, Tian Zhen, had gathered with hundreds of elite player from various game companies.
They had been waiting for more than half an hour.
Niu Xia was a little anxious from waiting. He could not help but ask, “Why hasn’t anyone come yet? is the news reliable? ”
No one answered him, and the atmosphere was a little awkward.
Ahem.
After a long while, the vice-guild leader of Holy Paladin Gaming Guild coughed lightly. “Can you explain the situation in detail? It’ll also help us mentally prepare better. ”

The ambush was an emergency operation that Tian Zhen had organized at the last minute. The other participating gaming union players only knew that the ambush was aimed at Fang Heng. With just a word from Tian Zhen, they had led a team here.

The battle during the day ended in a crushing defeat. However, at that time, Leftway Gaming Guild was left alone to fend off the Scavenger Army to buy time for everyone. They had won the trust of the players.

“Yes, the information is absolutely reliable. ” Though he didn’t bother with Niu Xia, Tao Yuanlei gave a response as the other players had also voiced out. “It was a childhood friend of mine who leaked it to me. He’s working in the Federation. ”
Everyone was enlightened.
The information they received from the Federation should be correct.

“The information we received is that last time, Fang Heng helped the Federation greatly in District 5. As a reward, the Federation provided Fang Heng with a large amount of medicinal ingredients yesterday. Based on other information, we believe that Fang Heng used some special method to produce a potion called warlord potion in a short period of time using the ingredients. As per what we saw during the day, the warlord potion can increase the combat strength of the Scavenger Army in a short period of time to a frightening extent. ”

Tian Zhen continued to explain calmly, “Currently, a large portion of the ingredients used to produce the warlord potion has not been sent back to the Scavenger Army. There’s a high chance that Fang Heng will personally bring people over to transport the ingredients. ”
Leftway Gaming Guild had suffered heavy losses. He urgently needed a victory to boost their morale.

“If we are lucky, we can directly get rid of Fang Heng. Even if we are unlucky and let him escape, we can take this opportunity to cut off the Scavenger Army’s supply of medicinal ingredients and prepare for the next battle. ”
“I see. ”
The players present were all elites of District 7. After Tian Zhen’s brief explanation, they all understood.
“Attention! Over There! ! ! ”
Looking in the direction that Tao Yuanlei was pointing at, the players saw a light appear on the road in the distance.
It was the headlights of a vehicle!
“They’re coming! ”
A player raised his binoculars and looked into the distance. He whispered, “There are more than ten trucks in total! Confirmed to be from the Scavenger Army! ”
The trucks slowly drove on the small road, heading in the direction where the guild players was lying in ambush.
“Target confirmed! Target confirmed! ”
“The truck is heavily loaded. Estimated to contain a large amount of ingredients being transported... ”
“Why would there be a lot of ingredients? ”
“What about the number of enemies? ”
“Don’t panic! ” Tian Zhen said in a deep voice, “Listen to my command. Demolition team, get ready! ”
They watched as the trucks drove past them one by one on the main road.
Tian Zhen shouted, “Do it! ! ! ”
Boom! Boom, boom!
As soon as he said that, the ground beneath his feet shook.
The bombs that were buried in the middle of the road had been detonated!

A few trucks that were in the middle of the explosion were surrounded by a ball of fire, causing a secondary explosion. The drivers in the trucks coming from behind hurriedly stepped on the brakes but could not dodge in time.
The overloaded trucks could not stop at all, so they crashed into each other, resulting in a series of collisions.
For a moment, the players’ vision was blocked by the thick black fog created by the explosion in front of them.
“Charge! ! ! ” Tian Zhen shouted.
Taking advantage of the enemy’s disablement, Tian Zhen led the small party of players to launch a surprise attack!
As each elite player charged forward, they used their submachine guns to wildly fire at the trucks.
The battle with the Scavenger Army in the morning was still vivid in their minds.

After getting boosted by the warlord potion, the physical defense of the Scavenger Army members was terrifyingly strong. Each and every one of them was not afraid of death. If one or two shots could not kill them, it was safer to fire a few more shots!
After continuously firing, the players rushed to a distance of more than ten meters away from the truck.
“Did none of the guards return fire? ” Tian Zhen vaguely felt that something was not right.
The sky was very dark at night.
Under the illumination of the fire, Tian Zhen could vaguely see a few tall black shadows in the thick black fog.
“Stop! ” Tian Zhen slowed down his pace and signaled the players to stop attacking.
As the gunshots stopped, a few swaying shadows walked out from the burning flames, revealing their true appearances.
“Tyrants? ! Why would they be here? ”
The Tyrant forms were still burning in flames. They advanced forward, patting the flames on their bodies as they walked toward the players.
Tian Zhen’s pupils instantly enlarged several times, and cold sweat could not help but appear on his forehead.
One, two, three...
A total of five Tyrant forms walked out from the flames!
Tian Zhen had never expected that they would actually encounter Tyrant forms during that night’s operation. “Is Fang Heng controlling them from behind? ! But where did they come from? ”
Boom! ! !
A rocket launcher hit the Tyrant forms.
The Tyrant forms, hit head-on, were sent flying.
As they fell to the ground, fine vines immediately wrapped around their bodies. The injuries they received healed at an extremely fast speed.
“Retreat! Fire! ! ! Don’t let them get close! ”
The players present were all elites from the various large guilds. When they heard the command, they raised their guns and fired at the Tyrant forms.
However, the next second, Tian Zhen heard a soft sound from the side.
“This sound... Something isn’t right! ”
The sky was very dark. Although the flames could provide a certain range of vision, it was impossible to see clearly.
Tian Zhen felt an unprecedented sense of danger from the bottom of his heart.
The sound was getting louder and closer.
Something was rapidly approaching them! And there were quite a number of it!
There was definitely something amiss about the sound!
Tian Zhen shouted, “Flashbang! Quick! ! ”
Shoo! Shoo! Shoo! !
A few flashbangs were thrown into the battlefield from the side.
A dazzling blue light shone, illuminating the surroundings.
Tian Zhen endured the piercing pain in his eyes and looked around.
With the help of the light from the flashbangs, Tian Zhen was finally able to see the surroundings clearly.
Standing on the spot, he widened his eyes, feeling a deep shock.
It was Tyrants, and there were far more than five of them!
It turned out that they were all hidden in the trailers behind the trucks!
A total of nearly 20 Tyrants climbed down from the trailers behind the trucks, and they were moving toward the players in large strides.
What was even more terrifying was that there was still a vast group of scarlet Lickers!
Affected by the high-frequency sound waves from the flashbangs, the Lickers were frozen in place.
There were at least 100 of them!
“How could this be... ”

chapters.title: Chapter 408: Rumors
paragraphs: The blinding light gradually dimmed, and the Lickers were still in a state of dizziness.
With the help of the light, the players could clearly see the vast number of Lickers surrounding them. For a moment, they were extremely shocked and terrified.
Wasn’t this battle an ambush? Weren’t they preparing to catch Fang Heng off guard?
The players wondered if they had been ambushed by Fang Heng instead.
Tao Yunlei was also stunned. He looked at the zombie team in front of him in disbelief, his mind blank.
He was a spy planted by the Federation in the various large-sized gaming unions.
According to the intelligence, Fang Heng had left Edge Creek Town with more than ten trucks full of boxes, and there was a high chance that he would head to the Dark Knights’ camp.
He had never expected that the big boxes were actually filled with Tyrants.
“Quick! Retreat! ” Tian Zhen shouted, taking advantage of the Lickers’ still dazed state.
Now, he couldn’t care less about whether Fang Heng was on the truck or not.
They had been tricked, and the enemy had definitely come prepared!
A dense barrage of bullets bombarded the Tyrant forms and Lickers.

Other than the large caliber bullets that could stop the Tyrant forms’ footsteps, the remaining bullets could not cause any damage to the Tyrant forms. They were directly blocked by the vines under the Tyrant forms’ skin.
Meanwhile, the Lickers had also received some of Fang Heng’s attribute bonuses. Their HP was much higher than a normal zombie corpse!
Presently, survival was more important. The players were fighting while retreating. They threw flashbang after flashbang at the zombie team, trying their best to delay the zombie team.
As most of the players were elites from the various gaming unions, the situation was relatively not chaotic.
“Hint: the trucks you rented have been damaged. Your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have been reduced. A portion of your Scavenger Army contribution points will be deducted... ”
“Hint: your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have slightly reduced. ”
Not far away, Fang Heng walked out of the passenger seat.
With the help of the Vampire Bloodline’s night vision ability, he swept his gaze across the battlefield and soon saw a familiar face among the retreating players.
It was Dragon Country Guild’s Niu Xia.
Fang Heng’s face darkened slightly. “How despicable to launch a sneak attack! ”
He did not feel any heartache about losing his reputation points and contribution points. It was just that the ambush had caused him to lose nearly one-third of his trucks!
That way, the speed of transporting the medicinal ingredients would be forced to decrease by quite a bit.
“They’ll have to pay the price! ” Fang Heng was extremely displeased. With a wave of his hand, he controlled the Lickers to pounce forward.
Screech! Screech, screech!
After being stunned, the scarlet Lickers quickly surrounded the players from all directions.
The effect of the flashbangs on the Lickers was becoming more and more limited.
“We can’t delay any longer! ”
When Niu Xia saw that the space for retreat was becoming smaller and smaller, he couldn’t help but shout, “Everyone, spread out and run as far as you can! ”
After saying that, without waiting for the others to respond, Niu Xia led his party members to escape from the side.
The rest of the players cursed silently in their hearts. They were filled with disdain for Niu Xia being the first one to rush for escape.
However, they also knew clearly that what Niu Xia said was presently the best method at the moment!
They did not have any heavy weapons that could kill the Tyrant forms.
If the situation dragged on, only death would await them!
Seeing that Niu Xia had taken the lead to escape, the other player guilds also scattered and fled. They quickly disappeared into the night.
“Did he run away? ” Fang Heng gritted his teeth. He felt inwardly dissatisfied.

He could not spread his control across too many groups of Lickers, so he simply split them into two groups. One group chased after Niu Xia’s player team while the other looked for an opportunity to kill.
“Hint: your zombie clone Licker has received fatal damage. ”
“Hint: your zombie clone Licker has used a skill to dodge the enemy’s attack. ”
“Hint: your zombie clone Licker has killed a player... ”
“Hint: your zombie clone Licker has died... ”
A series of game hints refreshed before him.
Without being able to directly see the situation, Fang Heng was unable to fully control the Lickers, so he could only give them a simple command to chase after the targets.
The Lickers that chased after the targets were quickly killed one by one.
Realizing that the death rate of the Lickers was increasing, Fang Heng understood that the players were using tactics to defeat them one by one.
Fang Heng had no choice but to recall all of them.
More than ten minutes later, the zombie team had completely regrouped.
After one battle, only about one-third of the players had been eliminated.
Looking at the Scavenger Army NPCs that were cleaning up the mess, Fang Heng muttered softly, “There seems to be a problem... ”
Niu Xia had planted explosive packs in the middle of the road in advance. It was clearly a planned ambush, and he knew that Fang Heng’s travel route.
“Who could it be that leaked my location? ” Fang Heng mused.
Few people in the game knew that he collected ingredients from the Dark Knights.
“Cheng Ya? ” Fang Heng slowly withdrew his gaze from the darkness.

Fortunately, the Scavenger Army members did not suffer much damage in the earlier wave of battle. The low-level members of the army who were injured in the explosion drank a few mouthfuls of the warlord potion and immediately more or less recovered.
After reorganizing the team, the Scavenger Army members began to move the boxes loaded on the trailer behind the truck out one by one.
The boxes were all loaded with cart components.
Soon, the construction of a cart was completed. More than 30 Tyrant forms pulled the large cart along the path to the mountainside while being escorted by the Lickers.
Fang Heng’s original plan was to bring the Tyrant forms to the mountainside to carry the goods, but who would have thought that they would be attacked on the way.
They could only consider themselves unlucky.
Outside the Dark Knights’ camp, Ai Lei silently looked at the group of Tyrant forms that were pulling the cart and wore a strange expression on his face.
“So the research on zombies in District 8 has already reached this stage, huh, Fang Heng? ”
“It’s not that advanced. We’re still spending a lot of money on research, ” Fang Heng humbly said.
“All right. ”
While the elite Dark Knights loaded the ingredients back onto the cart, Ai Lei took the opportunity to pull Fang Heng aside and ask in a low voice, “Fang Heng, do you know Hu Xuanxuan? ”
“Who’s that? I’ve never heard of her. ”
“That’s strange. ”
“What’s wrong? ”
“Hu Xuanxuan is a senior member of the Dark Knights. She’s been asking around about you. She thinks that the recent movements of the Scavenger Army are related to you. ”
Fang Heng frowned slightly. “Hu Xuanxuan’s probably a player. ”
“Other than Hu Xuanxuan, many people in the Dark Knights think that there is something amiss about you. Now, even the higher-ups of the Dark Knights have some doubts about you. ”
“Hint: affected by special player factors. Your reputation points in the Dark Knights have decreased. ”
“Hint: affected by special player factors. Your friendship with the Dark Knights has declined. ”
Fang Heng’s heart sank again. He immediately realized that something was wrong, and it was very wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - Dilemma
paragraphs: Seeing the slight change in Fang Heng’s expression, Ai Lei said in a low voice, “Fang Heng, by any chance, did you accidentally offend someone? ”
Fang Heng nodded, thinking that he had offended quite a number of people.
“Yeah, that’s right. ”
If he only had some guesses earlier when he was ambushed, then Fang Heng confirmed them presently.

Be it at the beginning when his supply of medicinal ingredients was cut, the moment his transportation team at the foot of the mountain was attacked, or his declined friendship with the Dark Knights, there was only one suspect that came to mind.
“It’s the Federation! They’re also secretly intervening. ”

Fang Heng originally thought that his relationship with the Federation was quite good. In addition, the Federation had always announced to the public that they welcomed all the major gaming unions to participate in friendly competition, so Fang Heng did not think that the Federation was doing something behind the scenes.

“Old Black was right about the Federation often resorting to underhanded tricks. They’re really shameless. ” A flurry of thoughts filled Fang Heng’s mind. “Regardless, with the main storyline being so attractive, it would be a wonder if the Federation was willing to back off so easily. ”
Having been tricked, Fang Heng instead felt his fighting spirit surge.
However, since the Federation had clearly made a move against him, he had to get rid of Cheng Ya and the two other spies.
“What are you thinking about, Brother? “Ai Lei patted Fang Heng’s shoulder. “Don’t be afraid. I’m on your side. If there’s any news, I’ll immediately tell you. ”
“Thanks! ”
Fang Heng continued to focus on the main storyline.
With the cart and Tyrant forms, it was much easier to move the medicinal ingredients.

The Tyrants repeatedly went to and fro the mountainside to move the boxes containing the medicinal ingredients back to the foot of the mountain. The medicinal ingredients from the Scavenger Army at the foot of the mountain were then transported back to the headquarters via the large trucks.
Originally, Fang Heng was optimistic that he would be able to complete the transportation of the medicinal ingredients in one night.
Unfortunately, he had lost five large trucks in the previous ambush, so the transportation efficiency was greatly reduced. He estimated that he might not be able to complete it in one night.
Fang Heng turned his head and asked, “Ai Lei, do you still have any large trucks here? How about lending me more? ”
Late at night, the Zombie Apocalypse’s District 7’s headquarters was brightly lit.
They had failed!
Kou Huai looked back and forth at the situation report submitted by Tao Yunlei.

“Zombie team? Hundreds of Lickers? More than 20 Tyrants? It wasn’t an ordinary zombie team but instead a team of specially enhanced zombies with combat strength surpassing that of their ordinary counterparts. The small team of players formed by the major game guilds of District 7 were more or less unable to retaliate and collapsed at the first touch. ” Seeing the lines in the report, Kou Huai felt his heart sink slowly.
The sniper operation was planned by him from behind the scenes.

Based on Fang Heng’s current strength, it would be difficult for the players from the game guilds of District 7 to contend with him.
Kou Huai kept tapping the table with his fingers, making rhythmic sounds.
The guard, Ah Chen, stood to the side in fear.
He knew that the finger-tapping was Kou Huai’s habit.

After a while, the tapping stopped.
“Ah Chen. ”
“Yes! ”
“Zombie Apocalypse’s District 7’s player Fang Heng has violated the Federation’s regulations and joined the Scavenger Army in the game... ”

“Yes! ”
Kou Huai took a deep breath.
After all, Fang Heng had just entered District 7, and his foothold was weak.

First, he could choose to withdraw from the Scavenger Army.

That way, Fang Heng’s main storyline would be halted. Relying on his considerable foothold within the Dark Knights, Kou Huai was confident that he could completely isolate Fang Heng from the main storyline!
Even if Fang Heng chose not to withdraw, it was fine.
That way, District 7 of the Federation would have a legitimate reason to take action against Fang Heng.
Bringing the first batch of trucks filled with medicinal ingredients back to the central square of Edge Creek Town, Fang Heng noticed that the army led by Roche had returned in complete victory.
During the day, not only did Roche beat up the members of Leftway Gaming Guild, but he also took down three survivors’ shelters in a row.
Presently, Roche was in the square instructing the army members to organize the materials they had looted from the outside.
Many injured Scavenger Army members lay on the square.
They relied on the warlord potion to replenish their stamina and recover from their injuries.

“Hahaha! Fang Heng, I’ve finally found you. Your potion is some pretty good stuff. We made a beautiful comeback today! ” Roche saw Fang Heng from afar and waved at him. The day’s victory made Roche very happy.

“A large number of survivors have gathered in the shelter these days, and they are equipped with automatic rifles. They think they can stop the Scavenger Army with those scrap metal. Haha! A bunch of trashes! Tomorrow morning, we will launch another surprise attack. We will completely destroy the remaining few shelters and rob them of all their materials! ” Roche declared fiercely. “You can stay here and make the potions in peace. Leave the rest to me! ”

As Roche spoke, he walked over with enthusiasm, saying in a low voice, “Fang Heng, I know that that guy Osborne will distribute the newly made warlord potions to a few nearby areas tomorrow morning. When the time comes, you watch out and prepare a few boxes of high-quality ones for me. ”
“No problem. ”
“Hint: your favorability rating with Roche has increased significantly. ”
“Hint: your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have increased. ”
“My reputation points in the Dark Knights have decreased, but that in the Scavenger Army have increased. The spies are really getting into action. ”
Fang Heng felt tired.
He looked around the square.
Cheng Ya and the other two Federation players were still at the corner of the square, keeping watch.
The three of them noticed Fang Heng’s gaze and lowered their heads at the same time.

After pondering for a moment, Fang Heng nodded and said, “Oh right, Roche, there’s a small problem with the production of the potions. I want to borrow a few people from the army to help me out with something. ”
“Of course. I’m giving you the go-ahead. No matter who it is, you can directly arrange for them to help you. ”
Roche didn’t care at all.
As long as he could get not a few but rather a large number of high-quality warlord potions, he was willing to let Fang Heng mobilize even dozens of the members!
“Thank you so much. ” Fang Heng smiled.

“Now, how should I toy with Cheng Ya and the other two Federation’s b*stards to death? By having them sort the medicinal ingredients for potion making for a day? No, they might leak the formula of the potions. Have them move logs in the forest for an entire day? Or maybe have them gather military intelligence on the Federation? Alternatively, should I have them charge into and attack the ordinary players’ shelters? ” Just as Fang Heng was struggling with how to vent his anger, game hints quickly refreshed on his retinas.
“Hint: you have received an urgent message from the game cabin. Message content: something big has happened. God, when you have the chance, hurry and come offline to discuss about it. ”
Seeing the game hint, Fang Heng frowned. He returned to the potion making warehouse and went offline.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - Countermeasure
paragraphs: “You want me to turn myself in? Voluntarily withdraw from the Scavenger Army? Otherwise, I might be added to the list of dangerous people in the Federation and even face the risk of being wanted by the Federation? ”
Listening to Mo Jiawei’s explanation, Fang Heng was amused. He thought, “They failed to secretly do me in, so now they’re trying to publicly do it? ”

“God, don’t laugh. We need to quickly think of a way. The Federation of District 7 is very powerful in the game. It’s not wise to fight them head-on. Moreover, once District 7 really issues an arrest warrant for you, the Federation’s inspection team in the real world might come and forcefully take you away... ”

Mo Jiawei was very anxious. He tried to come up with an idea. “Why don’t you agree to withdraw from the Scavenger Army on the surface but do as you wish in reality? In other words, instead of fighting them head-on, you can defy them behind the scenes. ”

“This involves the main storyline of District 7. There’s no doubt that the Federation will compete with us. If we retreat at this step, then we’ll have to retreat countless steps. Unless I withdraw from the competition for the main storyline of Server 7, the Federation will not let me off. ”
Fang Heng seriously thought about it, then continued, “We can indeed try to avoid defying them so obviously. It’s just that the trick of obeying on the surface will be too easily seen through. ”
“Then what should we do? ”
“We’ll just stall for a few days and see what his next move is. However, we have to be careful about Server 8’s prison. ”

Fang Heng felt that he didn’t have the time to take care of Server 8. He thought for a while and continued, “In name, Server 8 will be transferred to North River Heavy Industry so that the Federation can’t find an excuse to cause trouble for District 8. ”

Mo Jiawei nodded and uttered, “All right, I’ll get someone to release the news and announce that North River Heavy Industry will temporarily withdraw from cooperating with you. In addition, I’ll have to contact Fourth Uncle and have him hurry back so that the Federation’s inspection team won’t come knocking on our door. ”

“All right. Anyway, the Federation is nothing much. ” Fang Heng rubbed his wrist, looking like a militant. “Despite the Federation’s reputation, they’ve previously been beaten to such a terrible state by Night Owl. Their strength isn’t that great at all. I’ll show them who’s more powerful. Besides, the thing that the Federation’s spending so much effort to obtain must be very valuable... ”
Fang Heng’s current understanding of the game’s main storyline was still very vague.
He knew that the final reward was the ownership of the game world, but he didn’t know exactly what the final ownership entailed.
However, since the Federation could be so shameless for the ownership, it should be a very important and very powerful thing.
“All right! ”
For a moment, Mo Jiawei also felt his blood boil. He thought, “So what if it’s the Federation? Aren’t they all just players, too? ”
Given that he and Fang Heng had come so far as a team, Mo Jiawei had full confidence in Fang Heng. He thus became determined to compete with the Federation.

“Leave District 8 to me. Our North River Heavy Industry is a big business. The Federation will have to think twice before finding trouble with us. Also, God, the Federation’s inspection team might come looking for you. It’s safer to stay here for the next two days... ”
As the two of them were discussing, Fang Heng’s cell phone rang.
“Chen Yu? ”
“Fang Heng, are you okay? ”
Chen Yu had just seen the notice issued by District 7 not long ago. He immediately scolded his teammates for their idiotic behavior, then called Fang Heng.
Having interacted with Fang Heng for so long, he knew Fang Heng’s personality very well.
With such a threatening announcement, it would be a miracle if Fang Heng bowed his head and obediently withdrew from the Scavenger Army!
Even if he withdrew under pressure on the surface, he would definitely play all kinds of underhanded tricks behind the scenes.
Whether publicly or privately, Chen Yu was very unwilling to see Fang Heng as an enemy.
Fang Heng shrugged and said in a relaxed tone, “Fortunately, it’s not a big problem. It’s still under control. ”
“Uh... That... ” Chen Yu scratched his head, “I wanted to say that the announcement issued by the Federation was issued in the name of District 7. ”
“I understand. It has nothing to do with you. Organizational will doesn’t represent individual will. ”

“I just asked a few friends to pay attention to this matter. District 7 is not joking this time. They have already submitted a ban on you to their superiors and are preparing to join forces with the player unions of District 7 to attack the Scavenger Army in the game. A friend also told me that the Federation of District 7 has already started to transport large-sized weapons especially for countering Tyrants to the area of Edge Creek Town. ”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
Originally, with the Tyrants and warlord potions, dealing with the guild players of District 7 was a piece of cake.
Now that the Federation had joined in, it became a little troublesome.

Hearing Fang Heng’s silence, Chen Yu hesitated for a long time on the other end of the phone before continuing, “Fang Heng, Why don’t you return to District 8? As long as I’m in District 8, I guarantee that you’ll be unscathed in District 8. ”

“Come on, isn’t it just the Federation of District 7? Things haven’t developed to that serious of a state yet. ” Fang Heng answered unhappily, “Besides, how daring of you to make such a declaration when you might be fired tomorrow. When the time comes, come to my prison. As long as I, Fang Heng, am in the prison, I guarantee that you’ll be fine... ”
Chen Yu was speechless for a moment.
But he also felt relieved.
He felt that since Fang Heng could still joke at such a time, he was likely doing okay. “Make sense. He’s always been unfazed, ” he thought.
“All right, thanks for the information. I still have something to do. Let’s talk again next time. ”
After hanging up the phone, Fang Heng looked at Mo Jiawei who was at the side.
Mo Jiawei looked at Fang Heng with eager eyes.
“How’s the situation? ”
“Not good. The Federation of District 7 is already preparing to cooperate with the major player guilds of District 7 to deal with the Scavenger Army. ”
“The Federation’s ultimate goal is probably to halt my main storyline. ”
Mo Jiawei revealed a distressed expression. “Then what should we do? Do you have a plan? ”
“Hmm... ” Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
The enemy’s strength had increased again.
In order to balance things out, he had to think of a way to enhance his own combat strength.
As for the zombie clones, the research institute didn’t have the time to upgrade them. Presently, the institute was fully focusing on researching the first-generation meteorite.
As for the warlord potion, he could possibly try finding a way to improve the potion’s effects and in turn, increase the overall strength of the Scavenger Army!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up at that thought.

The commander of the Scavenger Army, Cook Barn, who had researched and produced the warlord potion, was also a senior researcher at Meteorite Company. It was very difficult to improve the potion’s effects through scientific research, not to mention in a short period of time.
Therefore, Fang Heng had to consider methods that were relatively unscientific.
“Occult! Potionology! ” Realization hit him.
Fang Heng figured that Mo Yunxiao should know some potionology.
However, Mo Yunxiao was currently not in the villa.
“Oh right, wasn’t there still her? ” Fang Heng mused as he thought of Xiao Ruoruo, whom he had seen in the study during the day.
“I can for the help of the top student who’s roughly read all the books in the study! ”
With that thought in mind, Fang Heng immediately got up and ran to Xiao Ruoruo’s guest room to ask her for help in improving the potion.
Meanwhile, Mo Jiawei was still thinking hard. When he saw Fang Heng rush outside, he immediately chased after him. “Fang Heng, where are you going? ”
“To find someone. ”
“Hmm? Going outside in the middle of the night? Isn’t that a little dangerous? You might be on the wanted list now and pursued by the Inspection Bureau. Be careful... ”
