chapters.title: Chapter 411 - Demi-Human Tribe
paragraphs: “Eh? Is she not in the room? ”
“Who are you looking for? ”
“Xiao Ruoruo, the top student. ”

Butler Sun had been woken up by the noise in the corridor and had come out to check the situation in his pajamas. Looking at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei suspiciously, he wondered, “What’re the two of them doing in front of a girl’s guest room in the middle of the night? ”
“Mr. Jiawei, Mr. Fang Heng, it’s already so late. What’s so important that you’re both here? ” uttered Butler Sun.
Mo Jiawei took two steps back to show his innocence.
Ahem.
Fang Heng’s face turned red.
The day and night were reversed in the game, so he had forgotten that it was already late at night.
It didn’t seem appropriate for two of them to block the entrance of a girl’s room at such an hour.

“I’m here to look for Xiao Ruoruo. I want to discuss some issues related to Occult with her. Please excuse me. As researcher academics, we got excited halfway through research and came here without a second thought... ” Fang Heng explained awkwardly, “We just... forgot to take the hour into consideration... ”

Butler Sun had a suspicious look on his face, showing that he didn’t quite believe Fang Heng’s words. He mused, “You? A research academic? How could you possibly focus on studying when you keep entering and exiting the study every few hours? ”
Mo Jiawei quickly skipped over the matter and went forward to ask, “Butler Sun, where’s Ruoruo? ”

“Is she not in her room? ” Butler Sun was also a little puzzled. He walked forward, looked at the dark room, then answered as realization hit him, “Oh right, she asked me after dinner where the warehouse where the ores are stored is. She might still be in the warehouse now. I’ll bring you two there to take a look. ”
Butler Sun was also a little worried about Xiao Ruoruo’s safety, so he followed Fang Heng and Xiao Ruoruo to the warehouse.
In the backyard, the warehouse door was closed tightly.
Creak!
Pushing open the warehouse door, the three of them stood at the door at the same time.
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and narrowed his eyes slightly.
He turned his head to look at Mo Jiawei and cast a questioning gaze at him.
Not noticing Fang Heng’s gaze at all, Mo Jiawei had a shock-filled face.
In the center of the warehouse was Xiao Ruoruo, her toes less than 10 centimeters above the ground. She was suspended in the air.
A large amount of blue crystal raw ores was revolving around Xiao Ruoruo’s body rapidly.
Being able to use active skills outside the game was the most obvious characteristic of Tier 3 materialization!
Mo Jiawei was shocked. He turned his head and asked Fang Heng in a low voice, “What’s going on? ”
Fang Heng was speechless. “You’re asking me? ”
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth without saying a word.
He had a deep impression of Xiao Ruoruo, the girl who was very afraid of strangers.
Since she was young, she often stayed in Mo Yunxiao’s study.
Every time Mo Jiawei saw Xiao Ruoruo, she would lower her head and walk past him quickly.
After she grew up, the situation slightly improved.
It was the first time Mo Jiawei realized that Xiao Ruoruo was actually so capable.
Thud.
Xiao Ruoruo landed on the ground and opened her eyes, noticing the comers.
“You guys... Why are you here? ”
“Eh? You want to improve the potion? ”
In the living room, Xiao Ruoruo looked confused after listening to Fang Heng’s explanation of his wish to improve the potion.

“Fang Heng, improving the potion is a very difficult thing because the transformation method of potionology is not quite consistent... To improve the medicinal effect, alchemists would carry out a special purification of the medicinal ingredients... But from the perspective of potionology, most would... ”
Listening to the top student explain the potionology’s area of focus, Fang Heng suddenly felt drowsy.
At least Fang Heng still had some foundation in potionology. Mo Jiawei was confused, and his eyelids were twitching.
In less than two minutes, Mo Jiawei directly fell asleep on the couch beside him.

“Hint: you have had a discussion with Xiao Ruoruo about potionology, alchemy, and Occult. As a result, you’ve gained some knowledge. You have gained 33 basic potionology skill experience points and 55 basic occult skill experience points. ”
“What’s going on? ! Both my basic potionology skill experience points and basic occult skill experience points have increased? ! ”
The sudden game hint had woken Fang Heng up.
It was rare to see a game hint outside of the game.
For a moment, Fang Heng’s couldn’t take his eyes off Xiao Ruoruo.
It was all too weird!
He had communicated with Mo Yunxiao about Occult before. Why hadn’t there been such a hint before? Why hadn’t he received any skill experience points before?
“Fang Heng? Is there something on my face? ”
Xiao Ruoruo noticed Fang Heng’s gaze, and her face flushed slightly. She couldn’t help but lower her head.
Fang Heng was shocked and asked, “It’s a game hint! Didn’t you receive it? ”

“Ah? ” Xiao Ruoruo was surprised for a moment, and then her expression dimmed. Without raising her head, she muttered softly, “I’m sorry, Fang Heng, I haven’t been honest with you. Actually, I’m demi-human. ”
“So that’s how it is... She’s demi-human, ” mused Fang Heng. His heart was pounding.
Demi-humans were one of the minorities in the game. They were the product of a human and an NPC.
Demi-humans had the dual attribute of NPCs and players. They were born in the game, but they had the ability to leave the game and enter the real world.
Demi-humans could avoid many risks of the game. They could directly bring all their abilities in the game out of the game, and they would not be subjected to the majority of the game’s punishments!

But similarly, they did not have part of the special abilities that players had. The most common examples were demi-humans who did not have a game backpack, could not accept missions, could not view personal information, and could not receive game hints.
The Federation had strict control over the demi-humans.
Under the Federation’s deliberate exaggeration, the demi-humans were regarded as monsters that were extremely dangerous existences in the game.
In a more advanced world, there was a group of anti-federation forces made up of demi-humans. They had once brought great trouble to the Federation!
“T-There’s no need to be sorry. I’m just a little surprised, ” responded Fang Heng.
Xiao Ruoruo timidly raised her head and looked at Fang Heng. “Then... Fang Heng, aren’t you afraid of me? ”
“Hmm? Afraid? Are you very scary? ”
Xiao Ruoruo became even more uneasy. “N-No... ”
“Then, all’s good. What’s there to be afraid of? ” Fang Heng was simple-minded. He walked over, casually picked up a book on the table, and quickly put it into his game backpack.
“Look, you now know my secret, while I know yours. With this, we can be considered good friends, right? ”
“Yes! ” Xiao Ruoruo felt relieved. A smile reappeared on her face as she nodded in response.
“Right, I heard that demi-humans can’t use the game cabin. How do you enter and exit the game? ”
“That... ” Xiao Ruoruo hesitated.
“Is it a secret? Then it’s okay. Forget that I asked. ”
“It’s not a secret, but Fang Heng, don’t tell anyone. ” Xiao Ruoruo reached out her hand and turned the back of her hand toward Fang Heng.
“We demi-humans enter and exit the game through this mark. ”
As Xiao Ruoruo spoke, a faint red mark appeared on the back of her fair hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - Mark Teleportation
paragraphs: Fang Heng’s pupils constricted when he saw the mark on the back of Xiao Ruoruo’s hand. He thought, “It’s a mark similar to mine! ”
“Don’t move yet, ” Fang Heng said as he aligned the back of his hand with Xiao Ruoruo’s.
The mark on the back of his hand emitted a weak white light.
“Eh? ” Xiao Ruoruo covered her mouth in surprise and carefully looked at Mo Jiawei, who was lying asleep on the couch.
She lowered her voice and said, “Fang Heng, why do you have a mark too? Could it be that you are also... ” Xiao Ruoruo looked at Fang Heng with a burning gaze.
From the moment she first saw Fang Heng, Xiao Ruoruo had felt a strange sense of closeness to him.
It would explain the feeling if Fang Heng was also a demi-human.
“No, I don’t think so. ” Fang Heng searched the memory of the body he was in and confirmed that he was not a demi-human.
“But... ” Xiao Ruoruo hesitated.
She carefully leaned over and carefully compared the marks on their hands.
Though they were not the same, a large part of the patterns was extremely similar!
“But this part of the mark is very similar to us demi-humans’. ” Xiao Ruoruo raised her head, her eyes filled with doubt. “Fang Heng, how did the mark on your hand form? ”
“I forgot, I really forgot. I can’t remember the origin of this mark at all. ”
Fang Heng also had a headache. He smiled bitterly and explained, “I’ve been learning Occult to solve this mystery. ”
“Yes, I believe in you, Fang Heng. ”
Fang Heng scratched his hair in distress.
It was getting more and more confusing.
Taking a deep breath, Fang Heng decided not to think about the marks for the time being. “Right, what were we talking about just now? ”
“Oh, we were talking about the special way demi-humans enter the game. We usually enter the game world with the strength of the mark. ”
As Xiao Ruoruo spoke, she raised her arm and extended her palm forward.
In an instant, a magic array appeared under Xiao Ruoruo’s feet.
“The teleportation process needs to last for 30 seconds. During this period, any disturbance will result in failure of teleportation into the game, ” Xiao Ruoruo explained and lowered her arm.
The magic array that was rotating slowly under her feet also disappeared.
“Through mark teleportation... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself.

“Wait. Right! When I activated the Tier 1 of the occult ritual, the game hint stated that I can enter and exit the game directly through the mark! Theoretically, I have the same ability. But how do I use it? ”
As Fang Heng had those thoughts, a line of small words immediately appeared on his retina.
Skill: occult ritual (binding soul seal).
Tier: Tier 1.
Skill description 1: after mastering this skill, you can synchronize your basic attribute ability and enter into the game world. Current synchronization rate: 100% .
Skill description 2: you can directly enter the game through the ritual seal.
Special ability 1 awakened through the soul seal: Outside the game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special Ability 2 awakened through the soul seal (Vampire Apocalypse) : you will not be affected by the distortion of the game world of Vampire Apocalypse. In Vampire Apocalypse, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special Ability 3 awakened through the soul seal (Zombie Apocalypse) : you will not be affected by the distortion of the game world of Zombie Apocalypse. In Zombie Apocalypse, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

“Fang Heng, you have the seal, so you should be able to teleport into the game world, right? Try it. You just need to focus and imagine a door in front of you. Try to open that door. ” Xiao Ruoruo looked at Fang Heng and encouraged him, “Good luck. ”
Hearing that, Fang Heng tried to imitate Xiao Ruoruo. He slowly raised his hand and closed his eyes.
“Imagine a door... ” he mused.
An ancient bronze door appeared in front of Fang Heng.
The bronze door was engraved with strange patterns, which resembled a palm.
“A zombie’s palm? ” Fang Heng was confused. He tried to follow Xiao Ruoruo’s instructions and open the door with his mind.
Swoosh.
A black formation instantly appeared under Fang Heng’s feet.
As the formation appeared, Xiao Ruoruo’s pupils suddenly constricted!
A powerful force emerged from the magic array, and she couldn’t help but take half a step back.
Screech, screech, screech!
Countless greenish-brown palms of rotting corpses shot out from the magic array, crazily moving upward and almost instantly wrapping Fang Heng!
In Xiao Ruoruo’s view, Fang Heng was currently wrapped up by countless twisted rotten arms, forming a human cocoon.
Bang!
In the next second, the cocoon shattered in front of her eyes, disappearing together with Fang Heng.
Xiao Ruoruo stood on the spot, recalling the scene she had just seen, her face filled with shock and confusion.
It was a total of 0.5 seconds.
Fang Heng had used the seal to enter the game world in just 0.5 seconds!
That was too abnormal!
Opening his eyes again, Fang Heng found himself in the King of Gods’ space.
“Hint: player has entered the game through the occult ritual for the first time. ”

“Hint: occult mark has an upper limit of 10 King of Gods’ space energy points. 1 energy point will be replenished every five hours. 1 King of Gods’ space energy points is consumed every time you enter the game. ”
“Hint: player can now choose to return to the game world, other mode, or the exchange store. ”
“Have I entered the game world? ” Fang Heng looked down at himself and tried to clench his fists.
Compared to the normal way of entering the game through the game cabin, there seemed to be no difference.
While Fang Heng had that thought, a line of small words appeared before his eyes.
“Hint: player, do you wish to quit the game? ”
“Quit! ”
He returned to the real world once again.
Appearing on the spot, Fang Heng tried to move his body.

It was pretty good. It was much more convenient than using the game cabin to log in and out of the game, especially in special situations where players outside the game cabin could not establish contact through the special hint function of the game cabin.
Fang Heng suddenly realized that such a kind of teleportation was also a pretty good life-saving skill.
If there was a sudden danger in the real world in the future, he could just hide in the game and tide over it!
Meanwhile, still in a daze, Xiao Ruoruo stared blankly at Fang Heng.
“What are you thinking about? “Fang Heng waved his hand in front of Xiao Ruoruo’s eyes.
“N-Nothing... ” Xiao Ruoruo came back to her senses. “Entering the game through a mark seems to be a special ability that only demi-humans have... ”
“Don’t bother thinking about it anymore. Maybe my ancestors were part of the demi-human bloodline. ”
Fang Heng shrugged, not pursuing the matter further. “Let’s return to the matter of improving the potion. ”
“Mhm, okay... ” Xiao Ruoruo nodded and got up to take a stack of white paper from the table beside her.
“I’m not sure if I can help. We can study the improvement of the potion together. ”
As Xiao Ruoruo spoke, she took out a piece of paper and spread it on the table.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - Perfecting the Formula
paragraphs: “Then let’s start with the composition of medicinal ingredients. In potionology, the decomposition analysis of medicinal ingredients is done in a special way. Do you remember the formula for the warlord potion? ”
“Yeah, I remember. I’ll write it. ”
Fang Heng listed the names of dozens of medicinal ingredients.
“Hint: your Intellligence points have reached over 15 points. You are able to use potionology for the decomposition analysis of potions... ”
“Hint: Xiao Ruoruo has imparted teachings of potionology to you. Your skill of basic potionology has gained 347 experience points and increased to level 4. ”
Two and a half hours later, Xiao Ruoruo finished all the decomposition analysis and recomposition.
“Mhm, it’s done. ”
Xiao Ruoruo wiped the sweat on the tip of her nose.
“Fang Heng, take a look. ”
Fang Heng leaned over and took out the list.
“Hint: you and Xiao Ruoruo have completed the modification-cum-recomposition of the warlord potion. You have come up with the new potion formula (incomplete) . You can name the formula. ”
“Modified warlord potion. ”
“Hint: you have completed the preliminary structure of the modified warlord potion. You have gained 788 experience points in potionology. ”
“Hint: your potionology level has upgraded to level 5. ”
“Awesome! Xiao Ruoruo, you’ve been a great help! ” Fang Heng was in a great mood after completing the modified potion.
Xiao Ruoruo’s face flushed red. “No, not really... I still need to make some minor adjustments to the composition of the ingredients. The specific formula is not considered complete yet. ”
“It’s already very impressive! I’ll just go back to the game to test and perfect the formula. You’ve been a great help to me. I’m in a hurry today. I’ll bring you some delicious food next time. ”
“Okay. Keep your word, Fang Heng. ”
Fang Heng hurriedly got up, bade farewell, and quickly left the living room.
Phew.
Seeing Fang Heng leave the room in a hurry, Xiao Ruoruo wiped the sweat on her forehead.

Doing decomposition analysis and recomposition on a medicinal formula had consumed a lot of her energy. However, Xiao Ruoruo still felt very happy that she could help her good friend whom she had just met.
Thud, thud.
Mr. Sun knocked on the door and walked into the room. He glanced at Mo Jiawei who was still sleeping soundly on the couch.
“Ruoruo, you must be very tired. Your body is not suitable for staying up so late. There’s no need to tire yourself so badly. ”
Xiao Ruoruo smiled. “It’s all right, Mr. Sun. Fang Heng is my good friend. I’m very happy to be able to help him. ”
Mr. Sun sighed in his heart.
He wanted to say something but stopped.
“All right. It’s late. Go and rest. ”
“Hint: player has failed to produce a potion sample. Some of the ingredients have been damaged and can not be used anymore. ”
“Hint: player has failed to complete the formula! ”
“Sh*t! I failed again! ”
In the warehouse in-game, Fang Heng cursed in a rather displeased manner.
Making a potion sample was much more difficult than he had imagined.
The final step of perfecting the formula required a more precise allocation of the ingredients. Ordinary players would need to spend a month or two to master the formula.
Fang Heng was clueless about potion theory and did not know how to calculate the proportions, so he tried a few times based on feeling.
Unsurprisingly, it ended in failure.
Fang Heng scratched his head.
“Whatever! I might as well use the stupidest method of trial and error. There’re enough zombie teams and medicinal ingredients to test out one by one. ”
Fang Heng was a little irritated. He turned around and glanced at the dozen or so potioneers in the room.
Noticing Fang Heng’s gaze, the potioneers who were on standby felt a chill in their hearts.
As fellow potioneers, they knew that consecutive failure in potion making put potioneers in a bad mood.
With an unfriendly tone, Fang Heng commanded, “Hey, you guys, prepare the ingredients needed to make the potion. As per this formula, make hundreds of different dosage combinations... ”
The potioneers took the potion formula from Fang Heng and looked at it. They were stunned at first, then they started to discuss it together.

“So, Fang Heng has been trying to develop a new formula for the warlord potion all this while. How amazing! It’s only been a night, yet he’s already managed to modify the ingredient composition like that.
The potioneers gathered together and looked at the formula given by Fang Heng, all amazed.
In the formula, some of the changes could be considered as a stroke of genius!
“A new formula? ”
“Amazing, it can be modified like this. I didn’t expect there to be such a method. ”
“But can these two ingredients still be combined? ”
“Indeed, they can. Look at this... ”
The potioneers discussed in low voices. From time to time, they would sneak a glance at Fang Heng.
“Hint: your ability of potion making has gained the recognition and respect of the potioneers. ”
“Hint: your reputation points in the Scavenger Army have increased significantly. ”
“Hint: potioneers’ loyalty to the Scavenger Army has increased slightly. ”
“Hint: Potioneer Harley is in awe of you... ”
Fang Heng looked at the game hints that flashed and the potioneers that were in constant discussion, and his mind immediately buzzed.

“Good heavens, I’m treating you guys as tools to sort medicinal ingredients. What are you all discussing? It’s not like I can bring you back to District 8 to make potions. I don’t care about your recognition and respect, ” thought Fang Heng.
Cough, cough!
Fang Heng coughed heavily, interrupting the conversation of the potioneers.
“Hey, you guys, hurry up and start concocting the potions! ”
The potioneers respected and feared Fang Heng at the same time. Hearing his order, they immediately stopped their discussion and began to make potions.
Fang Heng controlled zombie clones to start making potions through trial and error.
Channeling bar after channeling bar appeared above the zombie clones’ heads, and game hint after game hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: your zombie clone failed to make the potion... ”
“Hint: your zombie clone failed to make the potion... ”
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed the production of modified warlord potion sample. Current potion quality: C. ”
“Hint: you have perfected the potion formula of modified warlord potion. ”

“Hint: during the process of perfecting the potion formula, you have gained a new understanding of potionology. Your skill of basic potion making has upgraded. You have gained the new skill of intermediate potion making. ”

“Finally... It’s done! After 157 consecutive failures, there’s finally a zombie clone that’s completed the sample making and perfected the potion formula! Trial and error is indeed the best! I’ve even gained the new skill of intermediate potion making! ” Fang Heng let out a sigh in his heart. He took out the bottle of freshly made potion and held it in his hand to observe.
Item: modified warlord potion.
Quality: C.

Description: after being concocted with a special method, the warlord potion’s stimulation effects has increased. After a user consumes it, in a short period of time, their various attributes, as well as effects such as HP recovery, vitality recovery, rapid energy recovery, and regeneration of severed limbs, will greatly increase (only effective for players or NPCs who have taken the divine potion).
Creator: Fang Heng.
“Success! Let’s look at the skill... ” Fang Heng’s eyes sparkled with excitement. He opened and observed the skill panel.
Skill: intermediate potion making.

Description: Intellligence + 1. You can make potions according to the formula. The success rate of potion making will be increased. There is a chance to make a potion with a higher effect. The probability is related to the skill level.
Description: this skill can be upgraded to level 30 and can not exceed the player’s current level. (after the skill is maxed out, you can try to upgrade the skill) .

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - Improved Effects
paragraphs: Compared to basic potion making, the upper limit of intermediate potion making was level 30. There was also an additional 1 intelligence point bonus and the possibility of making potions with high-level effects.
“Not bad! ” Fang Heng was satisfied.
He put away the potion and looked around the warehouse.
Next, he could set up the production line!
There were still three hours until daybreak, and he would produce a mass amount of potions.
Fang Heng shifted his gaze to the potioneers in the corner who had gathered together and were clicking their tongues in admiration.
“Everyone, please help. ”
The dozen or so potioneers immediately stopped their conversation.
Seeing Fang Heng’s burning gaze, they immediately recalled the previous experience of staying up all night to sort medicinal ingredients, their legs turning weak.
Fang Heng smiled. “I’ll have to trouble all of you to sort the medicinal ingredients. ”
First was the distribution of the ingredients. Fang Heng would have the zombie team help him move boxes of the ingredients to the potioneers.
Then, the potioneers would sort the ingredients into sets.
After that, the zombie team would move the sorted ingredients and pack them according to the potion grade.
It was the perfect arrangement he thought of.
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed the production of the modified warlord potion. Current quality: D. ”
“Hint: you have gained 4 intermediate potion making skill experience points. ”
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed... ”
Game hints kept refreshing.
Looking at the preliminarily completed production line, Fang Heng felt a sense of satisfaction.

“No, wait! There’s still room for improvement in the production line. I can make some minor adjustments to speed up the efficiency. ” Fang Heng rubbed his chin and started to carefully study the production line.
Some of the ingredients wouldn’t be damaged after failure, so he couldn’t waste them. He had to open a new production line where the zombies would send suck ingredients back to be re-sorted.

“How should I go about doing it? Hmm... I know! I just have to change this part! Also, the zombies’ movements affect one other, so I’ll have to rearrange the layout of the production line. No, no, this doesn’t work. I’ll have to rearrange it, ” thought Fang Heng.
As the production line was set up again and again, the refresh rate of the game log was constantly increasing.
Fang Heng drank bottles of coffee, enjoying himself.
The next day, the sun was shining brightly.
The warehouse door was pulled open with a swoosh.
Two Scavenger Army elites stood at the entrance of the warehouse, carefully sizing up the interior of the warehouse.
Without Fang Heng’s permission, they would not dare to enter the warehouse.
The night before, there was a rumor that spread throughout the entire Edge Creek Town.

It was said that the warehouse was densely packed with Lickers controlled by Fang Heng and that a person who had barged into the warehouse without thinking was eaten by the Lickers until nothing was left of them.
Later on, Roche came out to refute the rumor.
If anyone entered the warehouse and disturbed Fang Heng, even if they weren’t eaten by the Lickers, they would probably have their legs broken and then thrown out to feed the zombies.
The two stood at the door and shouted toward the dim warehouse, “Commander Fang, are you there? Roche and Osborne have been waiting for you for more than half an hour. ”

“Eh? What? It’s already dawn? ” Inside the warehouse, Fang Heng, who was counting the medicinal ingredients, came back to his senses when he heard the shout outside the door. He subconsciously gulped down a mouthful of coffee.
“It’s a pity that there are still many medicinal ingredients left to be sorted... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself. He then shouted, “Come in and help me drive the trucks out. ”
“Yes! ” The two Scavenger Army elites carefully walked into the warehouse.
After staying up all night, the potioneers’ and NPCs’ eyes were bloodshot, and they all looked relieved.
Finally, they could rest!
Fang Heng walked out of the warehouse.
Outside the door, Roche and Osborne were waiting for him.
Osborne walked forward and asked, “Fang Heng, how’s the potion making? Several regions are pressing for it. They are under a lot of pressure and urgently need supplies of it. ”
“Everything is under control. ” Fang Heng nodded and gestured behind him.
Soon, a few trucks filled with big boxes drove out of the warehouse.
“The potions have already been loaded onto the back of the trucks. ”
“Okay! ” Osborne’s eyes lit up. He jumped up and boarded one of the large trucks, then took out one of the bottles of potion to check.
As soon as the potion was in his hand, Osborne frowned slightly. “Hmm? ”
He thought, “Why’s the color of the potion a little different? It has a slight yellow color. ”

“It’s a normal phenomenon. ” Facing Osborne’s gaze, Fang Heng casually waved his hand and explained, “The effectiveness of the first-generation warlord potion is not the highest. I made some minor adjustments. This is an improved version with better effects. ”
“Improved? ! ” Inwardly, Osborne was even more surprised. “Fang Heng found a way to improve the warlord potion that was personally developed by the founder of the Scavenger Army, Cook Barn? ”
“Haha! Fang Heng! You are really good! ” Osborne exclaimed.
Meanwhile, Roche did not have as many thoughts as Osborne. He was even a little dissatisfied with Osborne’s dawdling. He urged, “Osborne, quickly give me a bottle to taste! ”
Osborne secretly cursed Roche for being an idiot. He directly threw the potion in his hand at Roche.
Gulp, gulp.
Roche took the potion, unscrewed the lid without hesitation, and directly raised his head to pour all of the potion down his throat.
Roche was stunned as the potion greatly stung his tongue. As he felt a warm current flowing down his throat, his entire body went through a transformation.
Creak, creak...
Roche clenched his fist so hard that it made a creaking sound. The blood vessels in his pupils became apparent, making his eyes appear bloodshot, and blue veins appeared faintly under his skin.
Crash!
Roche crushed the bottle in his hand.
“Hahaha! The effects are awesome! ”
Roche turned around and looked at Fang Heng with a fervent gaze. “Fang Heng! I want this kind of potion! The more the better! ”
“Is it really that powerful? ” thought Osborne, puzzled. He then also gulped down the warlord potion.
The potion was like a ball of fire that instantly flowed through his entire body!

Osborne clenched his fists and felt a surge of strength flowing into his limbs. There seemed to be an endless amount of strength in his body. An impulse to destroy everything rose from the bottom of his heart.
He was not sure about its effects in actual battle, but from the bottom of his heart, Osborne felt that the warlord potion had improved by at least 50% compared to before!
At the same time, the bloodthirsty impulse had also increased significantly compared to before!
Taking a deep breath, Osborne forcefully suppressed the bloodthirsty impulse in his heart and used his bloodshot eyes to look at Fang Heng.

His eyes were filled with astonishment as he mused, “How did he do it? First, he produced a large number of warlord potions, and now, a day later, he improved the potion’s effects... This young man would completely change our army! ”
Fang Heng asked, “How is it? ”
“Very good. ” Osborne confirmed with Fang Heng, “Are you sure that the potion doesn’t have any negative effects? ”
“At least, we didn’t find any during the testing. ”
“F*ck, you’re so troublesome. Who cares about the negative effects? It’s best if you don’t want potions. We’ll use them! ”
As Roche spoke, he secretly winked at Fang Heng and waved his hand. “Brothers, this truck’s potions are ours! ”

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Ready for Battle
paragraphs: “Roar!”
Hearing this, the members of the Scavenger Army behind Roche started to cheer. They rushed to the back of the truck and started to carry the potions.
Osborne revealed a rare bitter smile.

“F*ck, don’t give me this nonsense.” Roche spat on the ground and waved his hand. “Brothers, two truckloads of the best quality goods are enough. Leave some for the others.”

Cheng Ya and the other two were rushing back with the logs on their shoulders.
Hearing the roars coming from Edge Creek Town, they looked at one another.
Wei Chun frowned and asked, “Did something happen?”
Last night, they received an emergency order from Roche, which required them to go out and collect a large number of logs in a short period.
They thought it was a special mission, so they moved the logs overnight.
“I’m not sure. It might be related to the logs we collected.” Cheng Ya lowered her head and thought, “You go offline and report to your superiors first. We’ll wait and see...”
At the Dragon Country Gaming Union base.
Having suffered two consecutive defeats, the morale of the alliance forces of the major player companies in District 7 had almost fallen to the bottom.
The atmosphere in the conference hall was unusually solemn.
Tian Zhen was silent.
They had been extremely shocked by the large number of Tyrant forms and Lickers they had encountered last night.
How long had Fang Heng been in District 7?
He had thought that Fang Heng would be weak for a while after entering Division 7.
However, he didn’t expect that the zombie team controlled by Fang Heng would become even stronger!
Tian Zhen thought hard for an entire night, but couldn’t think of a way to deal with Fang Heng.
The other people could only think of schemes and tricks to temporarily hinder Fang Heng’s development.
As long as they couldn’t completely deal with Fang Heng’s zombie team, they couldn’t threaten Fang Heng.
That was secondary.
What Tian Zhen was really afraid of was Fang Heng’s growth speed!
It was too fast!
The last time he saw Fang Heng’s video, Fang Heng could only control a small number of Lickers and a Tyrant form.
His combat power was considered strong among the player, but he was easy to deal with.
However, in just half a month, the number of Lickers that Fang Heng could control had turned into a large number, along with over twenty Tyrant forms...
If he was given another half a month...
Tian Zhen did not dare to think about it.
After thinking hard for an entire night, a thought suddenly appeared in his mind.
How about... surrendering?
Once this thought appeared, it lingered in Tian Zhen’s mind.
In the world of adults, benefits came first.
Surrendering was shameful, but it was useful.
At the very least, he would not suffer a greater loss.
Tian Zhen raised his head.
He noticed that many players in the guild were also exchanging glances with one another.
It seemed that everyone had been scared by the battle last night.
Just as Tian Zhen had guessed, many player guilds had already begun to think about quitting.
After two defeats, it was a huge loss for the guilds.
“Commander Tian! Good news!”
Outside the conference hall, a deputy commander of the game guilds hurriedly pushed open the door, interrupting everyone’s thoughts.
Everyone’s eyes were focused on him.
“What good news?”
“It’s the Federation! The Federation has announced it to the public!”

“To protect the people’s safety, the Federation has decided to join forces with the major player guilds in District 7 to deal with the Scavenger Army. They have also temporarily placed Fang Heng on the list of dangerous players and publicly called for Fang Heng to withdraw from the Scavenger Army.”
The player looked excited as he panted and said, “If Fang Heng is unwilling to withdraw, the Federation may take coercive measures...”
Everyone was stunned.
The Federation was going to participate in the battle?!
This way...
“Alright!”
This news caused Niu Xia, whose heart was half-dead, to resurrect on the spot.
He stood up abruptly.
“With the pressure from the Federation, Fang Heng will be in big trouble this time.”
The hall regained its vitality.
“Also, the Federation just sent us a message that their support team will arrive at the Edge Creek Town area in the afternoon and participate in the battle against the Scavenger Army.”
Seeing that the team was on the verge of collapse, the news of the Federation joining the team gave the players a shot in the arm and ignited their fighting spirit once again.
With the participation of the Federation, their overall strength would inevitably see a great improvement!
“Great! With the Federation taking care of the Scavenger Army together, our chances of winning are even greater!”
“The Federation has high-level heavy weapons, so it shouldn’t be much of a problem to deal with the Tyrant form controlled by Fang Heng.”
“Not only that, but I’ve also heard that the Federation has a special injection specifically for dealing with the Scavenger Army, and it works with a single hit...”
“Really? There’s such a thing?”
The players once again began to discuss fervently, as if with the addition of the Federation, they could turn the tide in one fell swoop.
Tian Zhen was silent.
The Federation had officially joined as well...
He had previously fought with the commander of District 7, Kou Huai, and he knew very well that he was an extremely difficult character to deal with.
Kou Huai must have also sensed the threat from Fang Heng.
The players were discussing excitedly when the door to the conference room hall was suddenly pushed open from outside.
“Commander Tian! They are coming to attack us!”
Tian Zhen’s pupils constricted.
“Coming to attack us? Who are they? Speak clearly!”
The player adjusted his breathing and said in a deep voice, “It’s the Scavenger Army! Roche has led a team to attack our shelter. They are expected to arrive in five minutes!”
The entire conference room fell silent again.
Tian Zhen looked around the hall and a surge of anger rose from the bottom of his heart.
They actually came knocking on his door?
Did they really think they were pushovers?!
“Everyone, follow me! Let’s fight!”

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - Ascension
paragraphs: In the suburban wasteland area.
Two large trucks drove into the town occupied by the Scavenger Army.
The commander of the military district, Lei Ming, led the members of the Scavenger Army to welcome them in the town’s central square.
The eyes of the members of the army were filled with incomparable eagerness.
“Osborne, you are three days behind the scheduled time.”
Osborne jumped down from the passenger seat.

“I’ve tried my best. The front line is in a dire situation. You know our current situation. The other areas are the same. I know you’re in a critical situation. I’ll send these two batches of potions to you immediately.”
“Cheh!”
Lei Ming waved his hand to signal his subordinates to move the goods. He gritted his teeth and said, “If you were two days late, you could have come directly to collect our corpses.”

As usual, Osborne had a stern face and said word by word, “Lei Ming, I believe that your strength is not limited to this. Also, I have good news for you. This time, I brought you an additional half-truck of potions.”
“Hmph.”
Lei Ming snorted lightly.
After getting an additional half-truck of warlord potions, the displeasure in his heart eased a little.
“By the way, what happened to that Fang Heng recently? How did he rise to the rank of regional chief commander so quickly?”

“It was specially approved by Commander Cook Barn. Fang Heng produced a large number of warlord potions in a short period to alleviate the crisis on the front line. In addition, these potions in your hands were all made with Fang Heng’s help.”
“A potion maker?”
Lei Ming pursed his lips and a feeling of dissatisfaction rose from his heart.
They fought to the death on the front line but in the end, they were worse off than a potion maker!
How unpleasant!
“Brother Lei!”
While they were talking, a team member who was carrying the goods jumped down from the truck and handed a bottle of warlord potion to Lei Ming.
“Brother Lei, the potion doesn’t seem right.”
Lei Ming took the potion and looked at it in his hand, his face darkening.
“Osborne! What does this mean?”
“It’s a modified version of the warlord potion. Fang Heng, whom you mentioned just now, was the one who made it.”
Osborne explained expressionlessly, “Tell your men to hurry up and unload the goods. I still have a few more to run. There was a problem with the transport truck yesterday. I’m in a hurry.”
“D*mn it! Are you kidding me?”
Lei Ming stared at Osborne fiercely.
“Are you trying to trick me with defective goods? Is that why you gave me more than half a box of potions?”
“I don’t have the time.” Osborne frowned. “Do you want it? If you don’t unload the goods, we’ll leave now.”
“Wait! I’ll try the effect first.”
Lei Ming stopped Osborne. Just as he was about to test the effect of the potion himself, gunshots sounded outside the town.
A member of the Scavenger Army shouted, “Brother Lei! Someone is attacking the base!”
Osborne and Lei Ming were stunned at the same time.
“F*ck! You’re courting death!” Lei Ming’s eyes turned red as he shouted, “Bring the potion with you! Fight alongside me!”
The base was suddenly attacked. Lei Ming didn’t care whether the potion provided by Osborne was defective or not. He picked up a bottle of potion, opened the cap and gulped it down.
As the potion flowed down his throat, a warm current instantly flowed into his limbs and bones!
Lei Ming’s pupils constricted!
The feeling was completely different from when he drank the warlord potion in the past!
In the past, the potion would give rise to a fighting desire that would gradually increase. In contrast, the new potion made one extremely violent!
He felt a violent force entering his body intensely.
“This... !”
Lei Ming turned around to look at Osborne, his eyes filled with bloodthirsty killing intent.
Osborne was expressionless as he looked back calmly.
“How is it?”
“Hahaha! Good! Good!!”
Lei Ming said as he gulped down several bottles of warlord potions in one go!
The veins on his neck bulged and his skin revealed a scarlet blood colour.
With a machete in one hand, Lei Ming laughed wildly, “Brothers! Take the potions and kill these intruders with me!”
“Roar!”
The members of the Scavenger Army gulped down the warlord potions which had been modified by Fang Heng.
In an instant, the entire Scavenger Army fell into an extremely frantic bloodthirsty state.
It was as if they were delirious and wild. They roared and joined the battlefield outside.
Soon, the Federation players who were attacking the Scavenger Army base noticed something strange about the enemy.
In the early hours of last night, all the Federation shelters in District 7 received the mobilization order from the command centre of District 7.

Federation Shelter No. 9 was all mobilized. They wanted to wipe out the Scavenger Army’s base in the suburban wasteland area in one fell swoop. They wanted to fight a beautiful victory and show their faces in front of their leaders.
But they did not expect that the Scavenger Army today was completely different from the sickly look they had in the past!
The soldiers of the Scavenger Army were all extremely excited. Their physical defense ability had directly improved by a level compared to two days ago!
Ordinary bullets could hardly stop their footsteps.
In less than ten minutes, the frontline positions set up by the Federation had been broken through by the Scavenger Army.
What was going on? How did their combat strength suddenly improve so quickly?
Seeing that the situation was not good, the federal commander immediately gave the order to retreat.
“The situation is not right! Retreat first!”
“Hahaha! Trying to escape!! Did you obtain my consent?”
Lei Ming was extremely excited, his eyes flashing with bloodthirsty killing intent.
“Ah!? Speak up! Did I agree to your escape?!”
“All of you, chase them! Kill them all!!!”
In the city, Osborne looked at the battlefield in front of him from afar.
Hearing the roars coming from his ears, Osborne could not help but feel a little aghast.
What did that Fang Heng do to the warlord potion?
Judging from the situation on the battlefield, the warlord potion had increased its effect by 40-60% from its original base!
The same situation was happening everywhere in the vicinity of Edge Creek Town.
The players from the Dragon Country Guild base were under great pressure from Roche’s attack.
The automatic cannons set up in the shelter kept shooting out tongues of fire.
Even so, they still managed to withstand the attack of the Scavenger Army with great difficulty.
Compared to yesterday, the Scavenger Army’s combat strength had increased significantly!
What was going on with this game?
How could the difficulty level increase again and again in just two days?
Was this all Fang Heng’s doing?!

Niu Xia was extremely shocked. He had even seen a high-level Scavenger Army elite fall to the ground after being hit by the range of the rocket launcher. A large part of the right side of his body, including his arm, had been blown off.
On the side, someone gave the Scavenger Army elite a mouthful of potion. The latter stood up and continued to join the battle.
Crazy!
They were no longer humans.
To a certain extent, they had become zombies...
The madness of the Scavenger Army made the players feel a sense of fear from the bottom of their hearts.
Behind the defensive fortifications, Tian Zhen led the player team to face the enemy.
On the surface, Tian Zhen looked extremely calm and gave orders in an organized manner. In reality, he was extremely nervous and uptight. His spirit had long been stretched to the limit!
For the time being, the shelter could still withstand the attack of the Scavenger Army by relying on the defensive facilities.
But...
There was still one major unsettling factor...
That was Fang Heng!
Until now, Fang Heng and his zombie team had not appeared yet!
Once the zombie team that they encountered last night joined the battle, their shelter would be lost!

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - Promotion
paragraphs: Due to the two-day teleportation time limit, Fang Heng was forced to return to District 8.
The research institute in District 8 was 100% operational and all the researchers were extremely busy.
Fang Heng originally wanted to ask Qiu Yaokang about the research and development of the first-generation meteorite but he didn’t manage to find him.

After asking around, he found out that there was a breakthrough in the research of the first-generation meteorite. Qiu Yaokang was invited to the Dark Knights to host a seminar on the first-generation meteorite.

He felt a sense of helplessness and decide to wait until the repair of the teleportation device was completed. In the meantime, Fang Heng would return to District 7 first. He planned to ask about the first-generation meteorite the next time he came back.
After a period of delay, it was already three o’clock in the afternoon when he returned to District 7.
The moment Fang Heng opened his eyes, a dense number of game hints rapidly refreshed in the lower right corner of his retina.
It took a full minute to complete the entire process.

[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie team has completed making warlord potion (changed)*2315. You have gained 5876 experience points from potion making. Your skill-intermediate potion making has been upgraded to Level 18. You have reached the current upper limit. Please upgrade your character level promptly.]

[Hint: The warlord potion you are researching has been approved by the regional commander of the Scavenger Army, Lei Ming. Your friendship with Lei Ming has increased. Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has increased!]
[Hint: You have received the approval of some members of the Scavenger Army.]
[Hint: Due to the help of your potion, the Scavenger Army has obtained control of the South City area. Your reputation value has increased...]

[Hint: The warlord potion you researched and produced has been approved by the regional commander of the Scavenger Army, Qin Qing. Your friendship with Qin Qing has increased. Your reputation value in the Scavenger Army has increased.]
[Hint: The warlord potion you researched and produced...]
[Hint: Lei Ming has occupied some of the town strongholds in the South City, and has nominated you as the regional commander of the South City.]
[Hint: Because you are offline, your vote is considered to be a forfeit.]
[Hint: Osborne has voted in favour.]
[Hint: Lei Ming has voted in favour...]
[Hint: Your nomination has been approved by a majority of votes above the rank of regional commander in the Scavenger Army.]
What the hell!
Fang Heng was in a hurry. He opened the game log and flipped back to read the game hints again.
After reading through, Fang Heng fell into a short silence.
“What does this mean? I got promoted?”
Fang Heng was about to ask Roche about the situation.
Walking out of the warehouse, Osborne was waiting outside the door early.
“Fang Heng, I was just looking for you.”

Osborne spent a lot of effort distributing the improved version of the warlord potions that Fang Heng had made to the regional branches of the Scavenger Army in the surrounding area. He had just returned to Edge Creek Town not long ago.
Although physically and mentally exhausted, Osborne’s spirit was very good.
The effect of the warlord potion made by Fang Heng was amazing!
In just half a day, the Scavenger Army gained a great advantage in the battle with the survivors. They directly declared that they had occupied three small-sized areas and one medium-sized area!
The morale of the entire Scavenger Army was at its peak.
“What? Am I in trouble again?”

“No, it’s a good thing. The regional commander, Lei Ming, has occupied the southern area of the city. Commander Cook has decided to build a large stronghold with this southern area as the centre. Together with the nine small-sized areas in the surrounding area, they will push forward together. You were elected by the regional commanders to be the leader of the southern area, the chief commander.”
“Half an hour ago, this appointment was personally passed down by Commander Cook Barn.”

[Hint: Your rank in the Scavenger Army and your reputation in the Scavenger Army have reached the requirements of a regional commander. You have also reached more than half of the votes through the election. You have become the regional chief commander of the southern area of the city.]
[Hint: You have obtained the command authority of Edge Creek Town, the suburban wasteland area, the Yellow Port area, the Wanlin Factory area, and so on.]
[Hint: You have obtained 50 high-level Scavenger Army members, 100 middle-level Scavenger Army members and 300 Scavenger Army members.]
A row of game hints flashed across Fang Heng’s vision.
He had been promoted...
But he seemed to be a mole in the Dark Knights?
Fang Heng was a little confused for a moment.
He tried to clear his mind and glanced at the main storyline mission in the mission panel about finding a way to get in touch with Cook Barn.
“Osborne, when can I meet Commander Cook?”

“The situation is urgent. You need to immediately head to the South City district to take up your post. Also, the personnel assigned to you have been prepared. After the construction of the South City district has come to an end, you can report the situation to Commander Cook at any time.”
“In addition, according to Commander Cook’s instructions, you will be in charge of the warlord potion making mission in the South City district. I will also accompany you as the logistics commander.”
Osborne said as he looked at the warehouse behind Fang Heng.
“So the most important thing for us now is to escort these materials back to the South City district. When can we set off?”
Fang Heng smiled bitterly in his heart.
At first, he did want to quickly get promoted and complete the mission.
But he did not expect it to suddenly become so fast.
“Fang Heng, there are still some production benches and pharmaceutical staff in the warehouse. Do you want to bring them back together?”
“Yes, okay. Send the things in the warehouse back first. Take all the pharmaceutical staff with you!”
“Okay, I’ll go and get ready now.”
Fang Heng scratched his hair and fell into deep thought.
At the headquarters of the Federation in District 7, Kou Huai received the latest battle reports in his hands.
Why did this happen?!
Kou Huai’s mood was extremely heavy.
The strength of the Scavenger Army had greatly increased overnight!
There was an unconfirmed report that the Scavenger Army had improved the special potion, and their strength had greatly increased.
Why?
How could it be such a coincidence?!
Fang Heng!
Everything was related to him?
Kou Huai felt that his judgment was not wrong.
“Dong Dong Dong...”
“Please come in.”
A soldier walked into the command room with a heavy expression and handed over the file in his hand.
“Sir, the latest intelligence from the Scavenger Army is about Fang Heng.”
It was Fang Heng again!
What action did he take this time!
Kou Huai’s heart skipped a beat.
“Put down the report, you can leave first.”
“Roger!”
Kou Huai’s expression was solemn.
He waited until the soldier closed the door before flipping open the report.
After reading the contents of the report clearly, Kou Huai stood up abruptly.
Regional chief commander!
Fang Heng was promoted to regional chief commander by the Scavenger Army?!
Kou Huai had once collected all the information related to the Scavenger Army.
Among the ranks of the Scavenger Army, the highest rank was the commander of the army, Cook Barn, followed by seven regional chief commanders!
Now, Fang Heng was the eighth member!
Fang Heng could increase his contribution within the Scavenger Army to become regional chief commander in such a short time?!

To be promoted to the regional chief commander, in addition to the player contribution points needed to be raised to an extremely high level, one also required a lot of prestige and even needed to win the votes of other commanders.
Only after going through many trials could one succeed.
He actually did it...
Kou Huai took a deep breath.
His evaluation of Fang Heng was already extremely high, but he did not expect Fang Heng to once again exceed his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - Ambushed
paragraphs: That’s right, this could explain it.
The large increase in the strength of the Scavenger Army must have been related to Fang Heng, which was why Fang Heng’s contribution to the Scavenger Army increased so quickly.
Kou Huai adjusted his mood and sat down again.
He took out the map on the table and compared it.
“The regional commander of the South City district...”
“Fang Heng, you are indeed very powerful, but you made a mistake in this step, which is tantamount to digging your own grave.”
Kou Huai sneered in his heart and picked up the phone on the table.
“Xiao Chen, pass the message to find a way to mobilize the Dark Knights.”
“Yes!”
“Any feedback from the inspection team?”
“Sir, I heard that the inspection team has sent people to look for Fang Heng and communicate with him.”
[Hint: Your team has completed the gathering in the southern area of the city.]
[Hint: You have obtained 7273 Scavenger Army contribution points. You have obtained the authority to command the South City district.]
[Hint: The current defense of the city is Level 37. You can use contribution points to exchange for materials, guns, and other items to strengthen the defense of the city.]
[Hint: Player has triggered a mission: protect the city, clear the southern area of the city, kill, gather materials, recruit soldiers, make potions and other missions...]
Fang Heng spent a full day’s work until the evening before settling down in the small town in the South City district.
The subsequent series of missions refreshed, causing Fang Heng to have a headache.
He admitted that he was a spy for the Dark Knights, so he would not work so hard for the Scavenger Army...
Originally, Fang Heng had wanted to complete the main storyline mission as soon as possible, and find an opportunity to kill Cook Barn to complete the main storyline mission.
But now that the Federation was involved, the situation became unclear.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng decided to wait until tomorrow morning to think of a way to meet with Ai Lei of the Dark Knights to confirm the details of the next step in killing Cook Barn.
Let’s talk about it tomorrow!
Thinking of this, Fang Heng decided to go offline and prepare to have a good rest.
After getting out of the game cabin, Fang Heng went to the library in the backyard and prepared to bring the book back to the game world for the zombie clone to read.
In the study, Xiao Ruoruo was reading a book carefully.
Hearing the sound of the door being pushed open, Xiao Ruoruo turned her head and said in surprise, “Brother Fang Heng!”
“Hey, haven’t you rested yet?”
“It’s still early. I found something about the mark, so I came to check some information.”
Fang Heng was surprised, “Found something?”
“Yeah, show me the mark first.”
Hearing that, Fang Heng raised the back of his right hand.
Once he focused on the back of his hand, a rune immediately appeared on the back of his hand.
Ever since he activated the mark skill in the game, the rune on the back of his hand had become more complicated. It would take him a long time to draw it again.
Xiao Ruoruo compared the rune and opened a book to compare it with a certain pattern on it.
“Brother Fang Heng, look, are the patterns on the mark similar to this one?”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
This part of the mark was 90% similar!
“Right!”
“Right? When I saw it for the first time, I felt that it was a bit familiar. It took me a long time to recall it.”
“What does this pattern represent?”
“It’s related to the Nightmare Mirror. When I was young, I heard my grandmother say that with the strength of the Nightmare Mirror, we can freely travel through many unknown worlds.”
Xiao Ruoruo recalled bitterly and slowly narrated.
“Unfortunately, a long time ago, the Nightmare Mirror was destroyed and divided into pieces that were left in every corner of the world.”
“Later on, the Nightmare Demon used its special strength to completely devour a few pieces of the Nightmare Mirror. We completely lost the hope of opening the passage to other worlds.”
The Nightmare Mirror with the ability to teleport...
Fang Heng lowered his head and started thinking.
The world that Xiao Ruoruo was in was a higher-level Nightmare World.
Did the Nightmare Mirror that she mentioned correspond to the space tearing device of a lower-level game world?
But what did this have to do with the mark on the back of his hand?

Xiao Ruoruo’s mood was a little low. She continued, “After completely losing the Nightmare Mirror, apart from facing the nightmare crisis in this world, we also have to constantly be on guard against the impact of the lower-level worlds.”
Fang Heng was puzzled.
“The impact of the lower worlds? What is that?”

“Hmm...” Xiao Ruoruo thought for a moment. “I’m not too sure either. Grandmother addressed them this way. In my impression, whenever grandmother encountered a similar impact, she would always be very nervous.”

“However, in my impression, the abilities of those intruders are very ordinary. In most cases, they would die at the hands of the Nightmare Demon before we could even make a move. I also don’t quite understand the meaning of them entering our world.”
“Oh right, the person leading them is called the World Lord. Every time they invade, the World Lord would bring many players with similar special abilities to participate.”
Listening to Xiao Ruoruo’s description, Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
World Lord?!
Could it be...
Could it be that Xiao Ruoruo was referring to the player that had cleared a server’s main storyline mission?
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
After leaving the study, Fang Heng was a little sleepy. He prepared to return to his room early to sleep.
“Eh?”
Fang Heng had just passed through the stone bridge in the back garden. His sharp perception told him something.
He stopped and looked around vigilantly.
In front of him, a middle-aged man in black sportswear walked out from the dark shadows.
He had a sword hanging by his waist.
“Fang Heng?”
The middle-aged man’s gaze was focused on Fang Heng, sizing him up.
“Yes, you are?”
The middle-aged man was expressionless, and his tone was unusually cold.

“Meng Wu, a Grade 3 investigator of the Federation’s Investigation Team. Player Fang Heng is suspected of violating the Federation’s ban. We need you to come back with us to assist in the investigation.”
As he spoke, Meng Wu walked toward Fang Heng step by step.
The Federation came knocking on his door?
Fang Heng’s heart stirred. He took half a step back and touched his pocket.
There were a few small raw blue crystal ores in his pocket.
“What if I don’t want to?”
“Then I can only invite you over.”
As Meng Wu spoke, he lightly tapped his feet on the ground and suddenly accelerated!
His entire body was light as a feather as if he did not have any point of force. His body turned into a shadow and rapidly flew forward.
Fang Heng’s pupils instantly enlarged.
His high level of perception ability allowed him to capture Meng Wu’s entire movement.
“Shoo~!”
Fang Heng suddenly swung his hand forward, and the two ores in his hand flew towards Meng Wu in mid-air.
“Bang!!”
A white light flashed.
The two ores were cut into ashes by Meng Wu’s sword.
Fang Heng was stunned.
Weapon?
He was playing tricks, right?
Fang Heng didn’t say much. He clenched his fist and used all his strength to punch forward.
His fist created a strong wind in the air.
For the first time, a surprised expression flashed in Meng Wu’s eyes.
He was surprised at the strength of Fang Heng’s punch.
“Swoosh!!”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched, and he suddenly felt a figure in front of him blur.
The punch hit nothing but air.
Oh no!
It was a special skill!
A player with Tier 3 materialization!

“Brother Fang Heng!”
Xiao Ruoruo cried out in surprise.
She had just heard the sounds of fighting outside in the study and came out to take a look. Then, she saw the scene of Meng Wu pressing the hilt of his sword against Fang Heng’s throat.
“Who are you! Let go of him quickly!”
Xiao Ruoruo’s willowy eyebrows were vertical as she stared at Meng Wu.
Under the moonlight, the shadow behind Xiao Ruoruo started to shake rapidly.
Meng Wu glanced at Xiao Ruoruo and looked at Fang Heng again.
“I have no intention of expanding the conflict, and I have no intention of hurting anyone. Just follow me back for the investigation.”
“I can’t. I still have things to do. It will be very difficult for me to follow you back...”
As Fang Heng spoke, he slowly raised his hand toward the sky and made an ‘eight’ gesture.
Xiao Ruoruo understood the meaning of Fang Heng’s gesture.
In the next moment, Meng Wu’s pupils suddenly constricted.
A black magic array quickly circled under Fang Heng’s feet.
The aura that exploded from the magic array caused Meng Wu to take half a step back.
“What’s the situation?”
Meng Wu sensed an extremely powerful strength from the magic array and did not dare to approach it for a moment.

A greenish-white palm that was as rotten as a dead tree extended out from the magic array and rapidly grabbed at Fang Heng’s body. In the blink of an eye, Fang Heng was tightly wrapped, as if it wanted to drag Fang Heng into the magic array with it.
After tightly wrapping Fang Heng, several greenish-grey palms even grabbed at Meng Wu.
Meng Wu was shocked and immediately reacted.
Several sword shadows streaked across.
“Bang!!”
The greenish-grey palms and Fang Heng, who was trapped within, shattered before his eyes.
What was going on?
Was it an illusion?
Meng Wu was shocked once again.
“Roar!!!”
In the next second, the two abyssal monsters that Xiao Ruoruo controlled transformed into shadows and roared as they charged toward Meng Wu from the left and right.
“Nightmare Demons...”
Meng Wu looked at the two shadow creatures and whispered.
The two abyssal monsters opened their huge mouths and were about to swallow Meng Wu.
The sword light flashed!
The Nightmare Demon’s body was cut by Meng Wu’s sword, and the roaring Nightmare Demon was cut into two by the sword light.
Xiao Ruoruo formed a seal with both hands and shouted, “Split!”
“Boom! Boom!”
In the next instant, two abyssal monsters self-detonated in front of Meng Wu at the same time!

Meng Wu was affected by the explosion at a very close distance. His hands immediately blocked in front of him, but his body was still sent flying by the berserk force generated by the self-detonation!
Just as his body lost control in midair, Meng Wu felt an extremely strong sense of danger.
An extremely weak light flashed in front of him.
After disappearing for eight seconds, Fang Heng appeared out of thin air!
Fang Heng clenched his fist and faced Meng Wu, who was flying toward him from the front. He threw a punch at Meng Wu’s face.
“Boom!!!”
In midair, Meng Wu had no way to dodge. He was hit by Fang Heng’s punch head-on, and his entire body was sent flying. He crashed into the wall behind him.
Crack!!
The wall cracked like a spider web.
More than half of Meng Wu’s body was trapped in the wall.
Meng Wu breathed slowly.
After three breaths, Meng Wu’s breathing returned to normal.
He slowly raised his head.
Meng Wu’s entire face had been smashed into a bloody mess by this punch, but he still maintained his extreme calmness.
As the shrapnel fell, Meng Wu fell from the hole in the wall.
Fang Heng stared at Meng Wu and felt an extremely dangerous aura from him.
Just now, even a slightly thinner steel plate could be pierced through, but it didn’t have much of a reaction when it hit his face?
“Ruoruo, be careful.”
“Okay.”
Just as Fang Heng was thinking about how to deal with Meng Wu, a voice sounded from behind the crowd.
“The great leader of the Federation’s Investigation Team, Meng Wu, has arrived. Why didn’t you inform us in advance? I could have prepared some good tea to welcome you.”
Mo Yunxiao walked out from the passage at the side with a smile on his face and looked at the person who came.
Mo Jiawei poked his head out from behind Mo Yunxiao and gave Fang Heng a thumbs up.
Good heavens, reinforcements were finally called in.
Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief, thinking that he finally didn’t have to fight this monster anymore.
Meng Wu slowly turned his head.
At this moment, his face was a bloody mess, looking unusually ferocious.
His tone was still unusually calm.
“Mr Mo, I received instructions from superiors to ask Fang Heng to go back and assist in the investigation.”
“What did Fang Heng do? Why is there a need to trouble Leader Meng to personally intervene?”
“I don’t know what crime he committed.” Meng Wu shook his head and said calmly, “I’m only responsible for receiving orders from superiors. Please go back and receive the investigation, Mr Fang Heng.”

“Alright, your mission failed. Go back and report it.” Mo Yunxiao smiled faintly and said, “Please tell your Minister Yu that if he wants to take Fang Heng away, I’m afraid he’ll have to come over personally.”
“Alright, I’ll bring him over.”
Meng Wu nodded at Mo Yunxiao. As he spoke, he slowly retreated into the darkness.
Ten minutes later, Mo Yunxiao, Fang Heng and the others arrived at the teahouse.
Mo Yunxiao leisurely made a cup of tea for the four of them.

“To be able to beat up the leader of the Federation’s Investigation Team, who can materialize a Tier 3 entity, with one punch...” Mo Yunxiao smiled gently and took a sip of tea, “Fang Heng, your name will be on the Federation’s list of high-level dangerous people tomorrow.”
“It can’t be that bad.”

“Those who can enter the investigation team are all elites of the Federation. At the very least, they are players who have entered the high-level game. In addition, Meng Wu is the captain of Team 3 of the investigation team. People call him facial paralysis. Countless high-level criminals of the Federation have fallen at his hands. This is the first time in the past few years that he has failed.”
“Then I’m truly honoured...”
Fang Heng nodded his head and thanked Mo Yunxiao. “Thank you.”
“There’s no need to be so formal.”
Mo Yunxiao waved his hand and put down his teacup. “Alright, I’m not joking. Fang Heng, I’ve already heard about what happened on the way from Jiawei.”
“Let’s be honest, you’re very interested in the main storyline mission of District 7 and want to compete with the Federation, right?”
“Yes,” Fang Heng admitted frankly. “I didn’t want it that much at first, so I just took it out of convenience. However, the recent actions of the Federation have made me very unhappy.”
“Yeah.”
Mo Yunxiao listened to Fang Heng’s words and felt that it was interesting.
Taking the main storyline as well?
It should be known that the Federation had spent so much effort to obtain the main storyline. Up until now, they had only obtained about ten main storyline worlds.
Mo Yunxiao pondered for a moment, then nodded and said, “I’ve heard that Kou Huai of Zombie Apocalypse’s District 7 is a very difficult character to deal with.”
“He once spent a year to eliminate all the anti-federal organization’s forces in District 7. Therefore, Zombie Apocalypse’s District 7 has always been very stable and was firmly controlled by him.”
“I think that the reason why Director Yu of the investigation team acted against you this time was probably because of him.”
Fang Heng began to feel a sense of danger.
Although he had the ability of the mark, he could directly use the mark to hide in the game when he was in danger.
However, it was a little displeasing to just hide like this.
“Mr Mo, do you have any suggestions?”

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - Countermeasures
paragraphs: “If you want my opinion, I think you should give up.”
Give up?
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.
Mo Jiawei shouted directly, “No! Fourth Uncle! How can we give up just like that! We’ve spent so much effort...”
“Listen to me first.”
Mo Yunxiao waved his hand and said seriously, “We all know that the main storyline mission of Zombie Apocalypse has a lot to do with the Dark Knights.”
“You’ve been in District 7 for too short a time. The Federation has already been ahead of you by too much. Under such circumstances, you can imagine how difficult it is to catch up.”

“If I were Kou Huai, I would use the resources of the Dark Knights to pressure you. He doesn’t even need to do it himself to make it difficult for you to move within the Dark Knights. He would completely cut off your follow-up main storyline mission in District 7.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
This was also what he had been worried about previously.

The Federation was able to affect the Dark Knights to a large extent. Even if he managed to complete the mission chain to assassinate Cook Barn and earn some contribution points, what about the following main storyline mission?
It was still difficult for him to interfere.
Mo Jiawei didn’t think so far ahead at the start. After hearing Mo Yunxiao’s words, his heart instantly turned cold as he thought to himself, “Can you still play like this?”
This is a dead end!
Are the people of the Federation all so sly?
Xiao Ruoruo also looked worriedly at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
The fact that the Federation was able to control the Dark Knights at this juncture was truly too unbearable.
However... was there no other way?
Not really.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes indiscernibly as he raised his head and said, “Mr Mo, I think I still have a chance.”
“Huh?”
Mo Yunxiao nodded with a smile. “Feel free to say it.”
“Kou Huai wants to play, so let’s play seriously.”

Fang Heng did not have any intention of joking. He thought for a moment and said seriously, “I can choose to slow down the progress of the main storyline mission and help the Scavenger Army resist the Dark Knights. Then, with the strength of the Scavenger Army, I can slowly find an opportunity to get rid of those Federation players who have higher contribution points than me in the Dark Knights.”
Everyone was stunned.

“Interesting idea, but it’s very difficult to do this. Moreover, as far as I know, there’s no precedent for this. Other than the Dark Knights, there’s no other way to complete the main storyline mission.”
“I will take my time then. I don’t mind. I believe there’s always another way to complete the main storyline. I can take my time to find it.”
Fang Heng spread his hands.
“If the path of the Dark Knights doesn’t work, why don’t we try to take the path of Cook Barn?”
Mo Jiawei was stunned and asked, “Cook Barn? What does that mean?”

Seeing the puzzled expressions on everyone’s faces, Fang Heng explained, “Cook Barn is also related to the first-generation meteorite in the main storyline. Maybe it can trigger the main storyline mission. There hasn’t been such a precedent before, but it doesn’t mean that it doesn’t exist, right?”

Fang Heng had a vague feeling that the founder of the Scavenger Army, Cook Barn, should know something. There was a probability that he could dig out clues related to the main storyline mission from him.
In his previous world, weren’t the games divided into ‘bad end’ and ‘good end’?
Helping Cook Barn destroy the entire world to complete ‘bad end’ might also be considered to have completed the main storyline...
Just because there was no precedent didn’t mean that it didn’t exist.
There were always more solutions than difficulties.
Even if he failed, he would be able to exhaust the strength of the Federation and vent his anger. At the same time, he would be able to obtain some clues related to the main storyline from Cook Barn.
If it didn’t work out, he might as well just destroy the Dark Knights!
He would just flip the table and stop playing! At that time, no one would be able to take the main storyline mission!
“Amazing! ! There’s such a move? Why didn’t I think of it?”
After carefully pondering over Fang Heng’s words, Mo Jiawei clapped his hands and was instantly pleasantly surprised.
He thought to himself that God was indeed a god. There were so many such fancy and flashy operations.
Mo Yunxiao smiled and didn’t say anything. He felt that it might be a method.
However, this method was too idealistic.
Ordinary players couldn’t join the Scavenger Army under the Federation’s strong pressure, let alone trigger the Scavenger Army’s mission line.

Moreover, it was easier said than done to do this. It was equivalent to a villain’s mission line courting death, and the vast majority of survival players and the Federation stood on a different side.
Even the anti-federal organization was rarely this crazy.
Thinking about it carefully, Mo Yunxiao felt that it was very interesting.
With an opponent like Fang Heng, the Federation would feel very distressed.
He was looking forward to what Fang Heng would become once he entered the high-level game.
Fang Heng asked, “Mr Mo, what do you think of my plan?”

“It’s a very interesting idea. I think that since you’ve already decided on your idea, you can be at ease and do it without any worries. I’ll be staying here for some time. The people of the Federation won’t personally come and ask for you.”
Mo Yunxiao raised his teacup. “I wish you success.”
“Thank you, Mr Mo!”
2 am in the morning.
At the Municipal Inspection Bureau.
The chief of the Federation’s Inspection Bureau, Cao Buchun, hurriedly walked outside the office. He knocked on the door and pushed it open to enter.
“Director Yu.”
“Hmm, you’re still here to personally report on your work so late at night? How’s the situation with Meng Wu?”
Yu Feiyu closed the file in his hand.
He was the one who had ordered Fang Heng to come back for the investigation.
He knew that Meng Wu’s operation would most likely fail tonight.
North River Heavy Industry had been very calm in recent years, but the higher-ups of the Federation were very clear that North River Heavy Industry was not of good character either.
This time, Meng Wu was asked to go over just to take a look at the situation and provide a decent explanation to District 7.
The Inspection Bureau had a lot of things to do. There was no need to waste manpower and resources for a low-level game world.
However, this time, Cao Buchun’s face was gloomy.
“Director Yu, there’s a problem. It was just confirmed ten minutes ago that Meng Wu is dead.”
“What?”
Yu Feiyu’s pupils constricted.
In a short moment, several thoughts flashed through his mind.
“Who did it? Is it North River Heavy Industry?”

“I’m not sure. After Leader Meng left North River Heavy Industry, he reported to me about the general work situation. It was too late at that time, so I told him to go back and rest first. Tomorrow, I’ll get someone to fill in a detailed mission record for him.”
Cao Buchun recalled the situation that night. “About ten minutes ago, the police station received a report that a corpse was found by the roadside.”

“The inspection team has already inspected the scene at the first possible moment. The preliminary conclusion is that it doesn’t seem like the Mo Family of North River Heavy Industry. From the traces left behind at the scene, it’s likely that it was done by a demi-human.”
Yu Feiyu frowned when he heard that.
“Demi-human...”

“The preliminary autopsy found that there were no external injuries on the surface of the body. The organs exploded and died. The scene of death contained a strong sense of provocation and venting anger...”
“Provocation?” Yu Feiyu stood up and picked up his coat. “Come with me to the scene. We’ll talk as we walk.
