Tomorrow, I’ll get someone to fill in a detailed mission record for him.”
Cao Buchun recalled the situation that night.
“About ten minutes ago, the police station received a report that a corpse was found by the roadside.”
“The inspection team has already inspected the scene at the first possible moment.
The preliminary conclusion is that it doesn’t seem like the Mo Family of North River Heavy Industry.
From the traces left behind at the scene, it’s likely that it was done by a demi-human.”
Yu Feiyu frowned when he heard that.
“Demi-human...”
“The preliminary autopsy found that there were no external injuries on the surface of the body.
The organs exploded and died.
The scene of death contained a strong sense of provocation and venting anger...”
“Provocation?” Yu Feiyu stood up and picked up his coat.
“Come with me to the scene.
We’ll talk as we walk.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - Counterattack
paragraphs: After chatting with Mo Yunxiao about the details of the game for most of the night, Fang Heng’s chaotic goals became clearer.
They talked until dawn before returning to their rooms to sleep.
This time, Fang Heng slept soundly.
Early the next morning, Fang Heng went online as usual.
As soon as he went online, a row of game hints instantly appeared.
[Hint: During the period when you went offline, the town in the South City district was ambushed by the outside world.]

[Hint: The high-level elite of the Scavenger Army, Wuke, led a team to resist the ambush from the outside world. You have obtained 21,983 Scavenger Army contribution points. Total consumption of warehouse materials and warlord potion (changed)*425.]
[Hint: During the battle, your team killed a member of the Dark Knights. Your friendship with the Dark Knights has been greatly reduced.]
[Hint: Your friendship with the Dark Knights has fallen into hatred.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Ai Lei has been greatly reduced.]
[Hint: Your mission to kill Cook Barn has been affected. Default failure.]
Looking at the game hints, Fang Heng’s face darkened and he fell silent.
He was boiling with rage internally.
The mission had failed. All his hard work during this time had gone to waste.
“The Federation!”
“Despicable!”
Mo Yunxiao had guessed it right!
They had already predicted that the Federation would use the Dark Knights to put pressure on him.
All of this was actually within Fang Heng and Mo Yunxiao’s expectations.

They had discussed for a long time last night and had already thought of ways to prevent the Federation from making any small moves, but the fact that the Federation was using the Dark Knights to tamper with him was simply impossible to prevent!
However, Fang Heng still felt angry in his heart.
This seemed to be his first time failing a mission.
Moreover, it was the main storyline mission!
He was clearly about to come into contact with Cook Barn, and he was just a little bit away from completing the mission!
Taking a deep breath, Fang Heng tried to calm himself down.
“I can’t calm down!”
“I can’t stand it!”
“I’m going to join the Scavenger Army!”
“I’ll directly start with the Scavenger Army to search for the main storyline mission!”
Miscellaneous thoughts ran through Fang Heng’s mind and he was feeling extremely unhappy.
With a vengeful mentality, he opened his character panel and found one of the clean-up missions.
Mission name: Clean up the southern region of the city.
Mission description: Clean up all player’s shelters within the southern region of the city.
Mission reward: Contribution points, survival points and various materials.
Following this, Fang Heng didn’t have to worry about robbing the Federation’s shelter.
“I’m not going to do the main storyline mission of District 7 anymore. Let’s just have fun!”
Fang Heng thought viciously. He opened the mission details and looked at all the shelters in the entire South City district.
The Federation had two large-scale shelters near the South City district, three central shelters, and more than ten small-scale shelters and resource gathering points.
Anyway, the main storyline mission of District 8 was still stuck in the research phase, and it would take some time to trigger.
Since he had nothing to do, he might as well help the villains fight against the Federation!
He would start from the Federation’s shelter! He would catch them off guard and earn contribution points!
Closing the map, Fang Heng immediately gathered Osborne and his new subordinates in the middle of the square.
Wuke and Huan Tai were originally the elites of the Scavenger Army and had just been promoted to regional commander.
Last night, they had led a team to break through the enemy’s raid and were full of fighting spirit.
“Chief Commander Fang Heng!”

Fang Heng looked around at his elite soldiers and said in a low voice, “Distribute the battle materials and prepare for battle. In thirty minutes, all of you will follow me to attack the target Shelter No. 16.”
Wuke and Huan Tai looked at each other and saw the excitement flashing in each other’s eyes.
When they first came here, they were a little worried when they heard that Fang Heng was a potioneer.
Now that they found out that Fang Heng was also a militant, they immediately put down their hearts that were hanging in the air.
The two of them shouted in unison, “Yes! Commander!!”
Federation’s Zombie Apocalypse, District 7 command post.
The Federation, together with the major game guilds in District 7, fought with the Scavenger Army that Fang Heng secretly controlled for three whole days.
Kou Huai was having a headache.
In all the war zones except the South City district, the Federation had a huge advantage.
The Scavenger Army was retreating in defeat!
Only the South City district was filled with tragic reports every day.
Until yesterday afternoon, the Federation’s last large-scale shelter in the South City district had been completely destroyed.
The South City district had fallen.
Helplessly, at this stage, the Federation was simply unable to resist the combination of the zombie team and the Scavenger Army’s lunatics!
The small shelter was taken over by the crazy scavengers almost at once, while the large shelter only lasted for two or three days.
The consumption ability of the zombie team was too terrifying.
During the day, they finally managed to repel the Tyrant team with their heavy weapons. At night, they made a comeback.
Twice a day, they cooperated with the crazy scavengers to consume their energy from afar.
The players had no time to repair the shelter that had been damaged in the battle and under wave after wave of attacks, their energy was wearing out forcefully.
Every time they received a hint of an attack, the Federation shelter was under great psychological pressure.
It was not like the Federation had not tried to launch a surprise attack on the South City district.
However, the effect was extremely limited.
There were too many Lickers wandering around the South City district!

They would take the initiative to attack the passing vehicles. It was difficult for the Federation to organize an effective attack. Moreover, the Scavenger Army had also accumulated a portion of their forces within the town.
Kou Huai even suspected that there was a mole within their Federation. Every time they launched a surprise attack, the other party would be able to predict it in advance.
“Dong Dong Dong.”
“Come in.”
A Federation player saluted Kou Huai.
“Reporting sir, the superiors’ report on Operation Guillotine!”
Operation Guillotine!
They had finally approved!
Kou Huai’s eyes lit up.
“Bring it over.”
It was a special side mission initiated by the Dark Knights, Operation Guillotine.
The objective of the mission was to directly kill Cook Barn.
Kou Huai had roughly heard of this mission.
The Dark Knights had managed to obtain the specific location of Cook Barn, the founder of the Scavenger Army.
The Scavenger Army was once under Cook Barn’s control.
If everything went smoothly, once Cook Barn was killed, the entire Scavenger Army would be completely annihilated!
But at the same time, District 7 would also bear a huge risk!

According to the experience gained by the experts from their superiors from other districts, once Cook Barn suddenly died, the entire Scavenger Army would fall into a frenzy for some time and their strength would greatly increase. Then they would crazily destroy the player’s shelter.
As long as they could survive that period of time, the members of the Scavenger Army would gradually die.
However, the troublesome thing was that the progress of the follow-up main storyline mission in District 7 would also be delayed for a very long period of time.
Therefore, before this, this plan had been put on hold.

But now, considering the destruction of Server 7 by the Scavenger Army, the superiors agreed to recruit various elite players from District 7 and District 8 to form an elite team to execute Operation Guillotine, completely eliminating Cook Barn.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - The Main Storyline Was Triggered
paragraphs: “Boom! Boom Boom!”
In front of a shelter, a dozen Tyrant form soldiers raised their fists and hammered at the ruins of the shelter.

[Hint: You have led the Scavenger Army to plunder a medium-sized shelter. You have received 23,000 Scavenger Army contribution points. Various resources are being transferred to the stronghold area of the southern city. Resources will be calculated after the transfer is completed...]
[Hint: You have cleared the shelter. You have obtained 26,000 Scavenger Army contribution points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with the Dark Knights (District 7) has been greatly reduced.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Ai Lei has been reduced to hatred.]
[Hint: Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has been greatly increased.]
[Hint: Your friendship with the commander of each district has been increased. Your friendship with Cook Barn has been increased...]
[Hint: Your honor level in the Scavenger Army has increased to Level 23 (Deputy commander).]
[Hint: Currently, you can still receive contribution points from the Scavenger Army, but your honor level can no longer be increased through contribution points.]
Even his honor level has reached the top level?
Looking at the game log, Fang Heng was somewhat silent. He even felt a little bored.
For the past three days, he had been fighting with the Federation.
He was under a lot of pressure.
Unfortunately, his teammates were not strong enough!

The Scavenger Army was besieged by the Federation and the player forces. Other than their South City district, the four regions in the game, the southern region, had been destroyed. The remaining western and northern regions were also in danger.
Only the eastern region, including their South City region, remained standing.
This was all thanks to his huge supply of improved warlord potions.
In addition, his friendship with the Dark Knights had already fallen into a state of hatred...
It would be more difficult than ascending to the heavens to restore their friendship.
As a mole, there was no turning back now.
“It’s troublesome enough.”
Fang Heng complained.
He had to think of another way to help the Scavenger Army develop and grow.
Otherwise, he would lose...
Fang Heng was thinking when Osborne walked in with two elite Scavenger Army members from the temporary warehouse.
“Chief Commander Fang Heng, Commander Mr Cook Barn wants to see you.”
Fang Heng was stunned.
Then, a hint appeared.
[Hint: Your performance recently received Cook Barn’s approval.]
[Hint: Your contribution has met the requirements. Special mission triggered-Cook Barn’s plan.]
[Hint: The current mission is related to the main storyline. It may have a great impact on the storyline of the subsequent world. Player, please choose carefully...]
Mission name: Cook Barn’s plan.
Mission description: Please meet with Cook Barn
Mission reward: ???
Main storyline! Main storyline!
The appearance of these two words made Fang Heng’s spirit rise!
He had come into contact with a mission related to the main storyline!
Originally, Fang Heng did not have much hope for this antagonist’s line. He just held the attitude of trying it out.

Currently, he was still staying in District 7 partly to disgust the Federation, and partly to quickly come into contact with Cook Barn. He wanted to try to obtain more information related to the main storyline from Cook Barn’s mouth and learn by analogy so that he could avoid detours on the main storyline of District 8.
He didn’t expect that he would be able to trigger the main storyline mission!
Fang Heng was in a great mood.
“I’ve always wanted to meet Mr Cook. When can we leave?”
“Commander Cook wants to see you as soon as possible. If it’s convenient, we can leave now. The car is already waiting outside the door.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng followed Osborne out of the warehouse.
Three large trucks parked side by side on the roadside.
“Trucks?”
Fang Heng looked at Osborne in confusion.
“Commander Cook Barn has always been paying attention to you. He wants to take this opportunity to see your friends.”
“Huh?”
“Tyrant form.”
“Oh.”
Fang Heng understood and waved at the warehouse behind him.
Six Tyrant forms walked out of the warehouse behind him, strode to the back of the truck and sat down cross-legged.
“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng said as he walked to the passenger’s seat.
Osborne glanced at the dark warehouse behind him, nodded, sat in the driver’s seat and drove away from South City district with Fang Heng.
He was finally going to see Cook Barn!
Fang Heng was a little excited.
He would definitely be able to find clues related to the main storyline from Cook Barn!
Five hours later, the truck drove into a mountain range.
Through the rearview mirror, Osborne could see hundreds of Lickers following behind.
They crawled quickly along the ground, making sizzling sounds.
After circling the mountain range for a long time, the truck stopped at a corner of the mountain range.
There was a huge cave ahead.
The truck drove directly into the cave and Fang Heng discovered that there was a different world inside the cave.
The interior of the cave had been completely transformed and had become a modern research base.
Elite scavengers were guarding both sides of the passage.
Just as he got out of the truck, a strong young man walked toward Fang Heng and the others.
Ni Shengtao walked in front of Fang Heng and extended his hand to him.
“Hello, Commander Fang Heng. I’m Ni Shengtao, the chief commander of the research base. Welcome.”
Fang Heng smiled and extended his hand. “Hello.”
Bang, Bang, Bang..
Six Tyrant forms stepped out of the truck and stood behind Fang Heng.
It was Ni Shengtao’s first time seeing the Tyrant form with his own eyes. A flash of surprise flashed across his eyes.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Immediately after, the group of Lickers climbed around the truck.
“Commander Cook is waiting for you in the living room. He wants to see the Tyrant form you’re controlling. Please bring the Tyrant form with you and follow me.”
Osborne nodded. “You can go. Commander Cook doesn’t want to see me. I’ll wait for you here.”
Fang Heng left the Lickers on the spot. He brought Tyrant along and followed Ni Shengtao into the depths of the research base.
After a while, Ni Shengtao brought Fang Heng to the meeting room.
This was the first time Fang Heng had seen the mastermind behind the Scavenger Army.
At first glance, Cook Barn looked like an old man who was dying.
He was sitting in a wheelchair and he was so thin that he looked like a dried corpse.
Fang Heng wondered if he could end Cook Barn’s life with a single shot.
Who would have thought that the plot would change?
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng.”
Cook Barn pushed the wheelchair and slowly moved in front of Fang Heng.
“Tyrant, a very beautiful life form, isn’t it?”
Cook Barn’s turbid eyes slowly moved toward Fang Heng.
“You’ve never drunk the divine potion.”
“Commander Cook.” Fang Heng slightly bowed and pointed at his head, he said, “The divine potion will desensitise me here. You know, I’m a potioneer. I need to maintain a clear mind.”
“I’ve heard that you’re a very capable potioneer.”

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - The Mysterious Box
paragraphs: Cook Barn did not dwell on this point. He shifted his gaze and pushed his wheelchair forward.

“You’ve done well during this period. The Dark Knights and the survivors have joined forces to deal with us. The army has suffered repeated setbacks. The improved potion you developed has helped us a lot...”
As he spoke, Cook Barn came to a wall in the reception room. He stretched out his palm and pressed it against the wall.
“I believe that the Dark Knights cannot stop our rise.”
“Click...”
A hidden secret door was opened.
“This place used to be one of the secret research institutes of the Meteorite Company. After the disaster came, I brought it with me to transform this place.”
Behind the hidden door was a long main passage.
Cook Barn pushed his wheelchair into the passage.
Fang Heng looked at Ni Shengtao and controlled the Tyrant form to follow him into the passage.
Walking along the long passage, Fang Heng pondered for a moment and tried to ask, “Commander Cook, I heard that you used to be a member of the Dark Knights?”
“Yes, that was a long time ago.”
“Why did you leave them?”
“Hehe, of course, to pursue a broader future, young man.”
Fang Heng frowned.
“You’re a potioneer and you’ve also successfully improved the warlord potion. I guess you’ve also studied the divine potion, right?”
“Yes.”
Cook Barn seemed to be testing him. He asked, “Then what did you find in the divine potion?”
“Worms.”
“Worms... Yes, worms... the mechanism of the divine potion is the worm’s body.”
As he spoke, he controlled the wheelchair to stop.
He turned his head and faced Fang Heng.
In an instant, his face gradually became distorted.
The skin on his face was slowly squirming...
Under his wrinkled skin and muscles, Fang Heng could clearly see the worm’s body squirming faintly.
Distorted and terrifying.
“Creak Creak Creak...”
The worm’s body gradually disappeared from his face.
“I was once a member of the Dark Knights. During the process of researching the first-generation meteorite, I was infected by this worm.”
“The worm invaded my brain and controlled my body. To prevent the worm’s infection from spreading, I chose to self-destruct.”
“I didn’t expect to miraculously survive after that explosion.”
“The strange thing is that the worm life in my body has gradually become quiet.”
“I have reached a strange balance with the worm in my body. Sometimes, I can feel its thoughts.”
Fang Heng frowned and asked, “What is it thinking?”
A twisted smile appeared on Cook Barn’s face. “It offered me an irresistible deal.”
Fang Heng looked at Cook Barn suspiciously.
He felt that Cook Barn’s brain might have been controlled by the worms.
“You’ll understand soon enough.”
Cook Barn turned around and continued pushing the wheelchair forward.
“Believe me, we will all be witnesses of this new era, Fang Heng.”
At the end of the passage, a large door opened in front.
Behind the door was a ring-shaped hall. In the centre of the hall stood a large mechanical facility.
More than a dozen researchers in blue clothes were pacing around the laboratory.
“What is this?”
“An Omega electromagnetic induction device. Through the special electromagnetic wave effect, we can track its whereabouts.”
“It?”
Cook Barn did not answer. He continued pushing the wheelchair, facing a large screen on the wall.
The big screen showed the map of the Zombie Apocalypse in District 7.
On the map, there were two conspicuous red circles.
“Long before the Zombie Apocalypse, the Meteorite Company made twelve special boxes. After dividing them, they hid them in every corner of the world.”
“The boxes were made of special metals. To find them, I built the Omega electromagnetic induction tower, which can search for the location of the secret boxes.”

“The search range of the main electromagnetic induction tower is limited. To expand the search range, we need to set up sub-centres of the signal towers in every corner of the world, establish a connection with the main electromagnetic tower, and expand the search range to find the specific locations of the twelve special boxes.”
“As you can see, currently, we can only find the location of two of the signal sources with the help of the main induction tower.”
Fang Heng was puzzled and asked, “What’s in the box?”
“It’s something that can give us strength.”
A ferocious smile appeared on Cook Barn’s face. He warned, “Strength also means danger. After you find it, hand it over to me. Don’t open it without permission, understand?”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng agreed. He frowned and several thoughts flashed through his mind.
The box that the Meteorite Company hid?
What was in the box?
Why did Cook Barn say that it represented strength?
Since it represented strength, why did the Meteorite Company hide it?
Putting aside his doubts, Fang Heng looked up at the red circles marked on the map.
“Commander Cook, one of the boxes is near us?”
“Yes, I have found one of the boxes. There are eleven left. The nearest box is at that place. Be careful, there is the camp of the Dark Knights there.”
[Hint: Player has completed the mission-Cook Barn’s plan.]
[Hint: Player has triggered a special main storyline mission-Mysterious box.]
Mission name: Mysterious box.
Mission description: Cook Barn wishes for you to head to the location of the signal source and look for the mysterious box that was hidden by the Meteorite Company.
Mission description: This mission will have a great negative effect on the main storyline mission. Player, please make a careful choice.
Mission reward: Main storyline mission contribution points, Scavenger Army contribution points, special unknown reward.
Fang Heng quickly skimmed through the mission hint.
Since it was related to the main storyline mission, he had to think of a way to complete it.
“Okay, I understand. I will think of a way to get the box as soon as possible.”
“Very good. Follow me. I have another good thing I want to share with you.”
As he spoke, he continued to push the wheelchair and brought Fang Heng forward.
After leaving the hall, everyone went to the special laboratory in the sixth basement of the research institute.
“Commander Cook.”
More than a dozen researchers bowed their heads and greeted him.
There were five large-scale cultivation pods in the laboratory.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and walked to one of the cultivation pods to check.
High-level creature cultivation pod!
Even his shelter in District 8 didn’t have such a high-level cultivation pod.
If he could bring it back...
Fang Heng kept his eyes on the cultivation pod.
Each cultivation pod contained a zombie corpse.
“Fang Heng, our army has been under a lot of pressure recently. The biggest problem is our manpower. Your arrival has given me some new ideas.”
“Ideas?”
“You already know how the divine potion works, so you should know the flaws of the divine potion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - Stealing Home
paragraphs: “Humans have always been a very fragile life form.”

“Ordinary human bodies cannot directly withstand the parasitism of high-level worms. They need a long time to adapt to the transformation of the parasites. During this period, they also need to constantly take the nutrient solution. The process is too long.”
“But the zombie corpse is different. From a certain point of view, zombies are more adapted to worms than humans.”
While speaking, Cook Barn turned his head and looked at the Tyrant form behind Fang Heng.
“The Tyrant, the product that was modified by the Meteorite Company, is compatible with strength and agility. Its design is full of beauty, isn’t it?”
Fang Heng was stunned. “You want to let the Tyrant form and the worm body fuse together?”
“That’s right. Recently, I’ve been thinking about the research on zombies and worm bodies.”
“I know that in the past, the Meteorite Company also had a similar Nemesis plan, but they didn’t know much about the research on worm bodies. I’ve improved on the foundation of the Nemesis.”
Cook Barn looked at Fang Heng. “How is it? Do you want to try to let the zombie form you control fuse with it? Do you want to let your Tyrant form gain more strength?”
It could transform an evolved Tyrant!?
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up and he immediately asked, “Can it be done?”
“Of course, you’ve done so much for the army recently. This is the reward that you deserve.”

Cook Barn turned around again and faced the large-scale cultivation pod, “But currently, this research is still in progress. The configuration of the worm body and nutrient solution is extremely limited. We still lack one very important thing...”
Fang Heng frowned.
“As long as you can help me find the box, I can immediately perfect the modification. What do you think?”
A row of game hints flashed in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
[Hint: Player has discovered an evolution option for the zombie corpse Tyrant-unknown worm body modification upgrade.]

[Hint: After the modification is completed, the value of each attribute will be greatly increased, allowing the Tyrant form to have a stronger vitality and explosive power while retaining the original modification.]
[Hint: Current fusion success rate is 100%. The transformation will take 72 hours. You can reduce the transformation time by spending survival points.]
[Hint: Player’s current mission: Mysterious box reward update. After completing the mission, you can obtain a special transformation opportunity for the transformation cultivation pod.]
Mission name: Unknown box.
Mission objective: Obtain more mysterious boxes and hand them over to Cook Barn.

Mission description: For every mysterious box submitted to Cook Barn, you will receive three chances to modify the unknown worm body. As the number of mysterious boxes submitted increases, the player will receive more modification opportunities.
Fang Heng took a deep breath.
Pretty cool!
It was a 100% success rate!
Fang Heng’s heart was burning.
After completing the transformation, the Tyrant form would completely evolve into a Tier 4 life form!
After combining the Tyrant form vine parasite and the unknown worm body’s three attribute characteristic skills, the Tyrant form’s strength could compete with a normal Tier 5 mutated zombie!
“Fang Heng, find the box and I can help you complete the transformation of the Tyrant form. Do you understand?”
Fang Heng swallowed his saliva. He felt that he had another reason to work for the Scavenger Army.
“It’s a deal!”
“As expected, I didn’t make a misjudgement. Go ahead and do it, Fang Heng.”
After finishing the deal with Cook Barn, Fang Heng seized the time to return to the South City district with Osborne.
Fang Heng opened the map and observed.
The coordinates of the mysterious box of the Meteorite Company were near a camp of the Dark Knights. If he went there directly, he might encounter trouble.
Fang Heng was well aware of the difficulty of the main storyline mission. He planned to make a plan after he returned.
However...
What exactly was in the box that Cook Barn was looking for?
It seemed that it had a great connection with the main storyline mission.
If he got the box, should he open it first and take a look?
Fang Heng was a little conflicted.
“Commander Cook admires you very much. He rarely talks to people for so long.”
“He has good taste.”
Fang Heng chatted with Osborne, trying to get some information out of him.
“By the way, do you know the box Commander Cook is looking for?”
“You mean the box hidden by the Meteorite Company. I do know something about it.”
“Do you mind telling me?”
“I knew Cook earlier than anyone in the Scavenger Army.”
“A long time ago, before the Scavenger Army was formed, Commander Cook and I went to the Meteorite Company’s emergency shelter to search for clues.”
Fang Heng was surprised and asked, “What did you say?”

“Before the zombie crisis broke out, the Meteorite Company had simulated the worldwide biochemical crisis. They had built seven large-scale shelters around the world to deal with the worst that could happen.”
“Once there was a biochemical crisis that was beyond their control, the Meteorite Company would choose to immediately evacuate and enter the emergency shelter to survive.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and whispered, “Cook Barn had investigated the Meteorite Company...”
Osborne looked at Fang Heng through the rearview mirror, his eyes flashing with mockery.
“Fang Heng, what do you think is the original intention of the Scavenger Army? To destroy this world? Or to become the new king of this apocalyptic world?”
“Isn’t it? Or is it to save this world?”
“You’re right.”
Fang Heng was stunned, thinking that this reversal was a little fast.

Whether it was clearing the territory occupied by the player’s shelter, or using the special worm found in the first-generation meteorite to develop a divine potion to control his subordinates, all the actions of the Scavenger Army followed the logic of a normal villain.
Why did Osborne say that the Scavenger Army still wanted to clear their name?
“Strange, since your goal is the same as the Dark Knights, why don’t you cooperate with them?”
“You expect those hypocritical Dark Knights to cooperate with us? It’s already good enough that they didn’t slice us up and study us.”
Osborne laughed lightly and sneered disdainfully.

He shook his head and continued, “At the beginning, Cook was worried that the worms in his body would go out of control and cause a riot again. He wanted to use his strength to solve the secret of the first-generation meteorite.”
“No one is willing to believe us. We can only rely on ourselves.”

As he said that, the light in Osborne’s eyes gradually dimmed, “But after that time, Cook became a bit unfamiliar to me. He began to be impatient for quick success. He developed the divine potion and formed the Scavenger Army...”
“Boom!!!”
Just as Osborne was speaking, Fang Heng heard a loud noise.
Then, under his feet, the big truck shook violently.
What was going on?
Was it an explosion?
Osborne slammed on the brakes.
“Squeak...!”
The big truck left a long skid mark on the ground.
Fang Heng frowned. He immediately poked his head out of the truck window and looked back in the direction of the explosion.
A cloud of thick black smoke rose from the mountains.
It was in the direction of the Scavenger Army headquarters!
Could the location of the explosion be in the army’s headquarters?!
Was his hometown ambushed?
Fang Heng’s heart was gripped in mid-air.
Just after he had obtained the Tyrant form’s transformation plan for the next tier, his hometown was at risk of being stolen?
He had to pray that the Tyrant’s improved cultivation pod in the eighth basement of the research institute would not be damaged by the explosion!
Osborne also stuck his head out of the window.
His expression also changed. He turned to look at Fang Heng. “Fang Heng.”
“Quick! Don’t just stand there, Hurry back and take a look!”
Osborne shut his mouth when he heard that. He immediately drove the truck and headed in the direction of the Scavenger Army headquarters.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - Be the Commander
paragraphs: In front of them, thick black smoke came out of the cave of Scavenger Army headquarters. The entire Scavenger Army was in a mess.
Osborne drove the truck into the cave.
When it reached the deep end, Fang Heng immediately jumped out of the truck.
“What’s going on?”
Seeing Fang Heng, a Scavenger Army elite instantly reported, “Commander Fang, the headquarters is under an unknown attack! Commander Ni Shengtao is leading some people to investigate thoroughly!”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched slightly, and a feeling of extreme unease rose in his heart.
Something terrible was going to happen!
Could it be that Federation had made another move? In the past, Federation had used a similar tactic in District 5, and he was one of the executors back then.

At this moment, Fang Heng was most concerned about Tyrant form cultivation pod on the sixth underground floor. He hurriedly asked, “What about the laboratory on the sixth underground floor? Is it fine?”
The Scavenger Army elite was obviously stunned.
He then said, “The damage is still under investigation.”
“Take me there for a look.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he strode toward the inner part of the army base.
Just as they reached the entrance, Ni Shengtao rushed out of the passage with a group of Scavenger Army elites followed.
As he saw Fang Heng, Ni Shengtao’s eyes narrowed.
“Commander Fang.”
Ni Shengtao stopped and said in a deep voice, “Mr. Cook is dead.”
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted as he heard this news.
“Cook is dead?
Someone has snuck into my place?” he thought to himself.
The next second, a game notice appeared in front of Fang Heng.
“Hint: Commander of Scavenger Army, Cook Barn, is dead.”
“Hint: Morale of Scavenger Army is reduced by 50%. All attributes of every member are reduced by 10%.”
Outside Edge Creek Town.
Cheng Ya and the other two were carrying the log back to Scavenger Army’s strongholds.
These few days, they had been doing high-intensity log-carrying jobs under Roche’s orders every day.
Wei Chun’s back ached from fatigue.
He had once thought that it was Fang Heng who played tricks on them.
However, their superiors ordered them to continue hiding in Scavenger Army to gather intelligence.
Just a few seconds ago, a series of sudden game hints made the three of them freeze on the spot.
They looked at each other.
What the h*ll? Commander Cook Barn was dead?
Federation had won? And Scavenger Army could be disbanded?
They could stop carrying the log?
A few seconds later, Cheng Ya was the first to come back to her senses. “You guys stay here. I’ll go back and report now.”
“Yes!”
At the headquarter of Federation District 7.
Kou Huai sat in front of his desk, his fingers constantly tapping on the desk.
Knock, knock!
After knocking on the door, a Federation soldier pushed the door open and entered.
“Commander, we’ve just received news that the assassination was successful. It’s confirmed that Cook Barn is dead. An elite player has failed to escape during the mission and died.”
“In addition, we’ve already collected a portion of the body tissues of Cook Barn and immediately submitted them to Dark Knights to complete the mission.”
The overall situation was set!
Hearing this, Kou Huai slowly stood up and spat out a word.
“Good!”
Kou Huai looked at the soldier who reported, “Tell everyone that the members of Scavenger Army will be in a crazy state for some time. So we must defend at all costs these days!”
“Yes, sir!”

The passage was silent.
Cook Barn was dead?
Osborne’s mind was blank, and his face was ashen.
He had screwed up! It was all over!
He knew well that Cook Barn was the only one knowing how to concoct the divine potion in the entire Scavenger Army.
All the members who had taken the divine potion would die once they lost it!
Including him, 98% of the members of Scavenger Army had taken the divine potion.
What should he do? Was there any way to fix it?
With many thoughts in his mind, Osborne suddenly thought of something.
He suddenly turned his head and stared at Fang Heng at the side.
Fang Heng!!!
He was an extremely remarkable pharmacist.
He had once developed a modified warlord potion.
This meant that his ability in pharmaceutics had even surpassed cook Barn!
Right now, Fang Heng was the only person who could save all their lives.
Osborne slowly turned his head, looked at Ni Shengtao, and winked to ask for his opinion.
At this moment, Fang Heng also fell into silence.
A game hint flashed across his vision.
“Hint: Your mission to find the mysterious box has failed.”
F*ck you! Federation!
Fang Heng clenched his fists tightly, cursing in his heart.
This was the second time he had experienced a failure of the mission in the game.
He had been defeated by Federation twice.
The main storyline he had painstakingly come into contact with was cut off by Federation again!
Fang Heng took a deep breath, trying to keep himself calm.
Wait a minute.
Since Cook Barn had died, what would happen to Scavenger Army?
Disband right away?
“The contribution points I’ve been accumulating for such a long time will all be gone?
No!”
Fang Heng began to ponder. He should take advantage of the chaos after Cook’s death to get more benefits while the group was leaderless.
At least, he had to think of a way to steal Tyrant form modification pod in the laboratory on the underground eighth floor.
In a short while, Fang Heng had already decided on his next action plan.
He would take advantage of the chaos to reap benefits.
Fang Heng had just raised his head and was about to say something when he noticed Ni Shengtao and Osborne quickly exchanging glances.
Then, the two of them stared at him with a decisive gaze.
What happened?
Fang Heng thought to himself, “Why are they looking at me like this?
Could it be that they had seen through my plan?”
Then, Ni Shengtao and Osborne seemed to have made a decision and nodded at the same time.
Osborne took a step forward and knelt down on one knee.
“Commander Fang Heng, we have no leader since Commander Cook has died. I propose that you become the new leader of Scavenger Army!”
What the h*ll?!
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.
What Osborne did also exceeded the expectations of all the other members of Scavenger army.
As the Scavenger Army NPCs were still in shock, Ni Shengtao walked to Osborne’s side and half-knelt like him.
“Commander Fang Heng, Scavenger Army is about to be destroyed. I sincerely advise you to be our leader. I hope you can take the responsibility of leading Scavenger Army!”
Hearing that, the Scavenger Army elites also came back to their senses. They all knelt on one knee and said in unison, “Commander Fang Heng, please be our leader!”
Fang Heng widened his mouth.
Then, a line of information immediately appeared before his vision.
“Hint: Commander of Scavenger Army, Cook Barn, has died. Player Fang Heng’s current honor level is 23 as Deputy Commander. It met the advancement requirements.”
“Hint: Player’s current reputation points in Scavenger army have met the advancement requirements.”
“Hint: More than half of the NPCs at the commander level and above in Scavenger Army have reached trust level and above in friendship. It met the advancement requirements.”
“Hint: Osborne and Ni Shengtao have both recommended you as the new leader of Scavenger Army. It met the advancement requirements.”
“Hint: Dear player, you can now choose to take over the commander position of Scavenger Army. Do you agree?”
“Hint: If you do, you will trigger the subsequent related missions. If you refuse, you can receive the main storyline contribution points as the reward and Dark Knights’ friendship.”
“Hint: Your choice will affect the progress of the main storyline. Please choose carefully.”

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - Fictitious God of Apocalypse
paragraphs: What?!
Fang Heng’s mind was in chaos for a moment.
“What’s going on?
Cook Barn is dead, so I can take his place?” he said to himself.
The development of this matter was far beyond Fang Heng’s original expectations.
Things had turned greatly delightful from greatly miserable.
Surprises just came to him suddenly.
“Perhaps Federation did me a big favor, right?” he thought.
Fang Heng suppressed the joy in his heart and checked his game log again.
Of course, he would choose to accept it!

The friendship of Dark Knights had already turned into hatred. Increasing it by a little would not change the situation at all! If he refused, Federation only needed to play little tricks to make him in huge disadvantage.
He would have a chance of survival only by joining Scavenger Army.
No, he would have many chances of survival.
Perhaps he would be able to find the main storyline soon!
Fang Heng immediately answered in his heart.
“Yes, I do.”

“Hint: Cook Barn is dead. You have chosen to be the commander of Scavenger Army. Your current honor level of Scavenger Army has automatically advanced to Level 24. You’re promoted as Acting Commander.”
“Hint: You have triggered the main storyline ending mission (normal ending), Fictitious God of Apocalypse.”

“Mission Description: Most members of Scavenger Army can be immune to the zombie virus. Although such an ability carries great risks, it may be the best way to coexist with the apocalypse. Please be fully in charge of Scavenger Army and allow it to occupy more than 85% of the territories in the world (District 7).
Mission Requirements: Lead your Scavenger Army to occupy 85% of the territories in the world and ensure the usage rate of divine potion be above 98%.

Mission Reward: The ending, Fictitious God of Apocalypse (Grade A), will be triggered after the mission is done. You can gain Mission reward and additional main storyline contribution points. After the ending mission is completed, players in District 7 will be ranked according to their main storyline contribution points. The player ranked first will obtain the ownership of District 7 in Zombie Apocalypse.”
Main storyline ending!
The game hints that appeared made Fang Heng’s heart beat fiercely.
After so much effort in a long time, he finally obtained the main storyline ending in such an unexpected way.
Fang Heng took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He rechecked the game hints.
Wasn’t it the end of the world?
The divine potion would cause humans to be infected with the unknown worm virus, so it meant everyone in the world would be infected with the worm virus?
According to the hint, there might be multiple endings of this game. Taking charge of Scavenger Army and dominating the entire apocalyptic world was just one of them.
The final reward for each ending would likely be different as well.
Thinking about it carefully, Fang Heng found it extremely difficult to complete the mission.
Scavenger Army had to occupy more than 85% of the world’s territory.
That was difficult!
The divine potion would affect the real world, so Federation would definitely not allow Scavenger Army to easily occupy District 7 of the game world.
“Should we go head-on with Federation?”
Fang Heng roughly thought about it.
They might not lose.
If Tyrant form cultivation pod on the eighth floor underground was intact, he could endlessly cultivate the modified tyrant forms. So what if they fight Federation of District 7 head-on?
He wouldn’t have to be afraid as long as Scavenger Army was strong enough.
Moreover, now that he was the leader of Scavenger Army, he might be able to think of a way to make a time passage stabilizer in District 7. By then, he could use the strength of District 8...
In a short while, Fang Heng had a general idea.
“Get up, everyone.”
“Yes, sir!”
The Scavenger Army elites all stood up respectfully and retreated to the side.
“Since I have become the commander, I don’t have to care about the mission of collecting boxes. I can go to the eighth floor underground and use Tyrant form modification pod, right?” he thought.
Fang Heng looked at Ni Shengtao at the side.
“Commander Ni, how’s damage of our shelter? And where are the intruders?”

“We have confirmed that the intruders have retreated. They entered here in quite a particular way. And they planted explosives while leaving. The second and third floors underground of the headquarters are badly damaged.
In addition, the information room on the twelfth underground floor is also badly damaged. Our men are doing rush repairs right now.
We have already started analyzing the intrusion methods of the intruders.”
Fang Heng continued to ask, “What about the eighth floor underground? Is there anything wrong with the laboratory on that level? Can the cultivation pod continue to run?”

Ni Shengtao was curious why Fang Heng was so concerned about the eighth underground level. He nodded and replied, “We haven’t received any reports of attacks on the eighth underground level so far. The laboratory is under the charge of Dr. Ding Min. She should know the cultivation pod’s condition the best.”
“Go and confirm the situation on the eighth floor immediately. Where is Dr. Ding Min now?”
“She is making urgent repair on the equipment on the second floor undergound.”
“Alright, ask her to come and meet me as soon as the repair is done. We’ll go to the eighth floor together...”
Osborne and Ni Shengtao looked at each other, then Osborne took a small step forward.
“Excuse me, Commander Fang Heng. Before you go, I have something really important to report to you privately.”
Fang Heng nodded and waved to his subordinates, “You guys go check the eighth floor now!”
“Yes, sir!”
After Scavenger Army elites all left, Fang Heng asked, “What’s it about?”
“Commander Fang Heng, it’s about the divine potion.”
Osborne was worried and continued, “Only the former commander, Cook Barn, has the formula of the divine potion. There will be no source of supply for the potion since he’s dead now.”
Fang Heng was stunned when he heard that.
This was a big trouble.
He suddenly realized that the divine potion was the biggest crisis he needed to face now!
In essence, the divine potion was a liquid providing nutrients to the parasitic worms inside the Scavenger Army members’ bodies.

If they hadn’t taken the potion for some time, the parasitic worms in their bodies would become restless, and their bodies would suffer a backlash. After a period of time, both the worms and their bodies would fall into a berserk state until they die.
At that time, Scavenger Army would inevitably collapse.

Osborne’s face was solemn as he said in a deep voice, “Commander Fang Heng, I have given immediate orders to seal off the news of Mr. Cook’s death. Currently, the remaining divine potion in the warehouse can only support us for three days at most. After that, our members will begin to have withdrawal symptoms if we can’t develop a new potion.”

“In order to maintain the stability of the team, I suggest that we announce the news of you becoming the new commander of Scavenger Army after we have completed the research and development of the divine potion.”
“Alright, you are thoughtful.”
Fang Heng nodded and smiled bitterly in his heart.
This was a really big trouble.
How could it be so easy to research and develop the divine potion?!
Due to the restriction of the worms in the divine potion, he was unable to deduce its formula even with his potionology skills.
Hold on!
Cook Barn should have left behind a lot of research materials. There might be clues to the divine potion.
“Commander Fang Heng, there’s one more thing.”

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - Something Left by Cook
paragraphs: At this time, Ni Shengtao looked at Fang Heng and said, “About three years ago, Mr. Cook told me that he wanted the new army commander to go to his secret storage room if he died by accident. He had something left there for you.”
“Something left for me?”
Fang Heng was surprised.
Then, a row of game hints appeared in front of his eyes.
“Hint: Dear player, you have triggered a mission, Scavenger Army’s crisis.”
“Name of Mission: Scavenger Army’s crisis.
Difficulty Level of Mission: SS.

Mission Description: The former commander of Scavenger Army, Cook Barn, suddenly died. You have taken over the position of the commander of Scavenger Army. However, you are still facing an unprecedented crisis.

Mission Requirements 1: Please finish the research and development of the divine potion within 3 days. If you fail this mission, the morale points of Scavenger Army will continuously drop significantly.
Mission Requirements 2: Please follow Ni Shengtao into the secret storage room within 1 day to search for the item left behind by Cook Barn. If it’s not done, you will fail this mission.

Mission Requirements 3: Please keep the morale points of Scavenger Army constantly above 20 (the highest will be 200). Once it goes below 40, there will be a defection of your team members. If it’s below 20 for more than an hour, the default result will be mission failure (current morale points: 120).
Mission Reward: You will become the official leader of Scavenger Army and obtain the authority to command all the regions of Scavenger Army.
Penalty for Failure: Scavenger Army will be disbanded. All your Scavenger Army contribution points will be cleared, and your survival points will also be deducted.
Fang Heng carefully checked the mission requirements.
In short, the mission’s most troublesome part was finding a way to make the divine potion.
Perhaps there were some clues about making the potion in the items left behind by Cook Barn?
Ni Shengtao and Osborne both looked at Fang Heng.
Now, Fang Heng had become their hope of survival.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and said, “I see. Take me there now. I’ll find out what Commander Cook has left for me.”
Tenth floor underground.
Outside the secret storage room of the research institute.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne’s expressions were highly solemn. They stood behind Fang Heng, their eyes flashing with deep fear.
Fang Heng was puzzled by their strange reaction.
“What’s wrong?”
“Don’t you feel it, Commander Fang Heng?”
Fang Heng didn’t feel anything. He asked with confusion, “Feel what? What do you mean?”
“It’s...” Ni Shengtao glanced at Osborne and said, “It’s a sort of fear that comes from the heart.”
Fang Heng looked at Osborne. “Do you have this feeling too?”
Osborne nodded solemnly.
“Yes, Commander.”
Fang Heng asked, “What’s in the room?”

“There should be a box. The former commander, Mr. Cook, said he hoped the new commander could get the stuff in the box after taking over the army. It is something significant to the entire Scavenger Army.”
“Okay, I see. Now open the door.”
Ni Shengtao carefully stepped forward and opened the door of the secret storage room with the backup magnetic card.
Fang Heng pushed the door open.
With the primary night vision ability of Vampire Bloodline, Fang Heng observed that the storage room was very empty inside.
There was only a wooden table in the middle of the room.
And there seemed to be a box on the table, but he couldn’t see it clearly.
“Aren’t you coming in?”
“Mr. Cook told us that only you can enter the room.”
“Cook is dead, and his orders are invalid now. Come with me.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he stepped into the room.
“Okay.”
Ni Shengtao and Osborne looked at each other.
They had an instinctive fear of this door.
Suppressing the fear in their hearts, the two of them slowly stepped into the room.
They could not get too close because their fear was too intense. So, Ni Shengtao and Osborne just stood at the room’s entrance.
The six tyrant forms followed Fang Heng into the room and stood behind him.
A humming sound came.
The automatic induction door closed again, and the lights in the room lit up.
Fang Heng slowly walked to the wooden table in the middle of the room.
There was a wooden box on it.
“This is it?”
Fang Heng reached out his hand and touched the wooden box.
“Hint: You have found an unknown wooden box.”
“Item: An unknown wooden box.
Description: It’s an unknown wooden box which looks ordinary.
Description (triggered by the perception attribute of over 30 points): You feel that there might be something dangerous in this wooden box.
Description (triggered by the skill of basic occult Level 7): You feel that there is a strong movement of life energy in the wooden box.
Something dangerous?
Strong life energy?
Fang Heng was on high alert.
Something was wrong!
In the past, his occult skill described even the first-generation meteorites as just an ordinary natural and weak energy.
But there was a powerful energy in this wooden box?
Swoosh!
Fang Heng retracted his hand.
Then, the box shook slightly in front of Fang Heng.
Danger!
Fang Heng suddenly had a bad feeling.
His danger perception skill had been activated.
Fang Heng had not activated this skill for a long time. He quickly reacted and retreated fast.
“Be careful!”
Ni Shengtao also shouted.
In the next moment, the box exploded in front of Fang Heng.
“Buzz...”
The moment the box exploded, Fang Heng heard a buzzing sound in his mind, and his head hurt!
“Hint: You have suffered an unknown spiritual attack.”
Ni Shengtao and Osborne were in a worse state. They had completely lost the ability to control their bodies, freezing on the spot simultaneously.
“Buzz, buzz...”
As the box broke open, dozens of tiny dark purple bugs sprang out from the box and rushed to Fang Heng.
However, their abilities were limited. They flew in midair for less than half a meter before landing on the ground.
This was a spiritual attack!
“What should I do?!”
Fang Heng’s head hurt badly. He could not concentrate on controlling the tyrant forms at all.
He gritted his teeth, and his body was almost out of control. His knees went weak, and he half kneeled on the ground.
Fang Heng watched helplessly as the tiny purple bugs slowly spread toward him!
Soon, Fang Heng flipped his wrist.
Vampiric Spirit Cane!
Using his last bit of strength, Fang Heng smashed his Vampiric Spirit Cane onto the ground.
Meanwhile, he cast the silence spell.
Faint red ripples spread out rapidly from Vampiric Spirit Cane.
It was silence skill, the special skill attached to Vampiric Spirit Cane.

By consuming the owner’s mental strength, it could make all creatures within range unable to use their skills, speak, or use their backpack. This status required continuous spellcasting posture and could last up to 5 seconds.
The hissing sound in Fang Heng’s mind disappeared as soon as the silence skill was activated.
He returned to the clear-headed state.
The purple bugs crawling toward him on the ground were also in the range of the silence skill.
They paused for a moment.
The six tyrant forms immediately received Fang Heng’s order and rushed forward, raising their fists to smash at the bugs on the ground.
“Be quick! We have only five seconds! Finish them off!”
Fang Heng shouted.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne had also recovered and regained control of their bodies.
Hearing that, the two of them charged forward with all their might. They took out their shotguns from their backs and aimed at the purple bugs on the ground, pulling the trigger.
“Boom, boom!”
At close range, the shotgun’s power was unleashed to the maximum.
The twisted and struggling bugs on the ground were blasted into pieces.

Once it goes below 40, there will be a defection of your team members.
If it’s below 20 for more than an hour, the default result will be mission failure (current morale points: 120).

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - Cook Barn’s Notes
paragraphs: “Hint: Your team members have killed an unknown lifeform. You have obtained 6,892 survival points. ”
“Hint: Your team members have killed an unknown lifeform. You have obtained 30 main storyline contribution points. ”
“Hint: player has completed the mission ‘Scavenger Army Crisis (mission requirements 2) : search for Cook Barn’s remnants. ”
After five seconds, the light of the silent domain dissipated.
Phew...
Fang Heng gasped for air.
He was careless.
Who would have expected that it was actually a trap?
Moreover, the worm actually had the ability to use spiritual attacks!
Cook Barn actually wanted to trick him even after his death!
Fang Heng’s face was gloomy as he turned around to look at Ni Shengtao and Osborne.
Both of them were still in fear. Their bodies were drenched in cold sweat, and their faces were pale.
Ni Shengtao put away his shotgun. “Commander Fang Heng, are you okay? ”
“Yes, I’m fine... What is that thing? Do you know? ”
“I’m not sure. This room is very secretive. Mr. Cook never allows outsiders to come near. Other than me and a few trusted aides, no one else knows about the existence of this place. ”
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
Did Cook Barn want to use this worm body to control the next leader of the Scavenger Army?

However, Cook Barn did not calculate that after his death, the next commander had not ever drunk the divine potion, so the worm body’s spiritual attack on him was not as strong as on Ni Shengtao and Osborne.
“Apart from the box, did Cook Barn leave anything behind? For example, a place to store research or confidential information? ”

“The data room is on the 12th basement. When we were attacked by the intruders just now, the data room was still under repair... Ah! That’s right! ” Ni Shengtao suddenly thought of something. “Mr. Cook often stays here alone for an entire night. Sometimes, he brings in and out some things. It’s very mysterious. I was wondering if there’s a special secret passage in this room. ”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“Do you have a blueprint of the research institute’s interior? ”
“Yes. ”
Ni Shengtao took out the internal blueprint that he carried with him and handed it over.
Fang Heng analyzed the blueprint and noticed a small problem with the structure of the building. There might be a hidden room.
Fang Heng slowly walked to the left wall.
Raising his head, Fang Heng clenched his fist and fiercely smashed it against the wall.
Bang!
There it was!
The vibration coming from the wall told Fang Heng that there was something else behind the wall!
Six Tyrant forms strode forward, raised their huge fists, and fiercely smashed them against the wall.
Bang! Bang, bang!
Not long after, a huge crack appeared on the stone wall.
“Do you sense any danger? ” Fang Heng turned to look at Ni Shengtao and Osborne.
The two shook their heads. “I don’t sense anything. ”
“Let’s go in and check it out. ”
“Hint: you’ve discovered the secret research room of Cook Barn. ”
“Hint: you’ve obtained 20 main storyline contribution points. ”
Fang Heng entered the secret room through the opening.
The automatic sensor light in the room lit up.
“Secret research room... related to the main storyline, ” Fang Heng whispered and looked around the research room.
There were rows of bookshelves lined up on the left side of the wall of the research room and a large-sized cultivation pod on the right side.
The cultivation pod was in operation and connected to the experimental table on the other side.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne carefully raised their shotguns and followed Fang Heng into the room.

Just then, Osborne noticed something. His eyelids twitched and he pointed to a metal box placed on the table not far away. “Fang Heng, look at that. It’s that box I told you about before, the one I found in the Meteorite Company’s emergency shelter. ”
Hearing that, Fang Heng immediately looked in the direction Osborne pointed.
The moment he saw the metal box, Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
The outer layer of the metal box was clearly marked with Meteorite Company’s logo!
This time, Fang Heng was careful. He did not walk forward directly. Instead, he controlled the Tyrants to walk forward and pick up the metal box on the table.
The box was not locked.
There seemed to be some damage on the outside.
“It’s empty? ” thought Fang Heng. He walked up and checked the empty box while asking, “Where’s the item inside? ”

Osborne walked up and shook his head as well. “Commander Cook and I found some information related to the first-generation meteorite research in Meteorite Company’s secret shelter. After that, we searched the ruins for a long time before we found the box. ”
He continued, “To be safe, we didn’t open the box immediately. When we returned to the temporary shelter, Commander Cook personally studied the box. I don’t know what was in the box. ”
Fang Heng put down the box and looked around again.
Could the bookshelves... ” he mused.
There was a row of bookshelves on the right side of the room, and in games, books often meant clues.
Fang Heng walked to the bookshelf and picked up a book.
“Hint: you have obtained research notes (November) ”
Book: Cook Barn’s research notes (November) .
Reading requirement: 11 Intellligence, 6 Will.
Description: after reading, you will be able to obtain some experience points related to potion making. There is a very small probability of mastering the skill.

Description (triggered by the mission ‘Scavenger Army Crisis : the book has records of Cook Barn’s research material. It may contain the formula of the divine potion’s formula. After reading it, the success rate of developing the divine potion will be increased.
“Great stuff! These books are materials of Cook Barn’s recent research on worm bodies and potions, and there’s a whole row of them! ” Fang Heng mused as he put the books into his backpack one by one.
When the zombies came back, he would let them read all of them! Then, he might be able to develop the divine potion!
“Eh? ” At the bottom of the bookshelf, Fang Heng discovered an extremely old book covered with a thick layer of dust.
“Hint: you have obtained Cook Barn’s notebook. ”
Fang Heng’s heart stirred. He immediately opened the notebook and flipped through it.
Other than mostly denoting most of the research notes and research insights, the notebook contained diary entries.

October 12th’s entry read: “This is the 475th day of my battle with it. I realized that I’ve already reached a certain balance with it. It can no longer control my will, and I could no longer chase them out of my body. The benefits are obvious. Every aspect of my body has improved dramatically, and I’m even immune to the zombie virus. Maybe this is a way to immunize against the zombie virus? If I could study it further... It’s impossible. The Dark Knights think I’m a monster. Since they won’t accept me, I’ll find the answer in my own way. ”

January 28th’s diary entry read: “Yesterday, I lost control again. The worm body inside me was still trying to eat away at my body. I felt like it was craving something. I will continue resisting it anyway. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - Hidden Ending
paragraphs: February 23rd’s diary entry read: “Over the course of a long day, I formed a team with a group of like-minded friends. The friends proposed our team’s name to be the Scavenger Army. The worm body’s thirst grew stronger and stronger, but my research on the worm body is at a standstill. ”

March 29th’s diary entry read: “The connection to the worm body’s growing stronger and stronger, and I can clearly sense that the worm body inside me is calling me to a place. What exactly is there? Perhaps the answer? ”

June 5th’s diary entry read: “I finally found it! Apparently, this was once the territory of Meteorite Company! It was originally a shelter designed and set up by the company to prepare for a global zombie disaster in advance! The connection came from inside the shelter! ”

June 8th’s diary entry read: “Meteorite Company’s shelter has long been occupied by the zombies. When we checked the periphery, we found that the shelter was badly damaged by some sort of violent explosion. Although it’s very dangerous, we plan to sneak in tomorrow. ”

June 10th’s diary entry read: “It took a long time, but I finally found the source of the connection! I never thought that it came from a metal box! Perhaps it was due to the impact of the explosion, but the outer layer of the metal box was damaged. What’s inside? I have a feeling it’s like Pandora’s Box. Once it’s opened... ”

June 12th’s diary entry read: “Inside the shelter of Meteorite Company, I found the remnants of the research room. From inside, I recovered some confidential information. A long time ago, Meteorite Company halted a certain experiment, codename Hila. I wonder what the experiment was about. In the only records, Hila was interrupted because of some external factors. After that, Meteorite Company blocked almost all the related information about the experiment. Meteorite Company even put the related experimental product leftovers of Hila into 12 special metal boxes, and through their authority, they hid the metal boxes in every corner of the world. That’s right! The box I found is probably the box of Hila. But the strange thing is, why didn’t Meteorite Company choose to destroy the experimental products instead of storing them in such a strange way? Why did they go through so much trouble and hide the products in 12 corners of the world? Was it really necessary to do so? I don’t know. ”

July 15th’s diary entry read: “It’s been over a month. After returning to the shelter, I’ve done a lot of research on the metal box. Due to the big explosion at Meteorite Company’s shelter, the outer layer of the metal box is greatly damaged. Maybe that’s why the worm body in my body can feel its presence. I can’t research any further without completely opening the metal box. It’s time to make a decision. I’m opening it! ”

July 16th’s diary entry read: “I’ve been out cold for a full day! I’m pretty sure that I’ve been infected by the special worm body in the box! I did a quick check, and there didn’t seem to be any symptoms other than being out cold. Okay, let me try to sort my thoughts. There’s some wriggling flesh complex in the box. When I tried to test it, I found worms in the tissue. I think I was infected by the worm body then and passed out... I just finished the test and confirmed that the tissue is a human tissue sample. The scary thing is, it’s still alive! Those worm bodies have a terrifying will to live! The tissue is more like a host for the worm bodies! I understand now. It’s not that Meteorite Company didn’t want to destroy the Hila experimental tissue sample, but they simply couldn’t do it! What the hell is Meteorite Company doing! I need to do a detailed check, including the tissue sample, the worm bodies, and myself... ”
May 17th’s diary entry read: “Dawn is coming. Let’s welcome the new world together. This world, together with me... ”
The contents of the notebook came to an abrupt end there.

Fang Heng closed the book and lowered his head in silence, pondering, “Box, Hila experiment, and the mysterious worm body. So... According to the contents of the notebook, Cook Barn was only completely controlled by the worm body after he was infected by the parasitic worm body, huh? He was only able to develop the divine potion after he was controlled by the worm body. It seems like all of Cook Barn’s previous guesses were off the mark... ”
Fang Heng had a vague feeling that he had caught onto something.
He found that the entire Zombie Apocalypse game story had a rough outline and tried to reconstruct the story.
Fang Heng tried to reconstruct the story.

“At the very beginning, Meng City experienced a meteorite crash, and the researchers discovered the special ability of the first-generation meteorite. After that, the first-generation meteorite was purchased by a large corporation, and Meteorite Company was founded. During one of the experiments of the research team on the first-generation meteorite named Hila, Meteorite Company must have discovered an unknown worm body. Perhaps the scale of the Hila experiment exceeded Meteorite Company’s expectations, or there might have been some accident. Therefore, Meteorite Company terminated the Hila project and divided the tissue samples of Hila into 12 parts, hiding them in every corner of the world. After that, Meteorite Company used another method to study the first-generation meteorite and developed the first-generation virus. Subsequently, the zombie apocalypse broke out. The Dark Knights and Cook Barn were accidentally infected with the worm virus through the first-generation meteorite. Sensing the existence of Hila’s tissue, Cook Barn searched for the secret of the worm body. Osborne looked eagerly at the notebook in Fang Heng’s hand.
Now, all their lives were in Fang Heng’s hands.
“Commander Fang, do you have any clues? ”

sentences.text: February 23rd’s diary entry read: “Over the course of a long day, I formed a team with a group of like-minded friends.
The friends proposed our team’s name to be the Scavenger Army.
The worm body’s thirst grew stronger and stronger, but my research on the worm body is at a standstill. ”
March 29th’s diary entry read: “The connection to the worm body’s growing stronger and stronger, and I can clearly sense that the worm body inside me is calling me to a place.
What exactly is there?
Perhaps the answer? ”
June 5th’s diary entry read: “I finally found it!
Apparently, this was once the territory of Meteorite Company!
It was originally a shelter designed and set up by the company to prepare for a global zombie disaster in advance!
The connection came from inside the shelter! ”
June 8th’s diary entry read: “Meteorite Company’s shelter has long been occupied by the zombies.
When we checked the periphery, we found that the shelter was badly damaged by some sort of violent explosion.
Although it’s very dangerous, we plan to sneak in tomorrow. ”
June 10th’s diary entry read: “It took a long time, but I finally found the source of the connection!
I never thought that it came from a metal box!
Perhaps it was due to the impact of the explosion, but the outer layer of the metal box was damaged.
What’s inside?
I have a feeling it’s like Pandora’s Box.
Once it’s opened... ”
June 12th’s diary entry read: “Inside the shelter of Meteorite Company, I found the remnants of the research room.
From inside, I recovered some confidential information.
A long time ago, Meteorite Company halted a certain experiment, codename Hila.
I wonder what the experiment was about.
In the only records, Hila was interrupted because of some external factors.
After that, Meteorite Company blocked almost all the related information about the experiment.
Meteorite Company even put the related experimental product leftovers of Hila into 12 special metal boxes, and through their authority, they hid the metal boxes in every corner of the world.
That’s right!
The box I found is probably the box of Hila.
But the strange thing is, why didn’t Meteorite Company choose to destroy the experimental products instead of storing them in such a strange way?
Why did they go through so much trouble and hide the products in 12 corners of the world?
Was it really necessary to do so?
I don’t know. ”
July 15th’s diary entry read: “It’s been over a month.
After returning to the shelter, I’ve done a lot of research on the metal box.
Due to the big explosion at Meteorite Company’s shelter, the outer layer of the metal box is greatly damaged.
Maybe that’s why the worm body in my body can feel its presence.
I can’t research any further without completely opening the metal box.
It’s time to make a decision.
I’m opening it! ”
July 16th’s diary entry read: “I’ve been out cold for a full day!
I’m pretty sure that I’ve been infected by the special worm body in the box!
I did a quick check, and there didn’t seem to be any symptoms other than being out cold.
Okay, let me try to sort my thoughts.
There’s some wriggling flesh complex in the box.
When I tried to test it, I found worms in the tissue.
I think I was infected by the worm body then and passed out...
I just finished the test and confirmed that the tissue is a human tissue sample.
The scary thing is, it’s still alive!
Those worm bodies have a terrifying will to live!
The tissue is more like a host for the worm bodies!
I understand now.
It’s not that Meteorite Company didn’t want to destroy the Hila experimental tissue sample, but they simply couldn’t do it!
What the hell is Meteorite Company doing!
I need to do a detailed check, including the tissue sample, the worm bodies, and myself... ”
May 17th’s diary entry read: “Dawn is coming.
Let’s welcome the new world together.
This world, together with me... ”
The contents of the notebook came to an abrupt end there.
Fang Heng closed the book and lowered his head in silence, pondering, “Box, Hila experiment, and the mysterious worm body.
So...
According to the contents of the notebook, Cook Barn was only completely controlled by the worm body after he was infected by the parasitic worm body, huh?
He was only able to develop the divine potion after he was controlled by the worm body.
It seems like all of Cook Barn’s previous guesses were off the mark... ”
Fang Heng had a vague feeling that he had caught onto something.
He found that the entire Zombie Apocalypse game story had a rough outline and tried to reconstruct the story.
Fang Heng tried to reconstruct the story.
“At the very beginning, Meng City experienced a meteorite crash, and the researchers discovered the special ability of the first-generation meteorite.
After that, the first-generation meteorite was purchased by a large corporation, and Meteorite Company was founded.
During one of the experiments of the research team on the first-generation meteorite named Hila, Meteorite Company must have discovered an unknown worm body.
Perhaps the scale of the Hila experiment exceeded Meteorite Company’s expectations, or there might have been some accident.
Therefore, Meteorite Company terminated the Hila project and divided the tissue samples of Hila into 12 parts, hiding them in every corner of the world.
After that, Meteorite Company used another method to study the first-generation meteorite and developed the first-generation virus.
Subsequently, the zombie apocalypse broke out.
The Dark Knights and Cook Barn were accidentally infected with the worm virus through the first-generation meteorite.
Sensing the existence of Hila’s tissue, Cook Barn searched for the secret of the worm body.
However, he was unfortunately infected by the worm body inside Hila’s tissue and was completely controlled by the worm body? ” Fang Heng frowned and scratched his hair.
“So, the rational guess is that the life form sample of Hila is the ‘final boss?

What exactly is the Hila experiment? ”
