chapters.title: Chapter 430 - The Hila Experiment
paragraphs: “Hint: you have discovered Hila’s living tissue. ”
Item: Hila living tissue.
Description: an extremely dangerous living tissue that can not be brought into the backpack.
“So the Hila living tissue in the box was here! ” Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and carefully looked at the flesh inside the cultivation pod.
Tiny worm bodies were growing inside the flesh.
“And this is... ? ” Fang Heng thought as he continued to observe.
The entire cultivation pod was connected to a large catheter. After dozens of processes, the catheter was finally connected to the test bench at the side.
Drops of liquid were passing through the catheter and finally dripping into the flask below.
Half of the turbid liquid had already accumulated in the flask.
Fang Heng held the flask in his hand and observed it.
“Hint: player has discovered an unknown liquid. ”

“Hint: player’s current intermediate potion making level is level 16, and player’s current potionology level is level 5. Lack of relevant information. Overall criteria is not met. Unable to obtain information related to the liquid. ”
“Hint: player can spend 1,000 survival points to carry out occult analysis. Try to obtain more clues and information. ”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Proceed with the analysis. ”
The bottle containing the turbid liquid was wrapped by a gentle strength and floated in mid-air.
Bang!
The bottle exploded.
A line of game hint appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.

“Hint: player has completed occult analysis. Combining player’s potionology skill, intermediate potion making skill, and information related to the Hila experiment, it has been determined that the liquid is the original liquid of the unknown worm body. ”

“Original liquid of worm body! ” Almost instantly, Fang Heng came to a realization. “Cook Barn developed the divine potion after discovering the Hila living tissue! No wonder the supply of divine potions has always been extremely limited! It turns out that the original fluid needed to make the divine potion relies on this type of Hila tissue for worm body culture... So now that I have the mixture, I should theoretically be able to make the divine potion! ”

He continued musing, “After the ordinary zombies come back, I’ll read through the books in the room. Then, I’ll probably be able to complete the first mission requirements of controlling the Scavenger Army, and it won’t be a problem for me to obtain the command authority of the entire Scavenger Army! As for the next step... If I want to trigger a more hidden ending, I’ll need to gather information related to the Hila experiment... I might have to start with the 12 boxes of Meteorite Company. Cook Barn’s already built the electromagnetic tower needed to locate the boxes. Now, I’ll just need to focus on the Federation. ”

Fang Heng then thought, “While I think of ways to increase the strength of the Scavenger Army and deal with the territory occupied by the Federation, I’ll search for information related to the Hila experiment. I’ll have to act quickly! ”
Thereafter, he stated, “Tidy up an empty laboratory for me. I need to start developing the divine potion immediately. ”
Osborne cupped his fists in excitement. “Yes! We’ll go and prepare immediately! ”
“Okay. I need a bigger one. ” Fang Heng thought for a moment and added, “The bigger the better. ”

Ni Shengtao’s mind was on the divine potion. After finishing the maintenance of the research base, he immediately gathered more than a dozen potioneers and returned to the fifth basement of the army headquarters.
Then, he saw many Scavenger Army elites crowding in the passage, moving large boxes back and forth to the large-sized laboratory.
Ni Shengtao was a little confused for a moment.
“Be careful with the two boxes over there. It’s filled with liquid! Be careful to handle it lightly! ” Osborne was at the side, directing the handling.
Ni Shengtao walked forward and asked, “What’s the situation? Why are there so many boxes? ”

“They were requested by Commander Fang Heng. Other than the information found in the secret research room, the boxes also include the file reports and research materials that were sorted out from the 12th basement data room. He wants to look through all of them. ”
Ni Shengtao gulped.

Originally, seeing that there were several bookshelves of information hidden in the secret research room, Ni Shengtao thought that Fang Heng alone could not read through them and gathered all the potioneers in the headquarters to help out. He had hoped to at least be of some help and speed up the progress of research and development.
But now, with so much information at hand, not to mention more than over a dozen people, even more than 100 people wouldn’t be able to read them all.
“With so many books, can the commander really finish reading all of them? ”

“Not just that. ” Osborne shrugged. “There are also medicinal ingredients. The commander asked us to move a lot of medicinal ingredients into the laboratory. He said that we need to carry out experimental research when the time comes. ”
Ni Shengtao smiled bitterly. “Seriously? So much? ”
He finally understood why Fang Heng needed such a large research room. An ordinary small research room really couldn’t fit so many books and medicinal ingredients.

“Commander Fang Heng naturally has his reasons. ” Osborne had some confidence in Fang Heng. He had personally witnessed Fang Heng’s feat of refining thousands of bottles of potions in one night. “Most of the things have been prepared. I’ll go and report to the commander. ”
Ni Shengtao sighed in his heart and followed him. “I’ll go with you. I’ve gathered all the potioneers from the headquarters. I hope they can be of help. ”
In the laboratory, Fang Heng was sitting in a corner of the room. He had just finished reading a book.
It took too much time for ordinary zombie clones to go all the way there. They might as well self-destruct on the spot and wait for more than six hours before being resurrected.
Taking advantage of the time when the zombie clones were being resurrected, Fang Heng casually took out a book that he had found in the secret room of Cook Barn and started reading it.
“Hint: player has completed the reading of Cook Barn’s notebook (13) . ”

“Hint: player can now choose to carry out the research and development of the divine potion formula. Player’s current skills of potionology and intermediate potion making have been combined. Player’s current success rate of the divine potion research and development has increased by 0.3% . Current success rate of the research and development of the divine potion formula: 5.3% . ”

“Hint: when the success rate of research and development reaches 100% , player can directly obtain the divine potion formula. Player can increase the success rate of potion research and development through manual experiments using medicinal ingredients. If the experiment is successful, player can directly obtain the divine potion formula. ”
At only 5.3% , the success rate was too low.
Fang Heng put the book in his hand aside and glanced at the game time.
There were only ten minutes left before the zombie clones could be resurrected.
When the time came, he would have the zombie clones make a surprise attack before the exam and read all the boxes of books. Then, he would pile up the success rate!
There was no need to conduct manual experiments at all.
It would be too much of a waste of the original fluid of worm body generated by the Hila tissue.
“Commander Fang Heng. ”
Fang Heng was interrupted in his thoughts and raised his head.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne led more than ten potioneers into the room. “All the potioneers from the headquarters are here. In addition, the medicinal ingredients you need have been prepared. ”
“Oh? What? Potioneers? ”
Fang Heng was puzzled for a moment. He glanced at the potioneers behind Ni Shengtao.
“I asked them to come here. I thought they could be of help in organizing the information and the research of the divine potion... ”
“No need. ” Fang Heng waved his hand. “Have them go back and rest well. Leave the rest to me. ”
Ni Shengtao was stunned. “You really don’t need them to help? ”
“Yeah, it’s okay. ” Fang Heng stood up as he spoke and pushed Ni Shengtao and the others outside.
“But, Commander Fang Heng... ”
“All right, I got it. I need to concentrate on the research of the divine potion. Don’t disturb me if there’s nothing else. ”
Bang!

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - Intense Reading
paragraphs: The laboratory’s door was slammed shut.

Outside the door, Osborne and Ni Shengtao looked at each other confusedly, thinking in unison, “What’s going on? The commander doesn’t need anyone’s help? Commander Cook didn’t seem to be like this when he was researching potions in the past. ”
Extremely puzzled, Ni Shengtao asked, “Has Commander Fang Heng always done potion research like this? ”
Osborne recalled for a moment and nodded slightly.
“Huh? ” Ni Shengtao responded.
Osborne didn’t know how to explain. He just nodded and said, “Wait patiently. ”
The matter was very important. The two of them didn’t have the intention to leave. They just stood guard at the door, worried, waiting for Fang Heng’s new orders at any time.
In the room, Fang Heng waited quietly.
Ten minutes later, rays of one alchemy magic array after another appeared on the hall’s floor.
One by one, gray arms extended from the magic arrays, and the zombie clones struggled to crawl out.
They accepted Fang Heng’s orders and stood up shakily to the side of the laboratory, then lined up to take out books from the boxes.
Each zombie clone had a book in their hands. They found an empty space in the laboratory and sat down. Long channeling bars popped out of their heads as they started reading.
The skill “Efficient reading” was triggered. Given their unlimited Vitality, the zombie clones’ reading efficiency increased exponentially!
Fang Heng took out a bag of Oreos as well as a bottle of yogurt from his backpack and waited silently.
“Haa! ” Fang Heng let out a long sigh.
Learning was actually very easy.
Half an hour later, a hint appeared in the game log.

“Hint: your zombie clone has completed reading the summary of February’s research on the unknown worm body. Success rate of divine potion research has increased by 0.17% . Current success rate is 5.47% .
Three hours later, Fang Heng watched as the success rate of the divine potion research gradually increase to 100% .
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed reading the researcher’s daily report. Success rate of divine potion research has increased by by 0.04% .
“Hint: your success rate of divine potion research has reached 100% . You have obtained the divine potion formula. ”
“Hint: your potionology skill experience points have increased by 21. ”
Phew!
It was done!

Fang Heng stretched his body and opened the game log. He looked at the materials needed for the divine potion and began to ponder, “If the warlord potion can be improved, then the divine potion can also be improved... ”
After all, he would have to fight the Federation head-on.
At the current stage, the strength of the Scavenger Army was not enough.
It would be better if it could be improved even a little bit.
Thinking of that, Fang Heng dropped a sleeping bag on the ground and went offline.

“God! The Scavenger Army collapsed? The Federation are f*cking bullies! They killed the boss of the Scavenger Army from the get-go? How unreasonable! God! ” Mo Jiawei had just learned the news of Cook Barn’s death from his friend not long ago. He was anxious and immediately found Fang Heng to discuss countermeasures.
In the study, Fang Heng was studying potions.
He had long heard Mo Jiawei’s shouts coming from the back garden and had no choice but to get up and leave the study.
“God, I was looking for you. ”
Shh.
Fang Heng made a soft hand gesture to Mo Jiawei who had hurried over.
Mo Jiawei was stunned. “What? ”
“Xiao Ruoruo is analyzing potions in the study. Keep your voice down and don’t disturb her. ”
Mo Jiawei blinked his eyes and lowered his voice. “No, I mean, what’s the situation, God? The Scavenger Army has collapsed, and you guys are still studying potions? ”

“Old Mr. Mo, isn’t your information a little outdated? ” Fang Heng pointed at himself and said seriously, “I’m officially introducing myself to you. I’m Fang Heng, the commander of the Scavenger Army of District 7. ”
“Huh? Commander? ” Mo Jiawei was stunned again, but he immediately reacted. “God, you mean you became the boss of the Scavenger Army? Wait, didn’t you say you were going to be a mole? ”
Ahem.

Fang Heng coughed lightly. “You know, the Dark Knights were bewitched by the Federation and suspected me of jumping ship. In addition, my reputation in the Scavenger Army is still very high, and I am highly regarded by my colleagues. I was unanimously recommended by everyone, so... ”
“So you jumped ship? ”
Fang Heng corrected him, “It’s not jumping ship. It’s commanding the Scavenger Army. ”
“Ah, uh... Okay. ” Mo Jiawei did not know how to retort for a moment.

He quickly thought of something and clapped his hands excitedly. “I get it. That’s why you are in a hurry to develop the divine potion! Now, there are rumors outside that with the death of Commander Cook Barn, the entire Scavenger Army will fall into a berserk state for a period of time. I guess the Scavenger Army’s showing withdrawal symptoms from losing their divine potion supply, right? ”
Fang Heng nodded and said, “Yes, you guessed right. Only by developing the divine potion can I truly control the Scavenger Army. ”
“Then what’s the situation now? There must be a way to develop the divine potion, right? ” asked Mo Jiawei.
“Developing the divine potion is not a big problem. We have already entered the optimization stage. Oh right, don’t leak this news for the time being. ”
“Really? It’s completed so quickly? ! ” Mo Jiawei’s eyes lit up when he heard that, and his mood surged!
Amazing!
God was indeed a god. He had completed the divine potion in such a short period of time.
That meant that the Scavenger Army would most likely stabilize and that Fang Heng was most likely guaranteed to secure his position as the commander of the Scavenger Army in District 7.
“Those idiots from the Federation. They killed Cook Barn and ended up helping Fang Heng to be the boss. God will be officially promoted as their commander! ” thought Mo Jiawei.
He then asked, “God, then should we control the Scavengers Army and start a head-on war with the Federation? ”

As Mo Jiawei spoke, he became more and more excited, “Awesome! To be honest, I’ve long been unhappy with the Federation of District 7! In the past, we secretly controlled them, but now, we’re going to officially fight it out with the Federation! ”
“Yeah, it’s most likely going to be a fight. ” Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
He came from another world, so he didn’t have much respect for the local forces of the Federation.
However, there was still a clear gap in strength between the two sides at the moment, and the Scavenger Army of District 7 was still at a huge disadvantage.
To change the situation, developing the modified divine potion was only the first step.

“But... ” After the initial excitement, Mo Jiawei was a little worried. He mused, “It’s the Federation we’re talking about. North River Heavy Industry is considered pretty influential in this area, but in the past few years, we’ve been restricted by the Federation in all aspects. The implications of starting a fight with the Federation are too large. I want to recklessly fight the Federation with Fang Heng, but North River Heavy Industry’s fate is in my hands... ”
Mo Jiawei then asked, “But Fang Heng... W-What if the Federation plays dirty? ”
He had to consider the worst case scenario.

“We used to go against the Federation behind the scenes. Now that you’ve become the commander of the Scavenger Army, the Federation will definitely find trouble with you when the time comes. What if they slander you and label you as part of the anti-federation forces? What if you’re wanted by the whole world? ”
Once he was deemed related to the anti-federation forces, Fang Heng would become a wanted criminal in the real world.
At that time, the Federation’s Investigation Team would not be the only ones who would look for him.

The commander doesn’t need anyone’s help?
Commander Cook didn’t seem to be like this when he was researching potions in the past. ”
Extremely puzzled, Ni Shengtao asked, “Has Commander Fang Heng always done potion research like this? ”
Osborne recalled for a moment and nodded slightly.
“Huh? ” Ni Shengtao responded.
Osborne didn’t know how to explain.
He just nodded and said, “Wait patiently. ”
The matter was very important.
The two of them didn’t have the intention to leave.

In the room, Fang Heng waited quietly.
Ten minutes later, rays of one alchemy magic array after another appeared on the hall’s floor.
One by one, gray arms extended from the magic arrays, and the zombie clones struggled to crawl out.
They accepted Fang Heng’s orders and stood up shakily to the side of the laboratory, then lined up to take out books from the boxes.
Each zombie clone had a book in their hands.
They found an empty space in the laboratory and sat down.
Long channeling bars popped out of their heads as they started reading.
The skill “Efficient reading” was triggered.
Given their unlimited Vitality, the zombie clones’ reading efficiency increased exponentially!
Fang Heng took out a bag of Oreos as well as a bottle of yogurt from his backpack and waited silently.
“Haa! ” Fang Heng let out a long sigh.
Learning was actually very easy.
Half an hour later, a hint appeared in the game log.
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed reading the summary of February’s research on the unknown worm body.
Success rate of divine potion research has increased by 0.17% .
Current success rate is 5.47% .
Three hours later, Fang Heng watched as the success rate of the divine potion research gradually increase to 100% .
“Hint: your zombie clone has completed reading the researcher’s daily report.
Success rate of divine potion research has increased by by 0.04% .
“Hint: your success rate of divine potion research has reached 100% .
You have obtained the divine potion formula. ”
“Hint: your potionology skill experience points have increased by 21. ”
Phew!
It was done!
Fang Heng stretched his body and opened the game log.
He looked at the materials needed for the divine potion and began to ponder, “If the warlord potion can be improved, then the divine potion can also be improved... ”
After all, he would have to fight the Federation head-on.
At the current stage, the strength of the Scavenger Army was not enough.
It would be better if it could be improved even a little bit.
Thinking of that, Fang Heng dropped a sleeping bag on the ground and went offline.

The Scavenger Army collapsed?
The Federation are f*cking bullies!
They killed the boss of the Scavenger Army from the get-go?
How unreasonable!

He had long heard Mo Jiawei’s shouts coming from the back garden and had no choice but to get up and leave the study.
“God, I was looking for you. ”
Shh.
Fang Heng made a soft hand gesture to Mo Jiawei who had hurried over.
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
“What? ”
“Xiao Ruoruo is analyzing potions in the study.
Keep your voice down and don’t disturb her. ”
Mo Jiawei blinked his eyes and lowered his voice.
“No, I mean, what’s the situation, God?
The Scavenger Army has collapsed, and you guys are still studying potions? ”
“Old Mr.
Mo, isn’t your information a little outdated? ” Fang Heng pointed at himself and said seriously, “I’m officially introducing myself to you.
I’m Fang Heng, the commander of the Scavenger Army of District 7. ”

Commander? ” Mo Jiawei was stunned again, but he immediately reacted.
“God, you mean you became the boss of the Scavenger Army?
Wait, didn’t you say you were going to be a mole? ”
Ahem.
Fang Heng coughed lightly.
“You know, the Dark Knights were bewitched by the Federation and suspected me of jumping ship.
In addition, my reputation in the Scavenger Army is still very high, and I am highly regarded by my colleagues.
I was unanimously recommended by everyone, so... ”
“So you jumped ship? ”
Fang Heng corrected him, “It’s not jumping ship.
It’s commanding the Scavenger Army. ”

Okay. ” Mo Jiawei did not know how to retort for a moment.
He quickly thought of something and clapped his hands excitedly.

That’s why you are in a hurry to develop the divine potion!
Now, there are rumors outside that with the death of Commander Cook Barn, the entire Scavenger Army will fall into a berserk state for a period of time.
I guess the Scavenger Army’s showing withdrawal symptoms from losing their divine potion supply, right? ”

We have already entered the optimization stage.
Oh right, don’t leak this news for the time being. ”

It’s completed so quickly? ! ” Mo Jiawei’s eyes lit up when he heard that, and his mood surged!
Amazing!

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - I Was Kidnapped
paragraphs: “What’s there to be afraid of? Just charge ahead. At worst, I’ll just hide in the game. ” Fang Heng snorted in disdain, “If they have the ability, then the Federation can come and kill me in the game. ”
Mo Jiawei looked at Fang Heng, and his heart surged with excitement. “All right! A real man should just charge ahead! F*ck the Federation! ”

Fang Heng chuckled as he said, “Oh right, go to the Federation and report that I suddenly disappeared last night and haven’t been found for more than 24 hours. Tell them that you suspect I might have been taken away by the Night Owl organization. ”
“Huh? What? ” Mo Jiawei’s heart was surging with excitement, but when he heard that, he was stunned again. He looked at Fang Heng with a dumbfounded expression.

“Stupid, we’re all adults now. We only became strong in District 7, not the other districts. We have to leave ourselves a way out. Whether the Federation believes it or not, we can use the excuse to our advantage in the future if necessary. ”

Fang Heng continued, “In short, during this period of time, I’ll hide in the game. When the time comes, I’ll just blame it on Night Owl. Just say that I was forced by Night Owl to fight with the Federation in District 7... ”
“This... ” Mo Jiawei thought carefully, “Dang! God always has his ways with playing dirty. Being kidnapped by the Night Owl organization is a great excuse! ”
“How is it? Have you thought it through? ” asked Fang Heng.
Mo Jiawei nodded repeatedly. “I understand the logic, but God, why do you look more and more like a big villain now? ”
Fang Heng silently rolled his eyes. “Get lost! ”
“Fine, I’ll make the report right now... ”
“Wait. ” Fang Heng reached out to stop Mo Jiawei and said solemnly, “What’s the situation outside in District 7 now? ”

“The players in District 7 all think that the Scavenger Army is going to be finished soon. Every player guild is afraid of being targeted by the crazy Scavenger Army. Even the Federation has entered a state of martial law and has concentrated their defenses. There’s no other news. ”
“Concentrated their defenses? ” thought Fang Heng as his heart skipped a beat.
It was early the next morning.
Osborne and Ni Shengtao were still guarding the laboratory’s entrance, sleeplessly.
Now, all their hopes of survival were placed on Fang Heng!
If the divine potion research and development could not be completed, the entire Scavenger Army would definitely collapse.
They were about to run out of time. There were still two days left.
Click.
A gap opened in the laboratory’s door.
Both of them were shocked at the same time and turned to look at Fang Heng who walked out of the laboratory.
“Commander Fang Heng. ” Osborne said in a deep voice, “Did you encounter a problem? Do you need any materials? We will immediately prepare them. ”
“Everything is normal. ” Fang Heng smiled warmly and took out a bottle of newly developed potion and handed it to Osborne. “Come, come, come. I have just developed the latest potion. Try it out. ”
“Potion? ” Osborne was stunned. He took the bottle of green potion from Fang Heng in disbelief.
“This is... the divine potion! ? ” Osborne already had the answer in his heart, but he still asked with uncertainty, hand trembling slightly.
“Of course. Try it. ”
Osborne took a deep breath, twisted open the bottle cap, and drank the divine potion in one gulp.
A scorching hot current flowed down his throat.
Osborne’s pupils constricted slightly.
The needle-like burning sensation instantly flowed through his entire body!
It was not an ordinary divine potion but a modified one!
Osborne felt his heart beating wildly, the veins on his neck bulging, and a berserk strength surging in his body.
He felt his entire body on fire.
NI Shengtao asked anxiously, “Osborne, how is it? ”
Osborne kept quiet. He gritted his teeth, turned his head, and threw a punch at the wall to the side.
Bang!
With a heavy muffled sound, the alloy wall was smashed, and a fist print was engraved in it.
Phew!
Osborne withdrew his hand and let out a heavy breath. “I’m doing really good. ”
“Looks like it isn’t too bad. ” Fang Heng licked his lips.
The divine potion was divided into three grades: high, middle, and low.
After being modified, the divine potion could allow the parasitic worm body’s ability to be further enhanced, and the user’s physical fitness would be strengthened once again!
Naturally, negative effects also existed.

The parasitic host would also become more emotionally excited, more bloodthirsty, and more prone to being affected by external emotions. The time between each use of the potion would be greatly shortened.
Osborne looked at Fang Heng and kneeled on one knee. “Commander Fang Heng, congratulations on completing the modification of the divine potion! ”
Then, a row of game hints appeared in front of Fang Heng.
“Hint: you have completed the development of the divine potion ”
“Hint: you have completed the modification of the divine potion. The morale of the Scavenger Army has increased slightly. ”
“Hint: you have completed the mission ‘Scavenger Army Crisis’ ahead of time. You have obtained all the command and control rights of the Scavenger Army ahead of time. ”
“Hint: you have obtained the recognition of all the regional commanders of the Scavenger Army. Your honor level has been upgraded to maximum level of Scavenger Army commander. ”
“Hint: your reputation points in the Scavenger Army has reached the maximum. ”
At the same time, in Edge Creek Town.
Cheng Ya and the other two who were waiting in the center of the square were stunned.
A game hint flashed in front of their eyes.
“Hint: after the recommendation of the various regional commanders of the Scavenger Army, Fang Heng has officially become the commander of the Scavenger Army. ”
“Fang Heng? ! Him? Commander? ! ” Seeing the name in the game hint, Cheng Ya and the other two were shocked.
What was going on?
How did Fang Heng become the commander?
In the headquarters of District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse, a combat conference was being held.
Kou Huai’s index finger lightly tapped on the table.
The entire Federation had made ample preparations. They were all cowering and defending against the potential crazy retaliation of the Scavenger Army after the death of Cook Barn.
However, it was very strange.
It had clearly been almost a day, yet the Federation hadn’t received even any reports of an attack.
The Scavenger Army was frighteningly quiet.
Why was it so quiet?
Kou Huai had an uneasy premonition in his heart.
There might be a great danger lying in wait.
“We think this is a normal situation. ” Xiao Changle, the head of the intelligence department of District 7, spoke with certainty and appeared very confident.

He looked around at the many commanders who had come to participate in the combat conference. “I can’t be too clear about the details of the main storyline. As you can see, the members of the Scavenger Army have great strength, and this strength requires a price... ”

Xiao Changle continued, “They need to take a special potion for a long time. Our Zombie Apocalypse’s intelligence department is sure that only Cook Barn has the ability to make this potion. Once the potion is lost, the entire Scavenger Army will suffer withdrawal symptoms and die... ”
As they were speaking, the door to the conference room was gently pushed open.

“Sir! ” A Federation soldier hurriedly walked into the hall. “It’s an emergency. An insider in the Scavenger Army received news that five minutes ago, Fang Heng has become the new commander of the Scavenger Army. ”
“What did you say? ”

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - Useless Teammates
paragraphs: Hearing the report, Kou Huai stood up from his chair and stared at the soldier. “What’s going on? Tell me clearly! ”
The Federation soldier who came to report felt that he was being targeted by a fierce beast, and his heart trembled.
That was all the information he had received. How could he be more specific?
“I have confirmed that Fang Heng has become the new commander of the Scavenger Army... ”
Kou Huai stood still for a moment, countless thoughts flashing through his mind.

How could it be? Fang Heng had become the new commander of the Scavenger Army? Was it a joke? He had never thought that the plot of District 7 could develop like that, and even the analysis report of the intelligence department had never given such a possibility. How useless was the intelligence department?

“This is impossible! ” The head of the intelligence department, Xiao Changle, also stood up when he heard that and said sternly, “Impossible! This has never happened before. We have also tested it in other districts, and it is difficult to increase one’s Scavenger Army contribution points. Unless the contribution points are maxed out, it is impossible to meet the most basic promotion conditions, and even maxing out the points is a mere possible theory. Other than that, there are hidden conditions that are realistically impossible to achieve. We need more information to study. Fang Heng must have used other special methods... ”
“Shut up! ” Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly, suppressing the urge to tear apart Xiao Changle alive.
“Study? At this juncture? What’s the point? ! ” he thought.

“Sir, please calm down. Even if Fang Heng has taken over the Scavenger Army, the destruction of the army is still within our expectations. We only need to stick to the original plan for three months, and the crisis will naturally be resolved. ”
“It’s not the same. ” Another shelter commander shook his head and retorted, “Once a player controls the Scavenger Army, the threat they can pose will be greatly increased. ”
The commanders of District 7 then began to discuss discreetly.
“Moreover, that person is Fang Heng, who also has the ability to control a zombie team. ”
“However, if the Scavenger Army loses its supply of potions, they might lose control. Fang Heng might not be able to control them completely... ”

“I think we should immediately pressure Fang Heng to disband the Scavenger Army and apply for an arrest warrant from our superiors. We can report that Fang Heng is suspected of participating in the terrorist action in District 7 and might be related to the anti-federation forces. We should bring hi under control first and then make a judgment. ”

Kou Huai took a deep breath and barely managed to remain calm. He mused, “How can it be so easy to bring Fang Heng under control? It’s not like I haven’t tried before. Fang Heng has the North River Heavy Industry backing him, and the North River Heavy Industry has influence within the Federation. As long as they are willing, they can delay the arrest warrant approval for a month. ”
Kou Huai turned around and stared at the head of the intelligence department, Xiao Changle, in the eye. He wished he could swallow him alive and sacrifice him to the heavens!
“Xiao Changle, can you guarantee that? Can you guarantee that Fang Heng won’t be able to develop the divine potion? ”
Facing Kou Huai’s murderous gaze, Xiao Changle felt a little guilty and didn’t dare to answer for a moment.
Kou Huai was burning with anger. He shouted sternly, “I’m asking you a question. Can you guarantee that the Scavenger Army will disappear completely in three months? ! ”
Xiao Changle replied with fear and trepidation, “I guarantee that the divine potion will never be developed within three months... ”
Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly, his heart filled with hatred.
First, it was the large-sized guilds in District 7, and presently, it was the Federation’s own intelligence department.
How could he meet so many useless teammates? !
The matter had developed to the current point, and District 7 was in big trouble!
Once Fang Heng agreed to command the Scavenger Army, he would be more of a threat than Cook Barn, much greater!
Kou Huai no longer believed Xiao Changle’s answer at all.
If Fang Heng really developed the divine potion, he would have complete control over the Scavenger Army! Coupled with his large-sized zombie team, Fang Heng’s power would be unthinkable.
Kou Huai had spent a lot of time and effort to plan the execution, but it ended up helping Fang Heng greatly. He had helped to nurture a monster that could destroy District 7.
“No! That won’t happen. It won’t... ” Kou Huai comforted himself inwardly. He controlled himself to focus on the present and not think about the worst.
“Fang Heng! ” Kou Huai gnashed his teeth. He had no choice but to calm down and face the present terrible situation.
What he was currently worried about was not the main storyline. It was Fang Heng, a ticking time bomb.
What if Fang Heng refused to even negotiate?
For a moment, Kou Huai felt that Fang Heng was 100 times more difficult to deal with than the anti-federal organization!
“Sir. ”
“Yes? ”

“There’s another thing I have to report to you. About an hour ago, Fang Heng’s main storyline contribution points increased significantly by 12,000 points. He has already beccome the fourth place on the main storyline leaderboard rankings of District 7. ”
“What? ! ”
The news of Fang Heng having replaced Cook Barn as the commander of the Scavenger Army of District 7 spread like wildfire.
The large-sized guilds in District 7 were in an uproar.
After the initial shock, the players of the large-sized guilds and the Federation of District 7 suddenly felt extremely sullen.

Countless people cursed in their hearts, “Those idiots from the Federation of District 7! What rotten luck for us to have met such lousy teammates like those from the Federation! After spending so much time, effort, manpower, and resources, not only did our joint sniping with the Federation fail to hit Fang Heng, but it even helped him rise to the top? ”
The various guilds went to the Federation to seek an explanation.
In the end, the Federation promised repeatedly that the Scavenger Army would collapse within three months and asked all the player guilds to hold out for three months.
Every player guild in District 7 was panicking, afraid that they would be targeted by the Scavenger Army led by Fang Heng.
However, Tian Zhen felt that everything was not that simple!
There was always a what if when it came to Fang Heng, for he would always give them an unexpected scare.
What if he thought of a way to keep the Scavenger Army going?

In the past, Fang Heng entering District 7 was not that much of a problem. At most, their guild in District 7 had to cede a portion of the benefits they received, causing a redistribution in the overall benefits.
However, presently, Fang Heng had successfully become the commander of the Scavenger Army.
Then, it was no longer as simple as the guild ceding a portion of their benefits received. It was even possible for Fang Heng to lead the Scavenger Army and completely conquer them!
The more Tian Zhen thought about it, the more restless he felt.
A veteran player who had followed the guild for more than ten years suggested, “Guild leader, if we cooperate with Fang Heng now- ”
Tian Zhen turned around and glared at him, interrupting, “Are you crazy! Cooperate with the Scavenger Army? ”
“I’m sorry, I didn’t think it through. ”
“Get out! ”
“I’m sorry. ”

Tian Zhen furrowed his brows tightly, the suggestion lingering in his mind. He mused, “Cooperate with Fang Heng? Impossible! The Federation would never allow that, and going against the Federation is throwing one’s life away. Openly cooperating with Fang Heng is absolutely out of the question! But, how about behind the scenes... ? ”

He continued pondering, “Fang Heng’s already made his move. Not only us, but the Federation’s also made their move. However, not only did the Federation not manage to suppress Fang Heng, but they even helped him expand his influence in District 7. Fang Heng has the strength, and even luck is on his side! Instead of continuing to oppose him, it might be better to think of ways to cooperate with him... ”

“What’s going on?
Tell me clearly! ”
The Federation soldier who came to report felt that he was being targeted by a fierce beast, and his heart trembled.
That was all the information he had received.
How could he be more specific?
“I have confirmed that Fang Heng has become the new commander of the Scavenger Army... ”
Kou Huai stood still for a moment, countless thoughts flashing through his mind.
How could it be?
Fang Heng had become the new commander of the Scavenger Army?
Was it a joke?
He had never thought that the plot of District 7 could develop like that, and even the analysis report of the intelligence department had never given such a possibility.
How useless was the intelligence department?
“This is impossible! ” The head of the intelligence department, Xiao Changle, also stood up when he heard that and said sternly, “Impossible!
This has never happened before.
We have also tested it in other districts, and it is difficult to increase one’s Scavenger Army contribution points.
Unless the contribution points are maxed out, it is impossible to meet the most basic promotion conditions, and even maxing out the points is a mere possible theory.
Other than that, there are hidden conditions that are realistically impossible to achieve.
We need more information to study.
Fang Heng must have used other special methods... ”
“Shut up! ” Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly, suppressing the urge to tear apart Xiao Changle alive.
“Study?
At this juncture?
What’s the point? ! ” he thought.
“Sir, please calm down.
Even if Fang Heng has taken over the Scavenger Army, the destruction of the army is still within our expectations.
We only need to stick to the original plan for three months, and the crisis will naturally be resolved. ”
“It’s not the same. ” Another shelter commander shook his head and retorted, “Once a player controls the Scavenger Army, the threat they can pose will be greatly increased. ”
The commanders of District 7 then began to discuss discreetly.
“Moreover, that person is Fang Heng, who also has the ability to control a zombie team. ”
“However, if the Scavenger Army loses its supply of potions, they might lose control.
Fang Heng might not be able to control them completely... ”
“I think we should immediately pressure Fang Heng to disband the Scavenger Army and apply for an arrest warrant from our superiors.
We can report that Fang Heng is suspected of participating in the terrorist action in District 7 and might be related to the anti-federation forces.
We should bring hi under control first and then make a judgment. ”
Kou Huai took a deep breath and barely managed to remain calm.
He mused, “How can it be so easy to bring Fang Heng under control?
It’s not like I haven’t tried before.
Fang Heng has the North River Heavy Industry backing him, and the North River Heavy Industry has influence within the Federation.
As long as they are willing, they can delay the arrest warrant approval for a month. ”
Kou Huai turned around and stared at the head of the intelligence department, Xiao Changle, in the eye.
He wished he could swallow him alive and sacrifice him to the heavens!
“Xiao Changle, can you guarantee that?
Can you guarantee that Fang Heng won’t be able to develop the divine potion? ”
Facing Kou Huai’s murderous gaze, Xiao Changle felt a little guilty and didn’t dare to answer for a moment.
Kou Huai was burning with anger.
He shouted sternly, “I’m asking you a question.
Can you guarantee that the Scavenger Army will disappear completely in three months? ! ”
Xiao Changle replied with fear and trepidation, “I guarantee that the divine potion will never be developed within three months... ”
Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly, his heart filled with hatred.
First, it was the large-sized guilds in District 7, and presently, it was the Federation’s own intelligence department.
How could he meet so many useless teammates? !
The matter had developed to the current point, and District 7 was in big trouble!
Once Fang Heng agreed to command the Scavenger Army, he would be more of a threat than Cook Barn, much greater!
Kou Huai no longer believed Xiao Changle’s answer at all.
If Fang Heng really developed the divine potion, he would have complete control over the Scavenger Army!
Coupled with his large-sized zombie team, Fang Heng’s power would be unthinkable.
Kou Huai had spent a lot of time and effort to plan the execution, but it ended up helping Fang Heng greatly.
He had helped to nurture a monster that could destroy District 7.
“No!
That won’t happen.
It won’t... ” Kou Huai comforted himself inwardly.
He controlled himself to focus on the present and not think about the worst.
“Fang Heng! ” Kou Huai gnashed his teeth.
He had no choice but to calm down and face the present terrible situation.
What he was currently worried about was not the main storyline.
It was Fang Heng, a ticking time bomb.
What if Fang Heng refused to even negotiate?
For a moment, Kou Huai felt that Fang Heng was 100 times more difficult to deal with than the anti-federal organization!
“Sir. ”

He has already beccome the fourth place on the main storyline leaderboard rankings of District 7. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Mutant Worm Body
paragraphs: Meanwhile, in the eighth basement where the research Institute of the Scavenger Army was, the head of the base’s laboratory, Dr. Ding Min, introduced the cultivation pod to Fang Heng.

“The cultivation pod’s transformation of the zombie corpse is only at the stage of secret experimental research. Transformation of the Tyrant form is still impossible. We lack the original fluid of worm body. It was previously provided by Commander Cook. ” As Ding Min spoke, she handed the report to Fang Heng. “In addition, I have reported to Commander Cook more than once that similar worm form modification is extremely dangerous. The probability of the Tyrant form losing control is over 95% ... ”
Fang Heng flipped open the report and looked at it. He asked in puzzlement, “The original fluid? ”

“It’s the foundational original fluid of worm body used to make the divine potion. I heard that you’ve successfully completed the research and modification of the divine potion. You should be clear about that. ”
Fang Heng took out the remaining half bottle of original fluid from his backpack and handed it over.

He had been carrying the half bottle of original fluid extracted from the Hila tissue all along. He had originally planned to bring it back to District 8 for Qiu Yaokang’s research. “Are you referring to this? ”
Ding Min took the original liquid, raised it high, and checked it against the light.

“Yes, it’s this kind of original liquid, but the quantity is still too small. The Tyrant form is different from ordinary zombies. It needs at least 500 times this amount to complete a Tyrant form transformation. ”

“500 times? ” Fang Heng thought that the number was too exaggerated. “Does the Tyrant form need to be bathed in the original liquid? To gather 500 times the original liquid of the worm body, I’ll need to stop producing the divine potion for a month. ”
He then asked, “It’s too much. Can’t it be less? ”
“It’s already the minimum amount. Mr. Cook has tried other transformation plans, but they all failed. A little less will cause the success rate to drop like a cliff. ”
“Then what about changing the transformation method? I understand that the Tyrant form is big. What do you think about changing it to a Licker body? ”

Ding Min shook her head and explained, “Before you came here, we already tested and studied many kinds of zombie corpses. Small-sized zombie corpses, such as ordinary mutated zombies and Licker bodies are unable to withstand the worm virus due to the strength of their bodies. Higher-level zombie corpses, such as one-eyed zombies, have stronger bodies, which will cause the worm body to have a strong rejection reaction. Their transformation requires more original liquid, and the success rate will be extremely low. After combining all kinds of tests, only the Tyrant form is the most suitable to be transformed. ”
“Hint: player has obtained information on the transformation of the Tyrant form ”
“Hint: player has triggered the mission ‘Tyrant form special modification (mutant worm form) . ”
“Hint: this modification is only for zombie clones in the Tyrant form. ”
Name of modification: Tyrant form special modification, mutant worm form.
Modification requirement 1: two research personnel above rank A.
Modification requirement 2: obtain 300 original fluid of worm body for the divine potion .
Modification requirement 3: one custom-made high-level mutant worm form custom-made modifying cultivation pod.
Ding Min was a little tired from rushing to repair the laboratory the previous night. She raised her head and said, “Commander, I’m tired. If there are no questions, I’ll go back and rest first. ”
“Okay, you go and rest first. ”
Seeing the game hints that refreshed on his retina, Fang Heng finally understood.
He had been tricked by Cook Barn!
Cook Barn had given him an empty promise!
At the current stage, the entire Scavenger Army did not have enough original fluid of worm body extracted from the Hila tissue!
So, to speed up the extraction of the original fluid of the unknown worm body, Fang Heng could only think of ways to get more samples of Hila cell tissues.

Ultimately, he still could not avoid the mission concerning Meteorite Company’s 12 boxes, whether it was to create more and more powerful divine potions to increase the strength of the Scavengers Army, to find clues related to the Hila experiment to trigger the hidden ending, or to complete the next evolution of the Tyrant form.
All of those required him to obtain more samples of Hila tissues that were hidden by Meteorite Company as a prerequisite.

Narrowing his eyes, Fang Heng thought, “Whatever, I’ll just get down to action. Didn’t Cook Barn leave an electromagnetic tower behind anyway? I already know the coordinates of the next box, so I can directly take action! It’s a good opportunity since the Federation can’t figure out the Scavenger Army’s plans and has concentrated their defenses. ”
On the bright side, once he found the box, almost all the problems he was currently facing could be solved.
It was akin to killing three birds with one stone!
“Everyone. ”

Three hours later, Fang Heng gathered most of the combat personnel from the Scavenger Army headquarters. “This is my first mission since I’ve become the new commander. For the death of Commander Cook! They must pay the price! I only have one request, and that’s to win in one strike! I can promise everyone that after the victory, all of you will be rewarded with the modified divine potion according to your merit points. ”
He then nodded to Osborne, who began to distribute the modified divine potions and weapons to the members of the team.
“Let’s go! ”
Raah!
The Scavenger Army elites poured bottles of divine potion into their mouths and smashed them on the ground, letting out angry roars.
“Hint: you have distributed the potions, which have boosted the morale of the team. Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has reached its peak. ”
“Hint: your speech has boosted the morale of the members of the army. Your intelligence points are higher than 10 points. You have mastered the unique skill of a leader ‘Team Encouragement. ‘ ”
Skill: Team Encouragement (level 1) .
Skill description: when a player becomes the team commander, he or she can take the initiative to use this skill and boost the morale of the team within 100 minutes.

Skill description: the skill effect is related to the player’s basic Will attribute and the level of the skill. The maximum level of this skill can be raised to level 20 and can not exceed the player’s current level (this effect can not be stacked) .
Skill cooldown: 12 hours.
There was actually such a benefit? Earning a skill for free?
Fang Heng knew his eloquence.
Probably only those Scavenger Army soldiers who were affected by the divine potion would be motivated, but that was fine.
The great reward would breed brave men.
Fang Heng raised his right hand high, “Now! Follow me! All set off! It’s just the Dark Knights! Crush them! ”
Raah!
The Scavenger Army soldiers roared again, venting the anger and killing intent in their hearts.
Under the leadership of the various captains of the Scavenger Army, the team marched in the direction of the Dark Knights’ camp.
Fang Heng was full of fighting spirit. It was presently the best opportunity to launch an attack.

While the Federation and other guilds were still lying in wait, he was going to make a big show of his attack! He would crush the Dark Knights with his strength and destroy them in one fell swoop, thereafter seizing the Hila tissue sample to complete the next tier transformation of the Tyrant form!
It was his first step in turning the tables on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - Attack the Dark Knights!
paragraphs: “The Scavenger Army has made a move! Report the situation to the higher-ups immediately! ”

At the entrance of the mountain range, the Federation player team, which had been lying in ambush and observing the situation, noticed that a large number of the Scavenger Army soldiers had left and immediately reported the news to the Federation.
Five minutes later, Kou Huai received the news that all the members of the Scavenger Army had gathered.
Not only the Scavenger Army headquarters, but the regional commanders of the Scavenger Army also led their teams to assemble.
Kou Huai was ironically relieved when he received the news, for them not making a move was far eerier.
Next, he just needed to block their attack.
Even if he could not block it and ended up surrendering a few shelters to them in vain, they would still struggle.
Kou Huai laughed coldly in his heart.
The weight that had been weighing on his heart was finally lifted.
“Have you determined the direction of the enemy’s attack? ”
“It’s still under observation. I can’t confirm it for now. ”
“Okay. ” Kou Huai nodded and said, “Continue to observe. Tell all the shelters to be careful and enter Tier 1 martial law. Also, remind the player guilds in District 7 to be careful. ”
“Okay, I’m on it! ”
“Keep an eye on them! I want to know their target as soon as possible. ”
“Understood! ”
Meanwhile, in the abandoned mine area in Zombie Apocalypse, District 7.
Prior to the zombie apocalypse, it was one of the largest iron mines in the world.
Meteorite Company had bought the entire mine and mined it.
After the apocalypse, the place was occupied by the Dark Knights and transformed into a branch base.
Fang Heng led the Scavenger Army soldiers to the gathering point outside the mining area.

Upon seeing Fang Heng, Roche smiled and went up to him. “Hahahaha! Commander Fang Heng! The first time I saw you, I knew you were extraordinary! You are indeed amazing! You became the commander so quickly! ” His voice was as loud as usual.
After he had received the news of the general attack, Roche immediately brought the regional team of Edge Creek town to gather and was the first to arrive at the gathering point.

“This area of the Dark Knights’ camp has been hindering our development. I’ve wanted to crush them for a long time! ” Roche’s eyes flashed with a bloodthirsty light as he looked at the Dark Knights’ camp not far away.

“Mm, the goal of this mission is to crush them, regardless of the price. ” Fang Heng nodded and whispered, “In addition, I have a special mission for you. I’m not comfortable with entrusting it to the others. ”
Roche was stunned. Hearing what Fang Heng said, a hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.

“Do your best. The things are already prepared. Bring your people over to collect the supplies. Your team will be given priority in receiving some of the supplies. After the battle is over, it will be your first achievement. ”
Roche’s eyes lit up. He liked Fang Heng’s style of doing things and thought the position of commander should have been given to Fang Heng long ago.
“Watch me, Commander Fang Heng. Watch how I crush them. ” After saying that, Roche waved his hand at his team members. “Come with me. Let’s go collect the supplies! ”
Osborne and Ni Shengtao followed behind Fang Heng worriedly.
They finally realized how swift and decisive Fang Heng acted.
In less than 15 hours after inheriting the commander position, he had completed the development and modification of the divine potion.

In less than five hours after that, he immediately gathered all the military strength in the eastern region of the Scavenger Army and concentrated on attacking the branch base of the Dark Knights located in the abandoned mine area!
For the sake of the battle, they had brought all the warlord potions and divine potions from the headquarters.
Looking at the tightly-guarded fortress building in the distance, Osborne was still uncertain.
If they lost the battle, the entire Scavenger Army would be doomed.
“Commander Fang Heng, do we really have to do this? The defense of the Dark Knights is extremely strong. Commander Cook had planned many raids and eventually gave up due to various reasons... ”
“Now is the best time. ” Fang Heng rubbed his fist and asked, “Have you notified the other sub-teams? ”

NI Shengtao replied, “I have. The five sub-teams’ commanders have already gathered. The other 16 sub-teams are still on their way. It is estimated that all the teams will be assembled within 30 minutes. ”
“Very good. There’s no need to wait. Pass down my orders. In five minutes, everyone will attack. ”
Tall Tyrant forms walked down from the truck behind them one after another and stood behind Fang Heng.
“Everyone, attack! ”
Within five minutes, the 30 Tyrant forms formed a line and walked toward the Dark Knights’ camp.
Bang, bang, bang!
Gunshots were heard everywhere.
The scouting team outside the Dark Knights’ camp had long noticed that a large number of enemies were approaching from the outside.
On the towering defense wall of the periphery, the elite Dark Knights each used a long-range sniper rifle to attack the head of a Tyrant form.
The Tyrant forms withstood the enemy’s firepower and created a zombie wall in front of them, blocking the front.
“Attack! Attack! ”
At the back, the Scavenger Army soldiers who had fallen into madness from drinking bottles of divine potions and joined the battle with the Tyrant forms.
“What! ? is the information reliable? ”
Kou Huai was stunned when he learned that Fang Heng had made his first target the Dark Knights after becoming the new commander of the Scavenger Army.
“Is he crazy? ! ” Kou Huai had been fighting Fang Heng all the while, even though Fang Heng always had the upper hand because of Kou Huai’s stupid teammates.
Kou Huai had always believed that he thoroughly understood Fang Heng and regarded him as a smart man.
Kou Huai subconsciously thought that Fang Heng’s target would be a super-large shelter of the Federation to inflict heavy damage on the Federation.
However, the current situation was too unexpected.

Kou Huai would have had an easier time accepting the situation if Fang Heng had chosen a small-sized shelter of the Dark Knights, the shelter of another game guild, or even other small-sized shelters as his target.
However, Fang Heng had chosen to attack the branch of the Dark Knights that was most difficult to deal with.
In the combat conference room, many shelter commanders started to discuss in low voices.
They also realized that something was not right.
“Commander Kou, should we rush over to support the Dark Knights? ”
Kou Huai did not answer. He was thinking to himself.
It was too late to go over to support at present, and it was easy to be ambushed by Fang Heng on the way over.
The Scavenger Army was especially good with direct combat engagements.
There must be something wrong. Could it be a trap set by Fang Heng, attacking a specific target on the surface but aiming for the reinforcements that would come?
Kou Huai frowned.
He couldn’t figure out Fang Heng’s intentions no matter how hard he tried.

Kou Huai mused, “Fang Heng would never do anything meaningless. Could it be related to the main storyline? ! Could defeating the Dark Knights’ branch be part of the Scavenger Army’s main storyline mission chain? ”
Suddenly having a flash of inspiration, he quickly turned his head and focused his gaze on Xiao Changle, the person in charge of the intelligence department of District 7.
“Xiao Changle, what do you think? Do you think Fang Heng’s unusual move this time is related to the main storyline? ”

sentences.text: “The Scavenger Army has made a move!
Report the situation to the higher-ups immediately! ”

At the entrance of the mountain range, the Federation player team, which had been lying in ambush and observing the situation, noticed that a large number of the Scavenger Army soldiers had left and immediately reported the news to the Federation.
Five minutes later, Kou Huai received the news that all the members of the Scavenger Army had gathered.
Not only the Scavenger Army headquarters, but the regional commanders of the Scavenger Army also led their teams to assemble.
Kou Huai was ironically relieved when he received the news, for them not making a move was far eerier.
Next, he just needed to block their attack.
Even if he could not block it and ended up surrendering a few shelters to them in vain, they would still struggle.
Kou Huai laughed coldly in his heart.
The weight that had been weighing on his heart was finally lifted.
“Have you determined the direction of the enemy’s attack? ”
“It’s still under observation.
I can’t confirm it for now. ”
“Okay. ” Kou Huai nodded and said, “Continue to observe.
Tell all the shelters to be careful and enter Tier 1 martial law.
Also, remind the player guilds in District 7 to be careful. ”
“Okay, I’m on it! ”
“Keep an eye on them!
I want to know their target as soon as possible. ”
“Understood! ”
Meanwhile, in the abandoned mine area in Zombie Apocalypse, District 7.
Prior to the zombie apocalypse, it was one of the largest iron mines in the world.
Meteorite Company had bought the entire mine and mined it.
After the apocalypse, the place was occupied by the Dark Knights and transformed into a branch base.
Fang Heng led the Scavenger Army soldiers to the gathering point outside the mining area.
Upon seeing Fang Heng, Roche smiled and went up to him.
“Hahahaha!
Commander Fang Heng!
The first time I saw you, I knew you were extraordinary!
You are indeed amazing!
You became the commander so quickly! ” His voice was as loud as usual.
After he had received the news of the general attack, Roche immediately brought the regional team of Edge Creek town to gather and was the first to arrive at the gathering point.
“This area of the Dark Knights’ camp has been hindering our development.
I’ve wanted to crush them for a long time! ” Roche’s eyes flashed with a bloodthirsty light as he looked at the Dark Knights’ camp not far away.
“Mm, the goal of this mission is to crush them, regardless of the price. ” Fang Heng nodded and whispered, “In addition, I have a special mission for you.
I’m not comfortable with entrusting it to the others. ”
Roche was stunned.
Hearing what Fang Heng said, a hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.
“Do your best.
The things are already prepared.
Bring your people over to collect the supplies.
Your team will be given priority in receiving some of the supplies.
After the battle is over, it will be your first achievement. ”
Roche’s eyes lit up.
He liked Fang Heng’s style of doing things and thought the position of commander should have been given to Fang Heng long ago.
“Watch me, Commander Fang Heng.
Watch how I crush them. ” After saying that, Roche waved his hand at his team members.
“Come with me.
Let’s go collect the supplies! ”
Osborne and Ni Shengtao followed behind Fang Heng worriedly.
They finally realized how swift and decisive Fang Heng acted.
In less than 15 hours after inheriting the commander position, he had completed the development and modification of the divine potion.

In less than five hours after that, he immediately gathered all the military strength in the eastern region of the Scavenger Army and concentrated on attacking the branch base of the Dark Knights located in the abandoned mine area!
For the sake of the battle, they had brought all the warlord potions and divine potions from the headquarters.
Looking at the tightly-guarded fortress building in the distance, Osborne was still uncertain.
If they lost the battle, the entire Scavenger Army would be doomed.
“Commander Fang Heng, do we really have to do this?
The defense of the Dark Knights is extremely strong.
Commander Cook had planned many raids and eventually gave up due to various reasons... ”
“Now is the best time. ” Fang Heng rubbed his fist and asked, “Have you notified the other sub-teams? ”
NI Shengtao replied, “I have.
The five sub-teams’ commanders have already gathered.
The other 16 sub-teams are still on their way.
It is estimated that all the teams will be assembled within 30 minutes. ”
“Very good.
There’s no need to wait.
Pass down my orders.
In five minutes, everyone will attack. ”
Tall Tyrant forms walked down from the truck behind them one after another and stood behind Fang Heng.
“Everyone, attack! ”
Within five minutes, the 30 Tyrant forms formed a line and walked toward the Dark Knights’ camp.
Bang, bang, bang!
Gunshots were heard everywhere.
The scouting team outside the Dark Knights’ camp had long noticed that a large number of enemies were approaching from the outside.
On the towering defense wall of the periphery, the elite Dark Knights each used a long-range sniper rifle to attack the head of a Tyrant form.
The Tyrant forms withstood the enemy’s firepower and created a zombie wall in front of them, blocking the front.
“Attack!
Attack! ”
At the back, the Scavenger Army soldiers who had fallen into madness from drinking bottles of divine potions and joined the battle with the Tyrant forms.
“What! ? is the information reliable? ”
Kou Huai was stunned when he learned that Fang Heng had made his first target the Dark Knights after becoming the new commander of the Scavenger Army.
“Is he crazy? ! ” Kou Huai had been fighting Fang Heng all the while, even though Fang Heng always had the upper hand because of Kou Huai’s stupid teammates.
Kou Huai had always believed that he thoroughly understood Fang Heng and regarded him as a smart man.
Kou Huai subconsciously thought that Fang Heng’s target would be a super-large shelter of the Federation to inflict heavy damage on the Federation.
However, the current situation was too unexpected.

Kou Huai would have had an easier time accepting the situation if Fang Heng had chosen a small-sized shelter of the Dark Knights, the shelter of another game guild, or even other small-sized shelters as his target.
However, Fang Heng had chosen to attack the branch of the Dark Knights that was most difficult to deal with.
In the combat conference room, many shelter commanders started to discuss in low voices.
They also realized that something was not right.
“Commander Kou, should we rush over to support the Dark Knights? ”
Kou Huai did not answer.
He was thinking to himself.
It was too late to go over to support at present, and it was easy to be ambushed by Fang Heng on the way over.
The Scavenger Army was especially good with direct combat engagements.
There must be something wrong.
Could it be a trap set by Fang Heng, attacking a specific target on the surface but aiming for the reinforcements that would come?
Kou Huai frowned.
He couldn’t figure out Fang Heng’s intentions no matter how hard he tried.
Kou Huai mused, “Fang Heng would never do anything meaningless.
Could it be related to the main storyline? !
Could defeating the Dark Knights’ branch be part of the Scavenger Army’s main storyline mission chain? ”
Suddenly having a flash of inspiration, he quickly turned his head and focused his gaze on Xiao Changle, the person in charge of the intelligence department of District 7.
“Xiao Changle, what do you think?
Do you think Fang Heng’s unusual move this time is related to the main storyline? ”

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - Complete Destruction
paragraphs: “This... ”
Hearing the question, Xiao Changle was startled by Kou Huai’s sudden gaze on him.
He immediately lowered his head and quickly flipped through the report in his hand.

“Sir, all the information the Federation has gathered regarding the main storyline of Zombie Apocalypse was known due to the Dark Knights triggering them. We have never really come into contact with the main storyline related to the Scavenger Army. In theory, the Scavenger Army does have the possibility of triggering the main storyline. ” Xiao Changle frowned. “Considering the flow of the past main storyline in the major districts, I think the probability of Fang Heng doing anything related to the main storyline is very low. ”
Kou Huai felt that there was no answer to Fang Heng’s actions.
If it had nothing to do with the main storyline, why would Fang Heng suddenly fight the Dark Knights?
It didn’t make sense!

“Commander Kou, why don’t we let the Scavenger Army and the Dark Knights fight it out? As far as I know, the branch of the Dark Knights has a large-sized spatial rift device. There will be an endless supply of high-level elites of the Dark Knights coming from all over the world to provide support. The Scavenger Army will never be able to take them down. ”
“Not necessarily. ” Kou Huai’s heart was heavy. “Under normal circumstances, the Scavenger Army can not claim victory, but their current commander is Fang Heng. ”
Kou Huai could not help but clench his fists tightly.
Fang Heng was the most unstable factor!
While everyone was discussing, a soldier walked into the conference room.
“Reporting! The latest report from the inspection team has come in. ”
“Give it here! ” Kou Huai opened the report and quickly skimmed through its contents.
Hah!
Kou Huai was so angry that he laughed.

According to the report, Fang Heng had been kidnapped by the anti-federation force, Night Owl, in the villa, and his current whereabouts were unknown. North River Heavy Industry was hence requesting the Federation for help, asking the Federation to consider how Fang Heng was a partner of North River Heavy Industry, had been on good terms with the Federation for a long time, and had even accepted the Federation’s appeal to withdraw from the Scavenger Army.

“In order to prevent Fang Heng from being threatened and used by the anti-federal organization, they hope that the Federation can help find him What a joke! ” thought Kou Huai as he fiercely smashed the file in his hand onto the table!

He continued musing, “Couldn’t Fang Heng have come up with a more believable reason? He’s determined to go against me! He definitely has a secret plan! No matter what, I have to stop the enemy’s plan. ”
Kou Huai then took a deep breath and asked, “How many shelters are closest to the area? Count the ones that can reach the Dark Knights’ branch in half an hour! ”

A Federation player immediately reported after checking the data, “Excluding the time taken for the teams to gather, there are 12 shelters that can reach the Dark Knights’ branch in half an hour to provide support. That includes two large-sized shelters, three medium-sized shelters, and seven small-sized shelters. Among them, there is one large-sized shelter and two small-sized shelters belonging to the Federation. ”

Kou Huai ordered in a deep voice, “Immediately send out support for the Dark Knights! Also, tell the few player teams within range to immediately send support for the Dark Knights! Tell them to act immediately! The Federation will compensate for the battle losses after the event! ”
“Understood! ”
“What’s going on? Fang Heng attacked the headquarters of the Dark Knights? ” Tian Zhen, who was personally overseeing the shelter, was also stunned when he received the news.
Why did he choose the Dark Knights?
A second ago, Tian Zhen was still debating whether he should take the risk and secretly cooperate with Fang Heng.
In the blink of an eye, Fang Heng made a stupid move.
Why did he provoke the Dark Knights for no reason?

“Guild leader, we just received a call from the Federation confirming that the Scavenger Army has launched a surprise attack on the Dark Knights. The Federation has already dispatched people to attack Fang Heng, and they need our assistance from the side. We need to take this opportunity to jointly destroy the main force of the Scavenger Army. The Federation has agreed to compensate part of the losses we suffer in the battle. There’s no time to lose. The Federation wants us to set off immediately. ”
Tian Zhen could not help but fall silent.
He frowned, stood up, and began to pace back and forth in the hall.
Something was wrong!
There must be something wrong!
No matter how he looked at it, Fang Heng’s move looked like a reckless one of giving up his own life.
What was he planning?
The branch of the Dark Knights was right next to the base shelter of Leftway Gaming Guild. Tian Zhen knew that very well.
The defense of the branch fortress was extremely strong.

Even if Fang Heng attacked with all his strength and successfully took down the fortress, it would only be a pyrrhic victory. It would only weaken the overall strength of the Scavenger Army. Was it really necessary just to get a fortress?

Deputy Commander Zhong Lei silently watched Tian Zhen pace about the room for a full five minutes. He mused, “Exactly what is the hesitation for? It’s such a good opportunity to completely destroy the Scavenger Army, not to mention that the Federation has promised to partially compensate for the battle losses. ”
Seeing that Tian Zhen had started to walk around the hall once again, he could not help but interrupt, “Guild leader, the Federation is pressing us very urgently. How should we reply? ”
Tian Zhen finally stopped walking and said in a deep voice, “Reply to the Federation and say that we have agreed. We will immediately head to the Dark Knights’ branch to provide support. ”
“Understood! ” Zhong Lei nodded and became excited. “I will go and gather the team now. ”
“Wait! ” Tian Zhen stopped Zhong Lei. “Who told you to gather the team? Gather the elite team. There doesn’t need to be many people. Just ten people will do. ”
“What? ” Zhong Lei was stunned and did not react for a moment.
“Only ten people! I will personally lead the team to take a look. Do as I say! Go quickly! ”
“All right, understood! ”
“Quick! Faster! ”
After receiving the request from the Federation, Holy Paladin Gaming Guild immediately gathered all their manpower and headed to the Dark Knights’ branch to provide support.
Having been suppressed by Fang Heng for so long, they would not miss such a good opportunity to thoroughly destroy the Scavenger Army.
Not far away from the Dark Knights’ branch, Holy Paladin Gaming Guild’s players were driving a large-sized truck on a wide road.
They were almost there. The abandoned mine area was just two kilometers away.
The guild’s vice-guild leader, Ma Keyu, could not help but urge the team to speed up.
Suddenly, Ma Keyu felt the seat under his butt shake violently.
Following that, he heard violent explosion noises.
Boom! Boom, boom!
“What’s going on? Is it an ambush? ! ” thought Ma Keyu, who realized the situation was not good and immediately got out of the vehicle to check.
The explosives that were buried in the road in advance had been detonated. The two large-sized trucks in the middle were directly affected by the explosion and had been sent flying.

The power of the explosives was not too strong, however, and the players in the truck only suffered minor injuries. They crawled out of the burning trucks while screaming in pain and sprayed first aid spray into their mouths.
For a moment, the entire team’s progress was interrupted.
Was it an ambush?

The Holy Paladin Gaming Guild was not an ordinary guild. The team was very experienced in dealing with such ambushes. Some of the players set out to save their teammates, while the others quickly reacted and stood guard around the area.
“But... Choosing to ambush on such a wide terrain? ” Ma Keyu was suspicious.
Just then, a voice sounded. “Look! What’s that! ? ”
