chapters.title: Chapter 437 - Ambush
paragraphs: As Ma Keyu looked in the direction pointed by the player, he witnessed a patch of scarlet appear at the end of the road, and his heart couldn’t help but clench. He thought, “No Way? ”
“Damn it! It’s the Lickers! ” a player immediately recognized the terrifying red and shouted.
The scarlet Lickers pounced at the players from all directions and approached at an extremely fast speed.
“Quick! Set up a formation on the spot! ”
“It’s too late! Run! ”

The players were flustered by the large-scale attack by the Lickers. For a moment, they were a little confused. They thought, “What the hell? ! Weren’t we supposed to completely destroy the Scavenger Army? Why were we ambushed instead? ”
Unfortunately, they encountered the mutated Lickers in the wild and did not have any cover to protect them.
Ma Keyu couldn’t help but lie down on his side with cold sweat running down his face.
That meant that they were not far from free rebirth!
A few players threw several flashbangs in all directions to delay the Lickers’ attack speed.
Ma Keyu quickly looked around, trying to find a way to break out of the situation and survive.
He then noticed that there was a gap on the right side of the Lickers’ encirclement.
“Quick! Over There! ” Ma Keyu shouted and immediately led his team to retreat toward the gap.
The team found a glimmer of hope and immediately retreated to the side of the road.
“Look! There’s a building over there! ” a player pointed to an abandoned observation platform not far away and shouted.
Ma Keyu also saw the observation platform and immediately felt a sense of joy. “Quick! Occupy the building and set up a defensive line! ”
Several players who were at the front of the team ran to the abandoned observation platform. One of them took out their rifle and was about to break open the main door.
He never expected that when he raised the muzzle of his gun and aimed at the lock of the door, the door would be pushed open from the inside.
Then, the muzzle of a black shotgun extended out from the door.
Boom! Boom!
Two shots from the front!
The player did not have time to react and fell to the ground.
“Hahaha! Commander Fang Heng was right! There are really people who want to die! I have been waiting for you here for a long time! ” Roche laughed excitedly.
“All of you, attack! Brothers! Crush them! ” He rushed into the crowd of players with his team, all of them possessing bloodshot eyes like a pack of wolves pouncing on their prey.
In an open-field battle, the Lickers and the crazed Scavenger Army were the strongest!
“It’s the Scavenger Army! ” The moment he saw Roche and the others, Ma Keyu felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
In a hurry, the Holy Paladin Gaming Guild players could not organize an effective counterattack.
In just five minutes, the entire guild was wiped out, and not a single player was left.
Roche’s body was full of bullet holes.
Blood kept flowing out of the bullet holes, and he looked like a bloodthirsty demon.
Feeling a little weak, Roche raised his head and gulped down three bottles of warlord potions.
As the muscles in his body squirmed, his wounds immediately stopped bleeding and quickly healed.
The other members of the Scavenger Army also gulped down the warlord potion and quickly recovered.
Before they could tidy up the battlefield, a member of the Scavenger Army rushed up.
“Captain Roche! There’s another wave of enemies ahead! There are so many of them! ”
“Captain! What if we don’t have enough explosives? ”

“F*ck! What a coward! ” Roche spat on the ground and poured another bottle of warlord potion into his mouth. “Then we don’t have to fight them with explosives! Remember what the boss said! As long as we can hold them off, it’ll be counted as our first achievement! ! ”
Under the effects of the warlord potion, the team spirit of the team led by Roche remained extremely high.
“Yes! ! ”

In the distance, on a high hillside, using binoculars, the deputy commander of Leftway Gaming Guild, Zhong Lei, witnessed the scene of Holy Paladin Gaming Guild being wiped out. A layer of cold sweat appeared on his forehead as he exclaimed inwardly, “That was close! ”
Fortunately, Leftway Gaming Guild did not rashly listen to the Federation’s words and directly lead a team to support the Dark Knights.
Otherwise, their current situation would not be much better than the Holy Paladin Gaming Guild’s.

Tian Zhen stood at the side and could not help but sneer in his heart, “Hah! The Federation! That old fox Kou Huai! He deliberately let the first few waves of players clear the mine area before the Federation’s main support force’s arrival. It’s clear as day that Kou Huai schemed this! ”
“Guild leader, what should we do next? ”

Tian Zhen snorted coldly in his heart. He then said, “Just sit tight and do nothing. Send someone to tell the Federation that our people were ambushed by the Scavenger Army halfway and suffered serious injuries. Hence, we have no choice but to withdraw. We will inform them of our battle losses at a later time. ”
Zhong Lei nodded and responded, “Yes! Understood! ”
Meanwhile, at the main battlefield where the Dark Knights’ branch was.
The light canons and automatic canons on the periphery of the fortress continued to fire.
The Tyrant forms that were the first to absorb the enemy’s firepower were severely injured.
The Scavenger Army soldiers mostly used close-range weapons, so their long-range combat power was very weak.
They could only rely on the zombie team to make up for it.
At the back of the team, Fang Heng, who was commanding the entire battle, had a layer of cold sweat on his forehead.
At the same time, Fang Heng had to be 100% focused on controlling the reinforcements on the front and side of the battlefield.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne stood behind Fang Heng. They were even more nervous than usual.
The battle had already entered its most intense phase. The battlefield was like a meat grinder, reaping the lives of both armies.
The number of deaths had increased greatly.

Osborne received some news from the rear and reported to Fang Heng, “Commander, there’s news from Roche. A large number of players have rushed over to support the Dark Knights. They’re suspected to be the Federation players that you mentioned. ”
“Mm, Ni Shengtao, bring the remaining people over to support them. You must stop the Federation’s people. You don’t have to wipe them out, but you must not let them get close. Do you understand? ”
Ni Shengtao said in a deep voice, “I understand! ”
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the battlefield in front of him.
The battle was undoubtedly a battle of attrition. It would depend on who could last until the end.
More than half of the Tyrant forms had been damaged.
The opponent’s light cannons’ muzzles had also entered an overheated state and could not continue to be operated.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, the remaining five Tyrant forms that were close to the bottom of the fortress raised their fists and crazily smashed at the outer wall.
It was time!
Once the enemy’s damage output was all directed at the Tyrant forms, the zombie team on the right side finally found an opportunity and quietly approached the front of the main building.
Fang Heng spent a lot of effort controlling the zombies to block the muzzles of the cannons.
The moment their HP dropped below 10% , they self-destructed.
“Blood explosion! Blood Explosion! ! ! ”
Boom! Boom, boom! ! !
The damage caused by the self-destruction of the zombie corpses was apparent. Every time, it would cause the overall HP of the fortress to drop by a large chunk!
However, carefully controlling every single zombie clone to self-destruct would consume too much energy.
Fang Heng was extremely focused. He raised his head and gulped down bottles of coffee as he stared at the game log.
The overall defense of the fortress was only left with less than a third!
Just a little more would do!

sentences.text: As Ma Keyu looked in the direction pointed by the player, he witnessed a patch of scarlet appear at the end of the road, and his heart couldn’t help but clench.
He thought, “No Way? ”
“Damn it!
It’s the Lickers! ” a player immediately recognized the terrifying red and shouted.
The scarlet Lickers pounced at the players from all directions and approached at an extremely fast speed.
“Quick!
Set up a formation on the spot! ”
“It’s too late!
Run! ”
The players were flustered by the large-scale attack by the Lickers.
For a moment, they were a little confused.
They thought, “What the hell? !
Weren’t we supposed to completely destroy the Scavenger Army?
Why were we ambushed instead? ”
Unfortunately, they encountered the mutated Lickers in the wild and did not have any cover to protect them.
Ma Keyu couldn’t help but lie down on his side with cold sweat running down his face.
That meant that they were not far from free rebirth!
A few players threw several flashbangs in all directions to delay the Lickers’ attack speed.
Ma Keyu quickly looked around, trying to find a way to break out of the situation and survive.
He then noticed that there was a gap on the right side of the Lickers’ encirclement.
“Quick!
Over There! ” Ma Keyu shouted and immediately led his team to retreat toward the gap.
The team found a glimmer of hope and immediately retreated to the side of the road.
“Look!
There’s a building over there! ” a player pointed to an abandoned observation platform not far away and shouted.
Ma Keyu also saw the observation platform and immediately felt a sense of joy.
“Quick!
Occupy the building and set up a defensive line! ”
Several players who were at the front of the team ran to the abandoned observation platform.
One of them took out their rifle and was about to break open the main door.
He never expected that when he raised the muzzle of his gun and aimed at the lock of the door, the door would be pushed open from the inside.
Then, the muzzle of a black shotgun extended out from the door.
Boom!
Boom!
Two shots from the front!
The player did not have time to react and fell to the ground.
“Hahaha!
Commander Fang Heng was right!
There are really people who want to die!
I have been waiting for you here for a long time! ” Roche laughed excitedly.
“All of you, attack!
Brothers!
Crush them! ” He rushed into the crowd of players with his team, all of them possessing bloodshot eyes like a pack of wolves pouncing on their prey.
In an open-field battle, the Lickers and the crazed Scavenger Army were the strongest!
“It’s the Scavenger Army! ” The moment he saw Roche and the others, Ma Keyu felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
In a hurry, the Holy Paladin Gaming Guild players could not organize an effective counterattack.
In just five minutes, the entire guild was wiped out, and not a single player was left.
Roche’s body was full of bullet holes.
Blood kept flowing out of the bullet holes, and he looked like a bloodthirsty demon.
Feeling a little weak, Roche raised his head and gulped down three bottles of warlord potions.
As the muscles in his body squirmed, his wounds immediately stopped bleeding and quickly healed.
The other members of the Scavenger Army also gulped down the warlord potion and quickly recovered.
Before they could tidy up the battlefield, a member of the Scavenger Army rushed up.
“Captain Roche!
There’s another wave of enemies ahead!
There are so many of them! ”
“Captain!
What if we don’t have enough explosives? ”
“F*ck!
What a coward! ” Roche spat on the ground and poured another bottle of warlord potion into his mouth.
“Then we don’t have to fight them with explosives!
Remember what the boss said!
As long as we can hold them off, it’ll be counted as our first achievement! ! ”
Under the effects of the warlord potion, the team spirit of the team led by Roche remained extremely high.
“Yes! ! ”
In the distance, on a high hillside, using binoculars, the deputy commander of Leftway Gaming Guild, Zhong Lei, witnessed the scene of Holy Paladin Gaming Guild being wiped out.
A layer of cold sweat appeared on his forehead as he exclaimed inwardly, “That was close! ”
Fortunately, Leftway Gaming Guild did not rashly listen to the Federation’s words and directly lead a team to support the Dark Knights.
Otherwise, their current situation would not be much better than the Holy Paladin Gaming Guild’s.
Tian Zhen stood at the side and could not help but sneer in his heart, “Hah!
The Federation!
That old fox Kou Huai!
He deliberately let the first few waves of players clear the mine area before the Federation’s main support force’s arrival.
It’s clear as day that Kou Huai schemed this! ”
“Guild leader, what should we do next? ”
Tian Zhen snorted coldly in his heart.
He then said, “Just sit tight and do nothing.
Send someone to tell the Federation that our people were ambushed by the Scavenger Army halfway and suffered serious injuries.
Hence, we have no choice but to withdraw.
We will inform them of our battle losses at a later time. ”
Zhong Lei nodded and responded, “Yes!
Understood! ”
Meanwhile, at the main battlefield where the Dark Knights’ branch was.
The light canons and automatic canons on the periphery of the fortress continued to fire.
The Tyrant forms that were the first to absorb the enemy’s firepower were severely injured.
The Scavenger Army soldiers mostly used close-range weapons, so their long-range combat power was very weak.
They could only rely on the zombie team to make up for it.
At the back of the team, Fang Heng, who was commanding the entire battle, had a layer of cold sweat on his forehead.
At the same time, Fang Heng had to be 100% focused on controlling the reinforcements on the front and side of the battlefield.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne stood behind Fang Heng.
They were even more nervous than usual.
The battle had already entered its most intense phase.
The battlefield was like a meat grinder, reaping the lives of both armies.
The number of deaths had increased greatly.
Osborne received some news from the rear and reported to Fang Heng, “Commander, there’s news from Roche.
A large number of players have rushed over to support the Dark Knights.
They’re suspected to be the Federation players that you mentioned. ”
“Mm, Ni Shengtao, bring the remaining people over to support them.
You must stop the Federation’s people.
You don’t have to wipe them out, but you must not let them get close.
Do you understand? ”
Ni Shengtao said in a deep voice, “I understand! ”
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the battlefield in front of him.
The battle was undoubtedly a battle of attrition.
It would depend on who could last until the end.
More than half of the Tyrant forms had been damaged.
The opponent’s light cannons’ muzzles had also entered an overheated state and could not continue to be operated.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, the remaining five Tyrant forms that were close to the bottom of the fortress raised their fists and crazily smashed at the outer wall.
It was time!
Once the enemy’s damage output was all directed at the Tyrant forms, the zombie team on the right side finally found an opportunity and quietly approached the front of the main building.
Fang Heng spent a lot of effort controlling the zombies to block the muzzles of the cannons.
The moment their HP dropped below 10% , they self-destructed.
“Blood explosion!
Blood Explosion! ! ! ”
Boom!
Boom, boom! ! !
The damage caused by the self-destruction of the zombie corpses was apparent.
Every time, it would cause the overall HP of the fortress to drop by a large chunk!
However, carefully controlling every single zombie clone to self-destruct would consume too much energy.
Fang Heng was extremely focused.
He raised his head and gulped down bottles of coffee as he stared at the game log.
The overall defense of the fortress was only left with less than a third!
Just a little more would do!

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - Capture the Fortress
paragraphs: In the command room of Dark Knights’ branch.
Ovidius, the chief commander, was highly anxious.
He had also sensed the threat from the zombie team on the right side of their fortress.
Ever since the zombie team appeared, bad news had been reported to the command room one after another.
“Commander! The alarm on the wall is activated!”
“The durability of the defense at the east has been greatly reduced!”
“The space tearing device needs to be recharged. We have to replenish more blue crystals!”
“The opening of the No.7 light cannon turret has been damaged due to overheating. We can no longer use it, and we must repair it immediately!”
“Elite Team No.2 is in position. They are replenishing the defense of point No.8...”
“There are too many zombies, and their defense is powerful. We need heavy weapons to deal effective damage to them.”
“They... they’re climbing up!”
Looking at the zombie team outside through the surveillance screen, Ovidius broke out in a cold sweat.
It was the first time Dark Knights had encountered such a high-level zombie team that had been mutated. At this time, they had no idea how to deal with it.
If they let the zombies do whatever they wanted, they would keep scratching the wall outside the fortress.

However, what they could do was more than this. Many mutated zombies would extend vines from their bodies and use them to climb up to the automatic turrets on the upper side of the fortress to scratch the turrets.

If they attack the zombies immediately, once their HP dropped to a certain level, the zombies would instantly release powerful self-destruct skills. That would cause a large amount of damage to the automatic turrets and the walls of the fortress!
However, if they continued to ignore the zombies, the automatic turrets on the walls would be destroyed.
What should they do?!
Ovidius felt they would be in big trouble no matter which choice he made.
Just as he hesitated, a player suddenly turned pale and shouted, “Commander! An alarm has appeared on the east defense! It has reached the threshold level!”
“Boom!”
Before Ovidius could respond, a loud noise came to the ears of all the players.
The command room shook violently.
Then, there was a dead silence.
The entire battlefield also fell into temporary silence.
“Roar!”
A moment later, Scavenger Army on the battlefield let out even more berserk roars.
The wall on the right side of the fortress of Dark Knights’ branch collapsed, leaving a huge hole.
“Haha! Follow me! Let’s charge in!”
“Let’s go! Now!”
The commanders of all the regions of Scavenger Army were excited when they saw this. They roared and led their team members to charge into Dark Knights’ branch building from the hole.
Once they entered, Scavenger Army’s close combat advantage would be fully activated!
“We finally make it.”
Seeing the wall on the east side of the fortress collapse, Fang Heng relaxed.
He immediately ordered the zombie clones to enter the fortress and then poured a bottle of coffee into his mouth.
“Osborne.”
“Here! Commander!”
Osborne suppressed the excitement in his heart.
They did it!
They had succeeded for real!
Although he fully trusted Fang Heng, Osborne had been worried whether their team would be able to break through Dark Knights’ branch fortress.
It was known that the previous commander, Cook Barn, had spent a few years of planning but still failed to take down this branch.
But now, Fang Heng had actually made it.

Within 24 hours since Fang Heng had taken over Scavenger Army, he had not only completed the development and optimization of the divine potion but also had broken through one of the three major branches of Dark Knights!
Osborne was agitated.
He had a strong feeling.
Scavenger army would definitely be able to create unprecedented glory under Fang Heng’s leadership!
Osborne took a deep breath and tried his best to appear less excited.
“Commander Fang Heng, we did it!”
“Not yet. It’s not time to celebrate yet. We still have some way to go.”
Fang Heng was a little worried that Dark Knights would play some tricks. He raised his head and looked at the fortress not far away. “Take a small team. We’ll follow in and take a look together.”
“Yes, sir!”
At the periphery of the abandoned mine area where Dark Knights’ branch fortress was located, a group of players from Federation who came for help was setting up a defensive line on the road.
A gathering of Scavenger Army and Lickers were across from them.
Both sides were separated by a distance of a few hundred meters.
They had been in a stalemate for nearly half an hour.
Qu Chengwu, the commander of Federation, had tried several times to lead his team to charge forward. A group of Lickers would charge out and stop them when they were halfway out.
Coupled with Scavenger Army’s powerful firepower, they had failed and were forced to retreat again and again.
A few minutes ago, another two groups of player guilds had just arrived and joined the team.
Qu Chengwu prepared to try again.
Just as he was about to give the order to attack, Qu Chengwu received an urgent message on his personal survival radio.
“Report: Scavenger Army has entered Dark Knights’ shelter. Some Tyrant form zombies are heading in your direction. You’d better retreat quickly.”
What?
They had been taken down?!
So soon?
Qu Chengwu was shocked when he saw the news.
It had only been an hour, and Dark Knights’ branch couldn’t hold on anymore?!
Was Scavenger Army crazy? How did their combat strength get improved so soon?
Qu Chengwu frowned.
He realized that his team was in trouble now.
Once Scavenger Army completely took charge of Dark Knights’ branch, they would deal with Federation next when they were free.
Even Dark Knights could not withstand Fang Heng’s frontal attack. How could they?
“Sir, we are ready to attack.”
“Stop it. There’s no need.”
Qu Chengwu said in a deep voice, “According to the latest news, Dark Knights’ branch has been occupied. Prepare to retreat in batches. We must be careful and minimize the casualties.”
The soldier’s expression changed slightly.
“Yes, sir!”
The branch of Dark Knights.
In the teleportation hall on the second floor underground.
Fang Heng stood in front of the large-scale space tearing device.
Two tyrants followed behind him as Fang Heng’s bodyguards, one on his left and one on his right.
Gunshots could be heard from the passage outside from time to time.
The space tearing device in front of him had long stopped working.
Fang Heng rubbed his chin and thought for a moment. He stepped forward, squatted down, and reached out to touch the cold mechanical device.
“Hint: You have discovered a damaged large-scale space tearing device.”
“Hint: It’s detected that you have mechanical maintenance skills and the blueprint of the space tearing device. You are regarded to be able to repair the device.”

“Hint: According to the assessment, its current damage is 37%. It can’t be used but is repairable currently. The repair requires 21 advanced precision devices, 11 special alloy metal wires, and 1 wrench. The success rate of repair is 88%. The damage reduction will probably be 0.02%-0.2%.”
What a pleasant surprise!
Fang Heng didn’t expect to find a large-scale space tearing device here.
And it could be repaired and used.
After all, the space tearing devices that could be made in every game world were limited.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - The Unknown Box
paragraphs: “Well, nice!”
Fang Heng murmured in a low voice as he began to think.

The large-scale space tearing device was a good item. It could continue to work after he had the zombies repair it. Fang Heng considered setting this place as their main base. Then, the rapid support ability of the entire army could be significantly improved.
“Sir!”
While he was thinking, a deputy commander in Scavenger Army walked into the teleportation hall.
“Commander Fang Heng, the main control room is currently under control. The regional commanders are cleaning up the remaining resisting members in the fortress.”
“Mm, well done.”
Fang Heng put the space tearing device aside and stood up.
“Tell them to be careful when cleaning up. Try their best not to damage the machines.”
“Yes, sir!”
Soon, a row of game hints appeared before Fang Heng’s eyes.
“Hint: Player Fang Heng, you have led Scavenger Army to occupy Dark Knights’ branch. The overall strength of Dark Knights has been greatly affected.”
“Hint: Your friendship with Dark Knights has been greatly reduced.”
“Hint: Your reputation among Scavenger Army has reached its peak.”
“Hint: You have occupied part of the abandoned factory, and the morale of Scavenger Army has reached its peak.”
“Hint: What you did have affected part of the world’s main storyline.”
Next, it was time to look for the box left by Meteorite Company.
Fang Heng rubbed his neck and exchanged a glance with Osborne, whose eyes flashed with admiration and fanaticism.
“Have you found the map of this fortress?”
“Yes, this is the map of the interior fortress we found in the main control room.”
“Hint: You have obtained the map of the interior of the modified military fortress.”
Fang Heng opened the map and glanced at it.
“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng took a few tyrant and vine zombies and headed to the spot where the coordinate was in his memory.
The Box’s hiding spot detected by the electromagnetic tower was a two-dimensional coordinate.
There were a total of five floors in the fortress, two on the ground and three under the ground.
Fang Heng led the team, searching from the second floor to the third floor underground. They thoroughly searched the rooms on the coordinate but still failed to find the box.
“That’s strange. Why can’t I find it?”
Osborne was puzzled and asked, “Could it be that Dark Knights took the box away when they evacuated?”
Fang Heng frowned and thought for a moment. Then he raised his head and said, “It can’t be. They shouldn’t know anything about the special box. Let’s go back to Level 2 and search again.”
“Okay.”
Then, Fang Heng and Osborne returned to the second-floor lounge.
The two tyrant forms walked to the spot of the coordinate and smashed their fists at the floor.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
They smashed a hole in the floor.
Then, they jumped down from the hole and reached the room below.
They smashed all the way to the room on the third underground level.
But still, they didn’t find anything.
Fang Heng stroked his chin.
“Maybe it’s a hidden room that was not marked on the map.”
Thinking of this, Fang Heng summoned a group of vine zombie clones to the room.
These zombie clones took out their shovels and started digging down.
Half an hour later, the zombie clones found something after digging down for more than five meters.
It was a cement ground!
There was cement right below the coordinate.
So, there might be another room below!
The two tyrant forms immediately jumped down and started to smash the ground with their big fists.
Soon, they smashed a hole again.
There was a room below the hole.
Osborne was surprised for a moment and said, “Is this room left behind by Meteorite Company? Dark Knights might not know its existence.”
“Yeah, let’s take a look in there. We’ll find out.”
As Fang Heng said this, he quickly ordered the two tyrant forms to jump down from where they were.
After confirming no danger was in the room below, Fang Heng followed them and jumped into the space below.
When he landed, a cloud of dust rose up.
Fang Heng quickly scanned the room.
It was dark inside, and there were piles of abandoned sundries everywhere.
There was a thick layer of dust in the room.
Was it a store room?
Fang Heng glanced at its entrance.
No wonder he couldn’t find it on the map. The door of the room had been filled with cement and sealed tightly.
Osborne also jumped down from the hole above. He shone his flashlight back and forth in the room, trying to find clues.
Soon, he noticed a metal box in a pile of sundries in the corner.
“Commander, look here! Is it this one?”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up as he walked up.
“Yeah! We found it!”
The metal box was covered with a thick layer of dust.
Fang Heng reached out and wiped off the dust.
“Hint: You have obtained an item, an unknown box.”
“Item: An unknown box.
Description: A strange metal box with Meteorite Company’s symbol on it.
Description: This item has the powerful strength of creatures. It can’t be transported through the space passage or be stored in a backpack.”
“Hint: You have discovered the unknown box hidden by Meteorite Company for the first time. You have obtained 1,000 main storyline contribution points.”
On the other hand, members of Federation were in the meeting room.
They were silent.
No one had expected that Scavenger Army’s strength had increased significantly in a short time after Fang Heng joined it.
They could actually take down Dark Knights’ branch in less than two hours.

“According to the current information, Fang Heng has completely taken down Dark Knights’ branch. After this battle, Dark Knights’ strength has been greatly reduced. It will probably take them a long time to recover.”
Kou Huai swept his gaze across the crowd.
“I’m gathering everyone here today to discuss our next move.
The death rate of Scavenger Army members is over 50%.
Since Scavenger Army’s current strength has been dramatically reduced, I think this is the best opportunity for us to launch an attack on them.”

A commander brought up a different opinion. “Since they have already suffered a significant loss, and their strength has been greatly reduced, should we just wait three months and not make any move? After three months, Scavenger Army will automatically disband, and we will naturally get over the crisis.
Will that be safer?”
“No.”
Kou Huai shook his head.
He was very doubtful about the time of three months.
“There might be accidents during this time. It’s best to get rid of Scavenger Army as soon as possible.
With the influence of the players, Scavenger Army can possibly survive three more months. I even suspect Fang Heng started this battle to develop a special potion.”
Hearing this, the commanders began to discuss quietly.
“No matter what Fang Heng wants to do, we must continue to put pressure on him, not giving him any chance to catch his breath!”
Kou Huai ordered, “Contact the player guilds in District 7 and get them ready to continue putting pressure on Scavenger Army.
In addition, as long as they can cause substantial damage to Scavenger Army, Federation will give them some reward and compensation, whether it’s an individual or the player guild.”
“Yes, sir!”

“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng took a few tyrant and vine zombies and headed to the spot where the coordinate was in his memory.
The Box’s hiding spot detected by the electromagnetic tower was a two-dimensional coordinate.
There were a total of five floors in the fortress, two on the ground and three under the ground.
Fang Heng led the team, searching from the second floor to the third floor underground.
They thoroughly searched the rooms on the coordinate but still failed to find the box.
“That’s strange.
Why can’t I find it?”
Osborne was puzzled and asked, “Could it be that Dark Knights took the box away when they evacuated?”
Fang Heng frowned and thought for a moment.
Then he raised his head and said, “It can’t be.
They shouldn’t know anything about the special box.
Let’s go back to Level 2 and search again.”
“Okay.”
Then, Fang Heng and Osborne returned to the second-floor lounge.
The two tyrant forms walked to the spot of the coordinate and smashed their fists at the floor.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
They smashed a hole in the floor.
Then, they jumped down from the hole and reached the room below.
They smashed all the way to the room on the third underground level.
But still, they didn’t find anything.
Fang Heng stroked his chin.
“Maybe it’s a hidden room that was not marked on the map.”
Thinking of this, Fang Heng summoned a group of vine zombie clones to the room.
These zombie clones took out their shovels and started digging down.
Half an hour later, the zombie clones found something after digging down for more than five meters.
It was a cement ground!
There was cement right below the coordinate.
So, there might be another room below!
The two tyrant forms immediately jumped down and started to smash the ground with their big fists.
Soon, they smashed a hole again.
There was a room below the hole.
Osborne was surprised for a moment and said, “Is this room left behind by Meteorite Company?
Dark Knights might not know its existence.”
“Yeah, let’s take a look in there.
We’ll find out.”
As Fang Heng said this, he quickly ordered the two tyrant forms to jump down from where they were.
After confirming no danger was in the room below, Fang Heng followed them and jumped into the space below.
When he landed, a cloud of dust rose up.
Fang Heng quickly scanned the room.
It was dark inside, and there were piles of abandoned sundries everywhere.
There was a thick layer of dust in the room.
Was it a store room?
Fang Heng glanced at its entrance.
No wonder he couldn’t find it on the map.
The door of the room had been filled with cement and sealed tightly.
Osborne also jumped down from the hole above.
He shone his flashlight back and forth in the room, trying to find clues.
Soon, he noticed a metal box in a pile of sundries in the corner.
“Commander, look here!
Is it this one?”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up as he walked up.
“Yeah!
We found it!”
The metal box was covered with a thick layer of dust.
Fang Heng reached out and wiped off the dust.
“Hint: You have obtained an item, an unknown box.”
“Item: An unknown box.
Description: A strange metal box with Meteorite Company’s symbol on it.
Description: This item has the powerful strength of creatures.
It can’t be transported through the space passage or be stored in a backpack.”
“Hint: You have discovered the unknown box hidden by Meteorite Company for the first time.
You have obtained 1,000 main storyline contribution points.”
On the other hand, members of Federation were in the meeting room.
They were silent.
No one had expected that Scavenger Army’s strength had increased significantly in a short time after Fang Heng joined it.
They could actually take down Dark Knights’ branch in less than two hours.
“According to the current information, Fang Heng has completely taken down Dark Knights’ branch.
After this battle, Dark Knights’ strength has been greatly reduced.
It will probably take them a long time to recover.”
Kou Huai swept his gaze across the crowd.
“I’m gathering everyone here today to discuss our next move.
The death rate of Scavenger Army members is over 50%.
Since Scavenger Army’s current strength has been dramatically reduced, I think this is the best opportunity for us to launch an attack on them.”
A commander brought up a different opinion.
“Since they have already suffered a significant loss, and their strength has been greatly reduced, should we just wait three months and not make any move?
After three months, Scavenger Army will automatically disband, and we will naturally get over the crisis.
Will that be safer?”
“No.”
Kou Huai shook his head.
He was very doubtful about the time of three months.
“There might be accidents during this time.
It’s best to get rid of Scavenger Army as soon as possible.
With the influence of the players, Scavenger Army can possibly survive three more months.
I even suspect Fang Heng started this battle to develop a special potion.”
Hearing this, the commanders began to discuss quietly.
“No matter what Fang Heng wants to do, we must continue to put pressure on him, not giving him any chance to catch his breath!”
Kou Huai ordered, “Contact the player guilds in District 7 and get them ready to continue putting pressure on Scavenger Army.
In addition, as long as they can cause substantial damage to Scavenger Army, Federation will give them some reward and compensation, whether it’s an individual or the player guild.”
“Yes, sir!”

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - Deep Blue Enigma
paragraphs: After leaving part of the Zombie clone in the Dark Knights’ branch that had just been conquered, Fang Heng returned to the main base of the Scavenger Army with the box containing the tissue sample of Hila.
The general manager of the laboratory, Ding Min, had just taken a few hours of sleep when she was urgently summoned to the secret laboratory by Fang Heng.
“Hint: Ding Min of the Scavenger Army, the loyalty of the Army decreased by 1 point. Current loyalty: 80.”
“Commander Fang Heng, What’s so urgent?”
Ding Min was very angry when she got out of bed. “I’ve already told you that I can’t carry out the modification of the Tyrant form without the original liquid of worm body.”
“No, that’s not why I called you here.”Fang Heng pointed at the round table behind the tempered glass. “I found the latest sample of Hila’s tissue.”
Seeing the metal box on the Round Table, Ding Min instantly lost her sleepiness.
“This is...”
Ding Min leaned forward, her face almost sticking to the tempered glass.
“This is the secret box hidden by Meteorite Company?”
“Yes.”
“When did you find it? Is it the box in the branch of the Dark Knights that we found before?”
“Yes, I just got it not long ago.”
Fang Heng nodded, “The branch of the Dark Knights was destroyed by us an hour ago. Now it belongs to the Scavenger Army.”
Ding Min turned around and looked at Fang Heng as if she wanted to get to know him again.
She had just gone back to catch up on her sleep. Fang Heng had already taken over the branch of the Dark Knights with his team before she could fully wake up?
“So Fast? How did you do it?”
“I kind of barged in.”
Fang Heng’s answer was concise and to the point.
The topic then circled back to research. “How much do you know about the research and development of the Hila’s tissue sample?”

Ding Min turned her head and looked at the metal box behind the tempered glass, she pursed her lips and said, “I don’t know much either. Commander Cook has always been on guard against me. Some things were only discovered by accident when I was collecting information last night.”

“Alright, I hope that you will immediately stop what you’re doing now and shift to the research and development of the Hila project. If there is anything you need, let me know immediately. Also, all the research and development files must be formed into experimental reports.”
“The most important thing at the moment is that I need to accelerate the cultivation speed of the original liquid of worm body.”

Fang Heng looked at Ding Min, “I will give you the highest research authority. I will immediately arrange for any personnel you need. We will also do our best to get all the materials you need. How long do you think it will take for the results to come out?”
Ding Min pursed her lips and thought for a moment.

“I read some experimental reports about the original liquid last night. I have also roughly studied the operation of the cultivation pod. With the new living organism of the Hila organization, it is not difficult to speed up the production of the unknown raw liquid. Half a day is enough.”
“As for the follow-up research on the Hila experiment, the time required is unpredictable.”
Ding Min said as she looked away from the box and turned to look at Fang Heng.
“Right now, I need a very important item. I need your help.”
“Mm, what can I do to help?”
“I need all the information on the project of Deep Blue Enigma that Meteorite Company had previously developed.”
“Deep Blue Enigma?”
Fang Heng frowned tightly. He had never heard of this in his memory.
Could it be that Meteorite Company had some special secret experimental project?

Ding min continued, “The project uses the essence of deep-sea seaweed to conduct research and attempt to fusion with the latest negative ion pore repair technology. It can deeply repair the aging of the skin and improve...”
The more Fang Heng Heard, the more he felt that something was not right. “Wait, the Deep Blue Enigma that you’re talking about can’t be a facial mask, right?”
“Yes, is there something wrong?”Ding Min asked curiously. “I will use my spare time to research and develop the Deep Blue Enigma Project. It Won’t take up any of my working time.”
Fang Heng was rather confused.
“What’s with that expression?”Ding Min didn’t think much of it. “Staying up late can cause fatal damage to the skin...”
After becoming the leader of the Scavenger Army, Fang Heng realized that being the leader indeed came with a lot of work.
There were too many things to deal with, and he was forced to work continuously.
The Scavenger Army won this battle, but they only scraped a narrow victory.
In order to ensure that they could take over the Dark Knights’ branch in a very short period of time, the entire Scavenger Army had also paid a very heavy price.
The entire army had lost 62% of its members!
In the following period of time, the Scavenger Army’s combat ability would be greatly reduced.
For the Scavenger Army, it had always been very troublesome to recruit new members. They needed a period of time to make it happen.

The newly recruited members were only beginner members. They could only use the lowest-level divine potion. After a period of time, the human body would be able to adapt to the stronger parasite body and take the intermediate divine potion.
There was indeed a shortcut.
Players were the key!
Players could complete the transformation in a very short period of time using the divine potion.
However, Fang Heng did not want to let the players take the risk.
The divine potion would affect an ordinary player’s spirit, even in real life.
This would pose a great threat to the real world.
Fang Heng did not want to destroy this peaceful world.
Then he could only look for NPCs to expand the team.
He had to modify the recruitment conditions to allow more people to join the Scavenger Army.

In the past, due to the limited supply of divine potions, the number of Scavenger Army members came with a limit. Now that he had obtained a new tissue sample of Hila, the production of divine potions would also increase, and he could recruit more elites.

In addition, he still needed to arrange for people to guard the Dark Knights’ branch area. The damaged space tearing device still needed maintenance, and the main base also needed a small-scale sub-teleportation device.
Construction materials needed to be prepared in advance.
Fang Heng was about to call Osborne to discuss when he noticed the game hint ringing again.

“Hint: player received an emergency message from outside the game cabin. Message: Fang Heng, the guild leader of the Leftway Gaming Guild is here. My fourth uncle wants to discuss cooperation with us. He’s already here. Do you want to meet him? If you have time, let me know.”
Fang Heng frowned slightly.
Leftway Gaming Guild?
In District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse, there was only one dominant player force, and that was Federation.
For many years, Kou Huai had been devoting himself to planning the development of District 7. All the player guilds’ forces were under his control.
Every guild that had developed to a certain stage would be targeted by Federation in the dark.
Fang Heng remembered that some time ago, the Leftway Gaming Guild started a conflict between the Scavenger Army and the game guilds in District 7.
“Leftway Gaming Guild is cooperating with me?” Fang Heng thought.
“Why do they want to cooperate with me? Is he not afraid of offending Federation?”
“Or was there another trap?” Fang Heng was very confused.
No matter what, he had to play along for Mo Yunxiao’s sake.
For a long time, Mo Yunxiao had been of great help to him.
Fang Heng had always been very grateful to Mo Yunxiao.
Thinking of this, Fang Heng dropped a backpack on the spot and went offline.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - Conspiracy
paragraphs: It was now In the reception room.
Mo Yunxiao and the other two were drinking tea.
Tian Zhen nodded at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei when he saw them walk in.
This was the first time he had seen Fang Heng with his own eyes.
He was even younger than what he had seen in the video!
Mo Yunxiao waved his hand and signaled to Fang Heng to sit down.

“Fang Heng, you’ve come at the right time. I suppose you haven’t met. This is Tian Zhen, the president of Leftway Gaming Guild. “Mo Yunxiao pointed at another middle-aged man. “This is my senior brother from the tea ceremony tutoring class, senior brother Wuxin. I’ll take senior brother Wuxin on a tour to see my collection of tea sets. You guys take your time...”
Mo Yunxiao simply greeted everyone and left the room with his senior brother. He also closed the reception room’s door.
Only Tian Zhen and the other two were left in the room.
Tian Zhen poured a cup of tea for each of them.

“Fang Heng, We’ve fought a few times before. To put it bluntly, it’s all for the sake of benefits. I’m sure you can understand. I’ll just be level with you. Let me apologize to you by drinking this cup of tea.”
After Tian Zhen said that, he finished his cup of tea.
“Okay.”
Fang Heng took a sip of tea. “We’re all busy people. Why don’t we just cut to the chase?”
“Okay. I’m here to cooperate with you.”
“How do you want to cooperate?”
Tian Zhen had already thought of everything before coming here.
He said word by word, “I will do my best to help you defeat Federation and seize the main task of District 7.”
Fang Heng’s eyes were wide open as he stared at Tian Zhen.
“Really?”
Tian Zhen looked sincere and earnest.
“I would like for us to work together.”
This cooperation was a huge gamble for the entire Leftway Gaming Guild.
Previously, Tian Zhen had been hesitant about this.

Not long ago, after witnessing Fang Heng plot to kill Federation’s reinforcements and lead the Scavenger Army to capture the Dark Knights’ branch with his own eyes, Tian Zhen finally made up his mind.
He decided to take a shot.
He had an extremely strong hunch.
He believed Fang Heng would win!
“Because we are restricted by Federation, we can only help you in secret. We will do everything in our power to help you.”

Tian Zhen listed all his requests. “Our request is that after the final main task of District 7 is settled, we need your support to allow the Leftway Gaming Guild to develop the shelter industry in District 7 and establish a shelter community. The designated area is thirty times the scope agreed upon by Federation. This is the scope that we have planned in advance.”
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei looked at each other.
Mo Jiawei understood. He took the proposal and quickly flipped through it.
He whispered in Fang Heng’s ear, “It’s about the size of an area of Edge Creek Town.”
Fang Heng tried to figure it out in his head.
The request from Tian town was nothing to him.
They just wanted to expand their territory.
When the time came, the entire District 7 and District 8 would be his, not to mention one Edge Creek Town because he could even afford a hundred of that!
And it would have the slightest impact on him
Upon second thought, he was now almost alone in District 7.
Unless he went to the black market to recruit fighters, no player would join him even if he posted an advertisement with desirable benefits.
The Scavenger Army itself had a lot of trouble to deal with.
He really could use some outside assistance!
To work with Tian Town’s Leftway Gaming Guild was exactly what he wanted. They concluded a deal very fast.
The problem was trust.
Fang Heng looked at Tian Zhen, wondering if he should trust him.

Tian Zhen said, “Standing up against Federation in secret comes with great risk. We have to earn ourselves enough benefits. 30 times the size of territory agreed upon with Federation would be our bottom line.”
“The payment is not a problem. I also hope that we can work together, but how can I trust you?”
Hearing that Fang Heng agreed to this condition, Tian Zhen breathed a sigh of relief.
Regarding the cooperation and trust, Tian Zhen had already made plans in advance.

“Don’t worry about this. I have already informed Mr. Mo Yunxiao. Mr. Mo will be the notary. As long as you agree, I can take out part of the company’s shares as collateral and hand it over to North River Heavy Industry.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat as he looked at Tian Zhen.
Tian Zhen also looked at Fang Heng.
Zuo Dao’s shares of Leftway Gaming Guild were an extremely important bargaining chip in Tian Zhen’s eyes.
As for Fang Heng, this could hardly be an enticing condition for him.
Fang Heng was thinking about competing against the entire District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse.
He didn’t care about Zuo Dao’s company shares at all.
Mo Yunxiao would be the key factor to think about.
Mo Yunxiao was willing to be a witness, which meant that Mo Yunxiao was willing to trust Tian Zhen.
With this in mind, Fang Heng immediately felt much more at ease.
“Mr. Tian, are you sure? If you cooperate with me, it’s very likely that you’ll offend Federation.”
Tian Zhen said seriously, “I’m sure.”
“Alright! I wish us happy cooperation!”

Fang Heng did not like dawdling, so he immediately made the decision, “I can also promise you that you will only need to act in secret from now on. Even if our cooperation fails one day, I will not expose the fact that you are cooperating with me. Even if there is a problem, it will not implicate your guild.”
“Thank you.”
After finalizing the cooperation with Fang Heng, Tian Zhen felt relieved, and a smile touched his face.
“However, there is one point that needs to be made clear. We will definitely not fail.”
“That’s right.”
Fang Heng was in a good mood. He picked up his teacup and took a small sip.
In terms of strength, the Leftway Gaming Guild was simply pale in comparison with Federation.
Fang Heng did not expect them to join the direct battle against Federation.
He just wanted them to hide in the dark, which was the biggest help they could be of.
He continued to expand his train of thought.
If he had Tian Zhen’s help, then..
Perhaps he could..
In a short moment, a rough version of the plan was quickly laid out in Fang Heng’s mind.
He had it!
The hidden ending of Hila experiment!

The current main task of the Scavenger Army was too difficult. They needed to occupy more than 85% of the world’s regions, and with Federation obstructing them, it was almost impossible to complete it.
If they had Tian Zhen’s help, perhaps with their strength, they could secretly build electromagnetic induction towers around the world to search for Meteorite Company’s mysterious box!

When the time came, the induction towers built around the world would be directly connected to the Scavenger Army’s main electromagnetic tower, searching for the location of the remaining 10 samples of the Hila organization around the world..

Once the plan was successful, the Hila organization sample could speed up the production efficiency of the divine potion. This also meant that he could provide more divine potions, which was equivalent to increasing the combat strength of the Scavenger Army.
If he was lucky, he might even be able to bypass the conquering ending of the Scavenger Army and trigger the hidden ending of the Hila experiment!
Perhaps two endings could be triggered at the same time?
Fang Heng could not help but feel a little excited.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this plan was very feasible.
Mo Jiawei watched quietly from the side.
He saw the familiar look of concern on Fang Heng’s face, and he realized something.
He knew that Fang Heng must be plotting something.

He whispered in Fang Heng’s ear, “It’s about the size of an area of Edge Creek Town.”
Fang Heng tried to figure it out in his head.
The request from Tian town was nothing to him.
They just wanted to expand their territory.
When the time came, the entire District 7 and District 8 would be his, not to mention one Edge Creek Town because he could even afford a hundred of that!
And it would have the slightest impact on him
Upon second thought, he was now almost alone in District 7.
Unless he went to the black market to recruit fighters, no player would join him even if he posted an advertisement with desirable benefits.
The Scavenger Army itself had a lot of trouble to deal with.
He really could use some outside assistance!
To work with Tian Town’s Leftway Gaming Guild was exactly what he wanted.
They concluded a deal very fast.
The problem was trust.
Fang Heng looked at Tian Zhen, wondering if he should trust him.
Tian Zhen said, “Standing up against Federation in secret comes with great risk.
We have to earn ourselves enough benefits.
30 times the size of territory agreed upon with Federation would be our bottom line.”
“The payment is not a problem.
I also hope that we can work together, but how can I trust you?”
Hearing that Fang Heng agreed to this condition, Tian Zhen breathed a sigh of relief.
Regarding the cooperation and trust, Tian Zhen had already made plans in advance.
“Don’t worry about this.
I have already informed Mr.
Mo Yunxiao.
Mr.
Mo will be the notary.
As long as you agree, I can take out part of the company’s shares as collateral and hand it over to North River Heavy Industry.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat as he looked at Tian Zhen.
Tian Zhen also looked at Fang Heng.
Zuo Dao’s shares of Leftway Gaming Guild were an extremely important bargaining chip in Tian Zhen’s eyes.
As for Fang Heng, this could hardly be an enticing condition for him.
Fang Heng was thinking about competing against the entire District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse.
He didn’t care about Zuo Dao’s company shares at all.
Mo Yunxiao would be the key factor to think about.
Mo Yunxiao was willing to be a witness, which meant that Mo Yunxiao was willing to trust Tian Zhen.
With this in mind, Fang Heng immediately felt much more at ease.
“Mr.
Tian, are you sure?
If you cooperate with me, it’s very likely that you’ll offend Federation.”
Tian Zhen said seriously, “I’m sure.”
“Alright!
I wish us happy cooperation!”
Fang Heng did not like dawdling, so he immediately made the decision, “I can also promise you that you will only need to act in secret from now on.
Even if our cooperation fails one day, I will not expose the fact that you are cooperating with me.
Even if there is a problem, it will not implicate your guild.”
“Thank you.”
After finalizing the cooperation with Fang Heng, Tian Zhen felt relieved, and a smile touched his face.
“However, there is one point that needs to be made clear.
We will definitely not fail.”
“That’s right.”
Fang Heng was in a good mood.
He picked up his teacup and took a small sip.
In terms of strength, the Leftway Gaming Guild was simply pale in comparison with Federation.
Fang Heng did not expect them to join the direct battle against Federation.
He just wanted them to hide in the dark, which was the biggest help they could be of.
He continued to expand his train of thought.
If he had Tian Zhen’s help, then..
Perhaps he could..
In a short moment, a rough version of the plan was quickly laid out in Fang Heng’s mind.
He had it!
The hidden ending of Hila experiment!
The current main task of the Scavenger Army was too difficult.
They needed to occupy more than 85% of the world’s regions, and with Federation obstructing them, it was almost impossible to complete it.
If they had Tian Zhen’s help, perhaps with their strength, they could secretly build electromagnetic induction towers around the world to search for Meteorite Company’s mysterious box!

When the time came, the induction towers built around the world would be directly connected to the Scavenger Army’s main electromagnetic tower, searching for the location of the remaining 10 samples of the Hila organization around the world..
Once the plan was successful, the Hila organization sample could speed up the production efficiency of the divine potion.
This also meant that he could provide more divine potions, which was equivalent to increasing the combat strength of the Scavenger Army.
If he was lucky, he might even be able to bypass the conquering ending of the Scavenger Army and trigger the hidden ending of the Hila experiment!
Perhaps two endings could be triggered at the same time?
Fang Heng could not help but feel a little excited.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this plan was very feasible.
Mo Jiawei watched quietly from the side.
He saw the familiar look of concern on Fang Heng’s face, and he realized something.
He knew that Fang Heng must be plotting something.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - Transformation
paragraphs: Fang Heng suddenly raised his head and asked, “Right, does the game guilds of the left path come with a large-scale space tearing device in the game?”

“There’s no such sophisticated device as that. District 7 has always been under the strict control of Kou Huai. Only a very small number of game guilds that work closely with Federation can obtain a small-scale space tearing device from Federation.”
Tian Zhen smiled bitterly.
How could it be that easy!
There was a limited number of space-tearing devices in the entire region, and all of them were under the control of Federation.
Meanwhile, Federation had already rejected several of their requests to build small-scale teleportation points.
In fact, Tian Zhen knew very well that this was a restriction that Federation had placed on their guild.
Federation would provide some small-scale player guilds with a small-scale space-teleportation device. As for the main devices, they would hold them tightly in their own hands.
“It doesn’t matter. There’s still time. We’ll just start building one. You should prepare the materials.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he casually picked up a piece of paper on the table and wrote on it the materials needed to build the space tearing device branch, the small-sized space tearing device.
Seeing Fang Heng writing at full speed, Tian Zhen was stunned. For a moment, he did not know what to say.
“Wait, you know how to build a space tearing device?”
“Yes, but I only have the theoretical knowledge.”

Fang Heng replied while writing in his notebook, “Every time you create the main tearing device, you need to consume blueprints. However, you don’t need to create a small-scale space tearing device. Coincidentally, I found the large-scale space tearing device left behind by the Dark Knights that I just conquered.”
“It can still be used if it is repaired.”
Tian Zhen was once again shocked by Fang Heng.
It did not occur to Tian Zhen that Fang Heng could actually repair and construct a large-scale space tearing device.
Was this considered a bug?

What was even stranger was that from the development of District 7 until now, all the blueprints in theory had already been controlled by Federation. How could Fang Heng know how to construct a large-scale space tearing device?
If he swapped servers, all of the skills would be reset by default, including the blueprints that he had already mastered..
Fang Heng handed over the note that he had recorded.

“Take it. This is the list of the manufacturing materials. Also, give me the coordinates of your headquarters. When the materials are completed, I’ll bring people over to manufacture them. Remember, it must be kept a secret...”
“Okay, I understand. I’ll arrange it immediately when I’m back.”
Tian Zhen opened his mouth and took the note.
He felt that it was better not to pry into each other’s secrets since both sides had just started cooperating.
Tian Zhen thought for a moment and asked, “Can I send someone to your side? That way, it’ll be easier for us to communicate in the game.”
Fang Heng nodded and said, “Of course, no problem.”

Fang Heng stood up and patted Tian Zhen on the shoulder, “Get Ready. I’ll help you become the biggest force in District 7 next to Federation. Get ready for the development. If you need money, borrow some from outside.”
Tian Zhen was stunned. “Borrow money?”

“Oh, it’s no big deal. I’ll take care of that.”Mo Jiawei listened for a long time. Finally, he had a chance to show off. He patted his chest, “Although North River Heavy industry can’t lend you money in public, I have a lot of connections. I can pull a few strings and get you the money you need.”
“Uh, okay, okay...”
Tian Zhen stared blankly at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei. His reply was a little stiff.
He did not understand why he would want to borrow money.
For a moment, he was a little confused by Fang Heng’s out-of-the-box thinking.
Just a moment ago, they were discussing the construction of a small-scale space tearing device. How did it suddenly become that they wanted to become the largest force in the game besides Federation?
Mo Jiawei saw Tian Zhen’s stiff smile and thought that he was worried. He also came up and patted Tian Zhen on the shoulder.
“Don’t worry. As long as you intend to cooperate with Fang Heng. I guarantee that you will earn a lot more money than you can spend for the rest of your life. Trust me, I have been there.”
Tian Zhen smiled bitterly. However, seeing that Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei were so confident, he was somehow reassured.

“Oh right, there’s one more thing, Fang Heng.” Tian Zhen thought of something, then he said seriously, “Before I came here, I received news that Federation wants to take advantage of the fact that the strength of the Scavenger Army has been greatly reduced this time to prepare to attack you. You have to be careful and make plans in advance.”
“Yes, I will be careful.”
Fang Heng was not surprised by Federation’s retaliation.
This was also what kept troubling him.
Currently, the strength of the entire Scavenger Army had fallen to the bottom, so it was very difficult to resist Federation’s attack head-on.
Fang Heng was already prepared to get rid of a few branches of Federation to buy more time for his development.
But he had other plans.
He couldn’t let them get the upper hand so easily.
Fang Heng rubbed his chin, thinking about playing a trick on them.
Six hours later, it was in front of the cultivation pod in the secret research lab.
Two Tyrant forms stood in the cultivation pod.
The door slowly closed.
Red liquid was poured into the pod, soaking the two Tyrant forms.
Ding Min held the record book in her hand and said in a low voice, “The experiment begins.”
“Hint: your zombie corpse is being modified.”
“Hint: the current Scavenger Army has 18 researchers above Grade A, a high-level research personnel’s cultivation POD * 3, divine potion and original liquid of worm body * 782.”
“Hint: player has met the current Tyrant form-mutant bug form modification condition.”
“Hint: this modification is only for the Tyrant form’s zombie clone.”

“Hint: currently, players can modify two Tyrant forms. The current modification will cost 50,000 survival points (per player) , Tier 1 evolution crystal * 50, the modification will last for 48 hours, divine potion and original liquid of worm body * 300(as well as other nutrient solution consumption) player can consume additional survival points to speed up the efficiency of the modification.”
“Hint: current evolution success rate is 100% . Would you like to begin evolution?”
“100% success rate! Good!”
Fang Heng thought to himself.
“Evolution! Increase the speed! Increase the speed to the maximum!”

“Hint: player has consumed 100,000 survival points. Tier 1 evolution crystal * 100. Divine potion and original liquid of worm body * 600. Player has consumed an additional 100,000 survival points to shorten the evolution time.”
“Hint remaining time of current transformation 6 hours.”
“Splash, splash, splash...”
A series of bubbles emerged from the large-scale cultivation pod.
It was just another 6 hours to go.
By then the Tyrant would appear following the mutated insect body transformation
Fang Heng indeed looked forward to that.
Ding Min was observing the situation in the cultivation pod while holding a pen and paper to record the data while explaining to Fang Heng.
“The newly collected cells of the new Hila creature are more active, so we can extract a large amount of the insect’s body fluid in a short period of time.”
“Don’t get hyped up yet. The current state is not stable. As time passes, the speed at which we obtain the unknown insect’s body fluid will greatly decrease until we return to a normal standard.”
“Hmm.”

Fang Heng understood what he said. He knew that by obtaining more samples of Hila’s tissue, he would be able to obtain more original liquid of worm body and think of a way to let more Tyrant form evolve!
So he knew what to do next.
The following work would be left for Tian Zhen. He would be responsible for managing the global distribution of Electromagnetic Induction Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - Black Castle’s Invitation
paragraphs: “I’ll have someone take care of the cultivation pod 24 hours a day. It’s already late. I’m going back to rest. Here’s today’s record report,” Ding Min said.
She put the record book on the table and left the laboratory.
Just as she reached the door, she met Osborne who was about to enter the laboratory to look for Fang Heng.
“Hi, Dr. Ding Min,” Fang Heng said.
“Hi,” Ding Min said.

Ding Min nodded. She suddenly thought of something and turned to Fang Heng. “By the way, Commander Fang Heng, the mask information you promised me should be obtained as soon as possible so that I can devote myself to research and development.”
Fang Heng said wordlessly, “Humph, typical woman.”
He did not know how to complain. He waved his hand at Ding Min and made an okay gesture, watching her leave.

“Commander Fang Heng, the abandoned mine area is temporarily guarded by Regional Commander Roche with his men. Edge Creek Town is not heavily guarded, so there might be trouble. After the previous battle, we suffered heavy casualties, so we need to recruit more men as soon as possible,” Osborne said.
He rushed into the room and reported the latest progress of the Scavenger Army to Fang Heng.

Osborne said, “In addition, all the building materials you needed before are being sorted and collected. Most of the building materials are available in the army, and a small number of special materials should be collected from the regional branches. It is expected that all of them will be delivered to the abandoned mine area by noon tomorrow.”
Fang Heng did not speak.
He stared at Osborne.
Fang Heng felt that something was wrong as soon as Osborn entered the room.
He looked at Osborne carefully, and there seemed to be an extremely blurry shadow behind Osborne.
He thought, “What is it?
“Or is it just my illusion?”
Fang Heng was puzzled when a hint flashed across his eyes.
“Hint: Your basic perception attribute has reached over 30. You have noticed something strange.”
“Hey, Commander, what’s wrong?” Osborne asked.
“No, nothing,” Fang Heng said.
He confirmed.
It was not his illusion.

Fang Heng pondered for a moment, then nodded and said, “I got it. After the materials are delivered, you should immediately speed up the recruitment process. You can adopt more flexible requirements when selecting people.”
“Okay,” Osborne said.

“Hint: You have issued the order to recruit members for Scavenger Army. The current morale points of Scavenger Army have reached their maximum. Recruiting members will cause a small drop in morale points.”
“Hint: Please note that recruiting too many members will result in a shortage of strategic reserve materials.”

“There is one more thing, Commander. The patrol team at the periphery of the headquarters met a suspicious person in the mountain when they were patrolling. The person claimed to be looking for you, saying that she was recommended by Old Black,” Osborne said.
“Old Black?” Fang Heng said.
He raised his eyebrows. “You have brought her into the headquarters?”

“Yes. According to the patrol officers, she has some special abilities. We’ve temporarily placed her in the temporary dungeon in the headquarters.” Osborne nodded and explained. Then he asked, “Should I bring her here now?”
“No need,” Fang Heng said.
Then he took half a step sideways, quickly raising his hand and smashing it forward severely.
Osborne was greatly shocked.
He felt a gust of wind blowing past his ear.
Fang Heng’s fist brushed past his ear and smashed forward.
Bang!
A figure appeared in the air after being hit by Fang Heng’s fist.
Wu Siying held a dagger in one hand to block in front of her body.
Fang Heng’s fist smashed fiercely against the dagger.
Wu Siying felt a large force.
She struggled to control her body and retreated a few steps before she could deflect all the force from Fang Heng’s fist.
Fang Heng’s fist was also cut by the dagger.
Drops of blood dripped down the wound.
The dagger-cut wound on Fang Heng’s fist healed in an instant because of the Vampire Bloodline and high Physique.
Osborne finally reacted. He immediately raised his shotgun and aimed at the woman.
Osborne was still surprised and bewildered.
He thought, “When did she follow me? Why did not I notice her?”
Fang Heng stopped attacking and asked, “Are you a friend of Old Black?”
“Yes, I’m Wu Siying from Black Castle,” Wu Siying said.
Wu Siying straightened her body and tried her best to appear calm.
She never thought that Fang Heng could see through her stealth.
Wu Siying thought that Fang Heng was just an ordinary summoner who relied on the zombie team to fight. She couldn’t imagine that the strength attached to Fang Heng’s punch was so terrifying.
Fang Heng did not look like a low-level player at all.
“Black Castle?” Fang Heng thought.
He looked at Wu Siying and thought to himself.
Black Castle was a very mysterious organization in the game.
In his memory, he had seen this name by chance when he collected information.
The Federation claimed that Black Castle was one of the extremely dangerous anti-federal organizations, and they did not dare to offend this organization.

However, in reality, few ordinary players had really come into contact with the Black Castle, and information about Black Castle in the outside world was also very rare. Black Castle spent most of its time in advanced game world and rarely participated in low-level games.
Fang Heng thought, “Why did she come here?”
Wu Siying put away her dagger and stretched out her left hand to press on her right shoulder.
Creak.
There was a soft sound.
The shoulder that had been dislocated by Fang Heng’s punch was restored to its original shape.

“Fang Heng, I invite you to join us on behalf of Black Castle. We will help you obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7. In exchange, we need you to agree to some conditions after that,” Wu Siying said.
“I refuse,” Fang Heng said.
“You can take a look at the contents of the contract first.”
Wu Siying flipped her wrist, and a pitch-black contract scroll appeared in her hand.
“No need. I refuse.”
Wu Siying’s brows were tightly knitted.
She did not expect Fang Heng to reject so decisively again.
How could anyone refuse such a generous condition?
Wu Siying thought of something.
That was right. Fang Heng was only an elementary player. He didn’t understand what a final authority of the game world actually meant.

Wu Siying said, “Fang Heng, I’m afraid you don’t know what it means to obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7. Even in an advanced game world, countless people are desperate to obtain the final authority of the game world.”
“No need. Thank you for your kindness,” Fang Heng said.
He still shook his head and refused.
In the game, things like contract scrolls were very strange. If one wasn’t careful, he could easily be cheated.
In addition, Fang Heng did not think that he needed the help of the Black Castle.
He already had a plan.
Once the transformation of the mutant worm body Tyrant was completed, he would have Tier 5 mutated zombie work for him.
When that time came, the Federation would be in big trouble.
Fang Heng was confident that he could obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7 by himself.
It was just a District 7 Federation.
There was no need to sign a contract and be controlled by others.

“Fang Heng, we have assessed your strength. You are indeed capable of controlling zombies, but it’s impossible for you to successfully occupy District 7 by yourself.” Wu Siying continued to try to persuade him, “We have received news that the Federation will launch an attack on Scavenger Army soon.”
“There’s no need.” Fang Heng turned to look at Osborne. “Osborne, help me send my guest off.”
As they were talking, a Scavenger Army elite stepped into the room.
“Report!” the Scavenger Army elite said.
“What’s the matter?” Fang Heng asked.
“Survivors are attacking Edge Creek Town, South City district, and other areas. There are also a small number of unknown scattered team members attacking the various strongholds of Scavenger Army...”
