The person claimed to be looking for you, saying that she was recommended by Old Black,” Osborne said.
“Old Black?” Fang Heng said.
He raised his eyebrows.
“You have brought her into the headquarters?”
“Yes.
According to the patrol officers, she has some special abilities.
We’ve temporarily placed her in the temporary dungeon in the headquarters.” Osborne nodded and explained.
Then he asked, “Should I bring her here now?”
“No need,” Fang Heng said.
Then he took half a step sideways, quickly raising his hand and smashing it forward severely.
Osborne was greatly shocked.
He felt a gust of wind blowing past his ear.
Fang Heng’s fist brushed past his ear and smashed forward.
Bang!
A figure appeared in the air after being hit by Fang Heng’s fist.
Wu Siying held a dagger in one hand to block in front of her body.
Fang Heng’s fist smashed fiercely against the dagger.
Wu Siying felt a large force.
She struggled to control her body and retreated a few steps before she could deflect all the force from Fang Heng’s fist.
Fang Heng’s fist was also cut by the dagger.
Drops of blood dripped down the wound.
The dagger-cut wound on Fang Heng’s fist healed in an instant because of the Vampire Bloodline and high Physique.
Osborne finally reacted.
He immediately raised his shotgun and aimed at the woman.
Osborne was still surprised and bewildered.
He thought, “When did she follow me?
Why did not I notice her?”
Fang Heng stopped attacking and asked, “Are you a friend of Old Black?”
“Yes, I’m Wu Siying from Black Castle,” Wu Siying said.
Wu Siying straightened her body and tried her best to appear calm.
She never thought that Fang Heng could see through her stealth.
Wu Siying thought that Fang Heng was just an ordinary summoner who relied on the zombie team to fight.
She couldn’t imagine that the strength attached to Fang Heng’s punch was so terrifying.
Fang Heng did not look like a low-level player at all.
“Black Castle?” Fang Heng thought.
He looked at Wu Siying and thought to himself.
Black Castle was a very mysterious organization in the game.
In his memory, he had seen this name by chance when he collected information.
The Federation claimed that Black Castle was one of the extremely dangerous anti-federal organizations, and they did not dare to offend this organization.
However, in reality, few ordinary players had really come into contact with the Black Castle, and information about Black Castle in the outside world was also very rare.
Black Castle spent most of its time in advanced game world and rarely participated in low-level games.
Fang Heng thought, “Why did she come here?”
Wu Siying put away her dagger and stretched out her left hand to press on her right shoulder.
Creak.
There was a soft sound.
The shoulder that had been dislocated by Fang Heng’s punch was restored to its original shape.
“Fang Heng, I invite you to join us on behalf of Black Castle.
We will help you obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7.
In exchange, we need you to agree to some conditions after that,” Wu Siying said.
“I refuse,” Fang Heng said.
“You can take a look at the contents of the contract first.”
Wu Siying flipped her wrist, and a pitch-black contract scroll appeared in her hand.
“No need.
I refuse.”
Wu Siying’s brows were tightly knitted.
She did not expect Fang Heng to reject so decisively again.
How could anyone refuse such a generous condition?
Wu Siying thought of something.
That was right.
Fang Heng was only an elementary player.
He didn’t understand what a final authority of the game world actually meant.
Wu Siying said, “Fang Heng, I’m afraid you don’t know what it means to obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7.
Even in an advanced game world, countless people are desperate to obtain the final authority of the game world.”
“No need.
Thank you for your kindness,” Fang Heng said.
He still shook his head and refused.
In the game, things like contract scrolls were very strange.
If one wasn’t careful, he could easily be cheated.
In addition, Fang Heng did not think that he needed the help of the Black Castle.
He already had a plan.
Once the transformation of the mutant worm body Tyrant was completed, he would have Tier 5 mutated zombie work for him.
When that time came, the Federation would be in big trouble.
Fang Heng was confident that he could obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7 by himself.
It was just a District 7 Federation.
There was no need to sign a contract and be controlled by others.
“Fang Heng, we have assessed your strength.

You are indeed capable of controlling zombies, but it’s impossible for you to successfully occupy District 7 by yourself.” Wu Siying continued to try to persuade him, “We have received news that the Federation will launch an attack on Scavenger Army soon.”
“There’s no need.” Fang Heng turned to look at Osborne.
“Osborne, help me send my guest off.”
As they were talking, a Scavenger Army elite stepped into the room.
“Report!” the Scavenger Army elite said.
“What’s the matter?” Fang Heng asked.
“Survivors are attacking Edge Creek Town, South City district, and other areas.
There are also a small number of unknown scattered team members attacking the various strongholds of Scavenger Army...”

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - Mutated Eyeballs
paragraphs: “I got it,” Fang Heng said.
He nodded.
Kou Huai was a tough opponent.
He didn’t even give Fang Heng some breathing space.
Federation reacted faster than Fang Heng had expected.
Fang Heng turned around, seeing Wu Siying’s gaze.
“Why are you still here?” he asked.
“Your strength is still too weak. Fang Heng, you can’t resist Federation alone,” Wu Siying said.

She decided to try one last time. “I suggest you reconsider our proposal. We can help you resist Federation’s attack. At the same time, we can provide you with a piece of hidden information related to the main storyline of Zombie Apocalypse. It will help you complete the main storyline as quickly as possible.
“We can promise you that we will definitely help you obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7 within three months.”
“What?” Fang Heng thought.
His eyes lit up when he heard this.
He thought, “A piece of hidden information related to the main storyline?
“That sounds great!”
However, joining Black Castle would inevitably be controlled by others.
Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “Why are you so sure that I will lose?”
Wu Siying said, “I’ve said it before. We’ve researched you. There’s no way you can stick it out.”
“Since you’re so confident, why don’t we make a bet?”
Wu Siying frowned. “What kind of bet?”

“We’ll bet on whether I can withstand Federation’s pressure. I’ll make Federation suffer a little within a week. Not only can I withstand the pressure, but I’ll make Federation feel great pressure. Do you believe it?”
“I don’t believe it.”

“So, let’s make a bet. If you win, I’ll sign a contract with you to join Black Castle. If you lose, you tell me the hidden information related to the main storyline of Zombie Apocalypse. How about it?”
Wu Siying looked at Fang Heng.
She felt that Fang Heng was too arrogant.
Perhaps he was used to being able to succeed in everything he did, so he was confident that he could defeat Federation.
She thought, “All right. Let Federation teach Fang Heng a lesson.
“However, in that case, it would be more troublesome to help Fang Heng obtain the final authority of the game world in District 7.”
She said, “Such a bet is meaningless. I won’t bet with you. You can’t do it.”
Fang Heng thought, “She actually didn’t fall for it!”
He licked his lips.
He knew it wasn’t that easy to get the hidden main storyline from Wu Siying for nothing.
But for now, it seemed that Wu Siying should not be his enemy.
He would keep her first and then slowly think of a way to get information about the main storyline from her.
“Humph, don’t you believe me? Just wait to see!” Fang Heng said.
Then he said to Osborne, “Osborne, take her to the lounge. Wu Siying, stay here for two days and see what I can do.”
Wu Siying said, “Okay, I’ll wait for you to change your mind.”
Six hours passed.
They were In the secret research room of Scavenger Army.
“Dr. Ding! The pressure in the cultivation pod is too high!”
Ding Min observed the condition of the cultivation pod with a grave expression.
After soaking the Tyrant form in the special solution for six hours, the pale yellow solution turned into blue liquid waste.
“Dr. Ding! The pressure is still rising!”
“Anomaly in the mutation index!”
“The worm body is eroding!”
In the last 10 minutes of the transformation, the Tyrant form in the cultivation pod expanded rapidly.
Creak...
Creak, creak, creak...
Looking closely, the tempered glass of the cultivation pod actually had some tiny cracks.
“Inject Type 3 stabilizer!”
Inside the cultivation pod, the body of the Tyrant form’s heart gradually twisted and grew a strange protruding sarcoma.
At the same time, rows of game hints appeared in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.

“Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant form and vine parasite fusion) is undergoing the transformation into a mutant worm body. The mutant worm body is controlling the nerve center of the Tyrant form and gaining control of the zombie clone.”
“Hint: Your zombie clone is currently in great danger. You can spend 50,000 survival points and 20 Tier 1 evolution crystals to eliminate the hidden danger.”
Fang Heng stared at the cultivation pod in front of him and whispered, “Consumption.”
Purr, purr...
A series of bubbles appeared again in the cultivation pod.
“Report! Dr. Ding! The mutation index is dropping rapidly!”
“The pod’s pressure is still rising!”
Inside the cultivation pod, the sarcoma at the heart of the Tyrant form exploded.
A yellow eyeball replaced the heart and was exposed.
The eyeball seemed to have been given life, looking at the outside world.
What a terrifying thing!
Everyone present felt a sense of fear from the bottom of their hearts when they saw the yellow eyeball.

Ding Min realized that some of the researchers had been frightened by the Tyrant form, so she immediately shouted, “Keep a clear head! Extract the waste liquid! Release the cultivation pod’s pressure!”
Only then did the researchers come back to their senses and continue to control the machinery.
Purr, purr...
The blue waste liquid in the cultivation pod was completely extracted.
Click.
The cultivation pod’s door opened.
Two Tyrant forms stepped out from the two cultivation pods.
Compared with before the evolutionary transformation, the height of these two Tyrant forms had greatly increased.
Their shoulders were wider and thicker, and their height had reached more than three meters.
Osborne felt a great threat from the Tyrant forms. He stretched out his hand and said in a deep voice, “Be careful!”
More than a dozen Scavenger Army elites immediately gathered in front of the cultivation pods and aimed their shotguns at the two fusion Tyrant forms.
Ding Min stared at the data on the control panel with a strange expression.
In her opinion, today’s modification experiment was too strange.
She was already prepared for the experiment to fail.
The worm body in the unknown original liquid of worm body was a highly active and completely uncontrollable kind of mutant worm.
Once they parasitized the Tyrant form’s body, they would definitely try to control the Tyrant form’s center nerve and use it as a parasite puppet.
In the beginning, just as she had expected, the insect body quickly suffered a backlash.
But just as the Tyrant form was about to lose control, the worm body’s backlash suddenly stopped.
What kind of strength had affected this?
Ding Min could not help but turn her head to look at Fang Heng, trying to get some information from him.

“Hint: The player has completed the Tyrant’s fusion form’s advancement. The Tyrant’s fusion form has gained a new addition: a mutant worm body. The player can choose to spend 200,000 survival points and 100 Tier 1 evolution crystals to solidify this state (maintain the new fusion form after death and resurrection).”
After seeing the game hint, Fang Heng felt a slight pain in his heart.
In theory, after the fusion of the mutant worm form, the ability of Tyrant’s fusion form was enough to compare with a Tier 5 life form.
However, the consumption of evolution was also very great.

Fortunately, after mastering the basic occult skill, the mark on the back of the hand could store evolution crystals. Otherwise, just relying on the Tier 1 evolution crystal in Scavenger Army’s warehouse would not be enough for evolution.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The transformed Tyrant forms were huge, and every step they took was extremely heavy.
They stepped forward and stood in front of Fang Heng.
A yellow eyeball form grew out of the original heart of the Tyrant form.
The yellow eyeball form looked up and down at Fang Heng

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - The Zombie Could Run!
paragraphs: “Hint: You have consumed 400,000 survival points and 200 Tier 1 evolution crystals. Your zombie clone has completed the Tyrant’s fusion form, mutant worm body transformation (current fusion: vine parasite, Tyrant form, mutant worm body).”
“Hint: The eyeball has taken control of the Tyrant form’s central nervous system. The Tyrant form has received a greater upgrade. Some of its original skills have changed.”
“Creature: Zombie-Tyrant (fusion form).”
“Basic skills.
Skill: Zombie corpse.

Skill description: Passive effect. Not affected by most mental spells. Not affected by most disease viruses. Does not possess mental strength. Does not possess Energy. Additional 300% increase in HP. (Note: Zombie clone does not possess the ability to infect.)”
“Fusion of mutated eyeball form and the central nervous system.
Description: The mutated eyeball control the central nervous system of the Tyrant form. It will coordinate the physiological functions of all parts of the Tyrant form to achieve an enhanced effect.”
“Skill: The mutated eyeball (complete fusion of related skills of corpse vine armor and the Tyrant form).

Skill description: After the completion of the transformation of the mutated worm form, the heart-mutated eyeball form will replace the functions of the brain and heart. The fusion Tyrant form possesses low-level thinking abilities.

Skill effect 1: The fusion Tyrant form will gain an additional 550% of the basic HP and an additional 1.5% of the maximum HP recovery speed per second. Other than the mutated eyeball, the other parts of the body will receive 85% of the final damage reduction when suffering most of the normal damage (excluding corrosive damage, armor-piercing damage, spell damage, etc.).

Skill effect 2: The fusion Tyrant form has elementary intelligence and can control heavy weapons. The weapon’s skill level will inherit the player’s relevant skill level. Due to the huge size of the fusion form, it can’t control light weapons. Fusion form can run. An additional 105 strength points, 40 agility points, and 95 vitality points will be added to the fusion form.

Skill effect 3: Intimidation. The mutated eyeball form can reduce the enemy’s willpower by 5 points and undergo a willpower test every 60 seconds. Failure to pass the test will result in a fear effect.”
“Skill: Fusion vine.

Skill effect: The fusion Tyrant form can take the initiative to extend vines from its arm to assist, attack, and defend. When attacking, there is a chance to cause vine entanglement to the enemy and confine them.”
“Skill: Mutant worm parasite.

Skill effect 1: The fusion Tyrant form has an unknown mutant worm parasite. When the fusion Tyrant form dies, the unknown purple worm body will crawl out from the corpse, and the worm body can attack the enemy (the worm body can cause infection, making the enemy become a second-generation zombie).

Skill effect 2: The fusion Tyrant form can also take the initiative to release the unknown purple worm body to attack the enemy. 50 worm bodies can be recovered per hour. 500 purple worm bodies can be stored at most(cooldown time: 6 hours).”
“Skill: Reckless evolution.

Skill description: When the zombie corpse’s HP drops below 20%, it will automatically enter Tier 2. When the mutant worm body evolves, its body will expand rapidly, recovering 100% HP. Maximum HP increases to 3,000%. Movement speed reduces by 80%. Strength points increase by 300%. HP recovery speed increases by 1,000%. Some of the original skills will be ineffective after the reckless evolution is completed.”
Ding Min said, “Test completed. Modification is successful.”
She lowered her head to record while reporting all the data of the mutant worm form modification to Fang Heng.

Fang Heng whispered to himself, “Compared to the Nemesis of Meteorite Company, the mutant worm form modification has a greater improvement. It has a higher level of intelligence and can use advanced weapons. In theory, it can understand part of human language and can learn. We believe that the newly grown eyeball form at the heart has completely replaced the function of the brain. It may even have a special effect on the spirit...
“It’s awesome...”
He had already gotten all the data of the modified form from the game hint.
It took him a few minutes to carefully understand the skill of Tyrant’s fusion form.
In Fang Heng’s opinion, other than the additional enhancement of each attribute, the strongest ability of the mutant worm Tyrant form was that it could run.
The zombies could run!
The agility of the Tyrant form had increased a lot.
It had a powerful hunting ability.
It was also amazing that it could use heavy weapons.
In the future, he could use heavy rocket launchers to bombard buildings.
The only problem was the lack of rocket launchers.
The production of a rocket launcher in the game was extremely difficult, and the number was very few.
It also had a defensive ability.
The Tyrant fusion body had only one weakness, the eyeball, and the final damage suffered by all other parts would be reduced by 85%. In addition, it had a maximum HP recovery of 1.5% per second.
It was a proper body shield!
What’s more, the Tyrant form could spread out tiny purple worm bodies from the body.
Fang Heng muttered in his heart, “I don’t know how the specific effects of the worm bodies. I have to think of a way to test the actual effects.”
He prepared to find an opportunity to test the actual combat effectiveness of the fusion Tyrant form.
Then he said, “Osborne.”
“Yes, here,” Osborne said.
He finally came back to his senses.
The constantly rotating eyeballs on the shoulder of the Tyrant’s fusion form made him unconsciously feel a chill riding up his spine.
“How’s the situation in Edge Creek Town now?” Fang Heng asked.

“Well. We don’t have enough military forces deployed in Edge Creek Town. Half an hour ago, a group of survivors launched an attack on Edge Creek Town. Commander Roche immediately led a team back to support as soon as he received the news. Perhaps they have already reached Edge Creek Town. But the situation is not optimistic,” Osborne said.
“Okay. Do we have any rocket launchers in our base?”
“Yes, we currently have a total of 18 of them.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes. “Alright. Let’s start with them.”
As he spoke, a fusion Tyrant form took two steps forward and stood in front of him.
It knelt on one knee and extended its right hand forward.
Fang Heng stepped forward along the Tyrant form’s right arm and stood on the Tyrant form’s broad and thick shoulder.
“Osborne, take me to the armory,” he said.
Osborne raised his head and looked at Fang Heng on the Tyrant form’s shoulders. Only then did he react.
“Yes!” Osborne said.
Night fell.
The three-meter-tall fusion Tyrant form ran wildly on the main road.
Fang Heng sat on the Tyrant form’s broad shoulders.
A cold wind blew across his face.
The Tyrant form had unlimited physical strength. When it ran at full speed, its movement speed was much faster than the speed of a big truck.
In the distance, the sound of gunshots could be heard.
Edge Creek town was engulfed in flames.
Federation’s temporary command post was outside Edge Creek Town.
Commander Liang Hucheng calmly commanded the player team to fight.

Just as his superiors had expected, after attacking Dark Knights, the combat strength of the entire Scavenger Army was greatly weakened, and the defensive ability of Edge Creek Town was also greatly reduced.
After more than an hour of continuous attacks, the defense of the periphery of Edge Creek Town had been completely broken through.
Next, they only needed to clean up the remaining resistance fighters of the Scavenger Army in the town.
Edge Creek Town was about to regain peace.
Liang Hucheng was already thinking about how to write a report when he returned and how to get a reward from his superiors.
Boom! Boom!
Just then, two explosions brought Liang Hucheng’s attention back.

Fang Heng whispered to himself, “Compared to the Nemesis of Meteorite Company, the mutant worm form modification has a greater improvement.
It has a higher level of intelligence and can use advanced weapons.
In theory, it can understand part of human language and can learn.
We believe that the newly grown eyeball form at the heart has completely replaced the function of the brain.
It may even have a special effect on the spirit...
“It’s awesome...”
He had already gotten all the data of the modified form from the game hint.
It took him a few minutes to carefully understand the skill of Tyrant’s fusion form.
In Fang Heng’s opinion, other than the additional enhancement of each attribute, the strongest ability of the mutant worm Tyrant form was that it could run.
The zombies could run!
The agility of the Tyrant form had increased a lot.
It had a powerful hunting ability.
It was also amazing that it could use heavy weapons.
In the future, he could use heavy rocket launchers to bombard buildings.
The only problem was the lack of rocket launchers.
The production of a rocket launcher in the game was extremely difficult, and the number was very few.
It also had a defensive ability.
The Tyrant fusion body had only one weakness, the eyeball, and the final damage suffered by all other parts would be reduced by 85%.
In addition, it had a maximum HP recovery of 1.5% per second.
It was a proper body shield!
What’s more, the Tyrant form could spread out tiny purple worm bodies from the body.
Fang Heng muttered in his heart, “I don’t know how the specific effects of the worm bodies.
I have to think of a way to test the actual effects.”
He prepared to find an opportunity to test the actual combat effectiveness of the fusion Tyrant form.
Then he said, “Osborne.”
“Yes, here,” Osborne said.
He finally came back to his senses.
The constantly rotating eyeballs on the shoulder of the Tyrant’s fusion form made him unconsciously feel a chill riding up his spine.
“How’s the situation in Edge Creek Town now?” Fang Heng asked.
“Well.
We don’t have enough military forces deployed in Edge Creek Town.
Half an hour ago, a group of survivors launched an attack on Edge Creek Town.
Commander Roche immediately led a team back to support as soon as he received the news.
Perhaps they have already reached Edge Creek Town.
But the situation is not optimistic,” Osborne said.
“Okay.
Do we have any rocket launchers in our base?”
“Yes, we currently have a total of 18 of them.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
“Alright.
Let’s start with them.”
As he spoke, a fusion Tyrant form took two steps forward and stood in front of him.
It knelt on one knee and extended its right hand forward.
Fang Heng stepped forward along the Tyrant form’s right arm and stood on the Tyrant form’s broad and thick shoulder.
“Osborne, take me to the armory,” he said.
Osborne raised his head and looked at Fang Heng on the Tyrant form’s shoulders.
Only then did he react.
“Yes!” Osborne said.
Night fell.
The three-meter-tall fusion Tyrant form ran wildly on the main road.
Fang Heng sat on the Tyrant form’s broad shoulders.
A cold wind blew across his face.
The Tyrant form had unlimited physical strength.
When it ran at full speed, its movement speed was much faster than the speed of a big truck.
In the distance, the sound of gunshots could be heard.
Edge Creek town was engulfed in flames.
Federation’s temporary command post was outside Edge Creek Town.
Commander Liang Hucheng calmly commanded the player team to fight.

Just as his superiors had expected, after attacking Dark Knights, the combat strength of the entire Scavenger Army was greatly weakened, and the defensive ability of Edge Creek Town was also greatly reduced.
After more than an hour of continuous attacks, the defense of the periphery of Edge Creek Town had been completely broken through.
Next, they only needed to clean up the remaining resistance fighters of the Scavenger Army in the town.
Edge Creek Town was about to regain peace.
Liang Hucheng was already thinking about how to write a report when he returned and how to get a reward from his superiors.
Boom!
Boom!
Just then, two explosions brought Liang Hucheng’s attention back.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - Actual Combat Test
paragraphs: Liang Hucheng thought, “What’s going on?
“Is it the enemy’s support?”
He found that the temporary camp was in small-scale chaos.
He said wordlessly, “Rocket launchers!”
Looking in the direction where the rocket launcher was coming from, he was shocked.
He thought, “What’s that!”
On a high slope far away from Edge Creek Town, there were two huge black shadows.
Two giant zombies each carried a rocket launcher on their shoulders.
Swish! Swish!
Boom! Boom!
They were continuously firing at the temporary camp with rocket launchers.
Liang Hucheng thought, “Mutated zombies?
“Why are they so big?”
Several thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant.

The rocket launchers that landed on the temporary camp directly blew up the temporary camp, greatly reducing the durability of the buildings. In addition, a few unlucky players hit by the rocket launchers died immediately.
After firing more than ten rocket launchers, the two fusion Tyrant forms threw the rocket launchers to the side and rushed towards Federation’s temporary camp.
Liang Hucheng thought, “What kind of monster are they!
“Why can they run!”
He was really shocked. He felt cold sweat running down his face.
He had never seen such strange zombies before.
He shouted, “All of you! Gather in formation! Stop them!”
Federation players quickly organized a counterattack. They raised their weapons and started attacking the fusion Tyrant forms rushing towards them from afar.
The fusion Tyrant forms had their arms crossed in front of their chest. They were blocking the front of their eye located at their heart, rushing towards the camp in a frenzy.
The players tried their best to pull the trigger. However, they realized that they could not hurt the two monsters in front of them.
They could only watch as the Tyrant forms rushed towards them.
The non-vulnerable parts of the fusion Tyrant forms had an 85% damage reduction. Their powerful defense almost ignored the attacks of all light weapons.
Boom!
The fusion Tyrant form broke into the temporary camp in less than a minute. They raised their huge fists and smashed straight at the defensive fence outside the temporary camp.
Bang!

The temporary reinforced fence that the players had spent a lot of effort to build was shattered by the fist of the fusion Tyrant forms. Even the player hiding behind the fence was smashed with only a trace of blood left in his health bar. He was directly knocked into a near-death coma.
Liang Hucheng was bewildered.
He thought, “What’s going on? Ordinary light weapons are completely ineffective against them?”
They had taken advantage of Edge Creek Town’s weak defenses this time. They had expected that Edge Creek Town would not have any reinforcements, so they chose to launch such a surprise attack.
They had not been prepared to deal with a large creature. They had not prepared any heavy weapons beforehand.
They could only try some chemical weapons.
He shouted, “Howitzers! Howitzers! Get ready!
“Attack!”
Boom! Boom!
The howitzers accurately bombarded the body of the fusion Tyrant forms. The parts that were hit by the howitzers immediately evaporated into a white mist.
A foul stench spread out.
The fusion tyrant forms swayed back and froze for a few seconds.
Liang Hucheng thought, “Effective!
“Corrosive damage is effective on them!”
He was delighted.
However, they quickly recovered from the corrosive damage in less than a few seconds. The two fusion Tyrant forms continued to wave their huge fists to attack the temporary defense outside the camp.
Liang Hucheng’s eyes were filled with fear.
He realized that the camp’s defensive line was like a piece of paper in front of the two mutated zombies.
Liang Hucheng thought, ‘Where did these two monsters come from?”
A terrifying thought emerged in Liang Hucheng’s mind.
He thought, “Could it be Fang Heng?
“Obviously, they are here to support Scavenger Army in Edge Creek Town.
“Fang Heng can control the Tyrant form, and he is also the new commander of the Scavenger Army.
“Could it be that these two monsters are also under Fang Heng’s control?
“If that is the case...”
The deputy commander whispered from the side, “The howitzers have been used up.”
“Captain, what should we do? These two monsters are definitely at Tier 5. We can’t hold them off.”
Liang Hucheng said, “Well...”
He also came back to his senses. He felt indignant and turned to take one last look at Edge Creek Town.
He thought, “What a bummer!
“We are so close to conquering Edge Creek Town!
“D*mn it!”
He wished he could give himself a slap.
He thought, “Stop thinking about Edge Creek Town. The most important thing now is to leave here safely!
“Hope these two creatures both are stupid.
“I hope as many people as possible can escape.”
Liang Hucheng immediately gave the order. “Retreat! Immediately split up and retreat!”
Inside Edge Creek Town, Scavenger Army was already on the verge of being unable to hold on.
A large number of Federation players had already broken through the defenses outside and entered the inner part of Edge Creek town.
Roche was ready to accept his fate of death.
But he suddenly discovered that the enemy’s offensive had suddenly weakened.
And they even began to retreat orderly.
Roche thought, “What’s going on?”
He took a closer look, then he was delighted.
Outside of Edge Creek Town, the temporary camp built by the group of survivors seemed to have been attacked and fell into chaos.
Roche thought, “Could it be that the support team had come?”
He shouted, “Hahaha! Brave fighters! Follow me and rush forward together!”
He raised his head and drank the last bottle of divine potion, trying to reassemble the remaining members of the Scavenger Army and regain control of Edge Creek town.
Roche said, “Commander!”
More than ten minutes later, Roche returned to Edge Creek Town with the remaining members of Scavenger Army, only to see Fang Heng standing there alone.
He asked, “Commander, why are you here?”
Roche didn’t expect to see Fang Heng here. He looked behind Fang Heng.
Behind him was Federation’s temporary camp, which had been reduced to ruins.
He asked, “Just you alone?”
Fang Heng said, “Yes.”
Fang Heng was distracted by controlling the fusion Tyrant forms to chase after Federation, so he answered casually.
This was the first time Fang Heng had tried to control the Tyrant forms to chase after the enemy after they could run.
Unfortunately, when Federation retreated, they split into teams and ran in different directions, and they even left a few teams to block the pursuit of the fusion Tyrant forms.
Looking at Fang Heng, Roche could not help but feel a little shocked.
The group of elites following him also felt that it was inconceivable.
They thought, “What was going on? Only Commander Fang Heng alone?
“That group of enemies was all defeated by him alone?”
Fang Heng asked, “How’s the situation in Edge Creek Town now?”
He withdrew his gaze from afar and ordered the fusion Tyrant forms to return.
After wiping out four small teams of Federation, the Tyrant forms had completely lost track of the enemy.
Roche said, “Edge Creek Town has suffered serious damage. Fortunately, your support was timely, and at least it wasn’t taken away.”
He wiped off the blood at the corner of his mouth as he spoke. And he instinctively reached out for the warlord potion on his waist, only to find that it had run out.
He said, “Commander, we came back in a hurry. The strategic reserve materials are insufficient.”
Fang Heng said, “Okay, thank you for your hard work. I’ll get Osborne to send over a batch of materials as soon as possible.”
He made a rough estimate in his heart.
These two fusion Tyrant forms were Tier 5 mutated zombies.
Just as he had expected, the strength of the fusion Tyrant forms had reached the standard strength of Tier 5 mutated zombies in a field raid combat.
Just by relying on the Tyrant form’s passive effect of more than 100 attack attribute and the 85% damage reduction on non-vital parts, they could successfully persuade Federation players to quit.
The test data was still not enough. Fang Heng had not tried out the actual combat effectiveness of the mutant parasite skill.
He was still excited.
Even though it was already very late, he still decided to wait until the test was over before going offline.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - Mutant Worm Parasite
paragraphs: Fang Heng turned his head and glanced in the direction where Liang Hucheng and the others had retreated.
He asked, “Roche, are you familiar with the group that attacked Edge Creek Town? Do you know where their stronghold is?”
Roche said, “I know! That group is in the area next door, about six kilometers away from here. They’ve come to harass us more than once in the past.”
He clenched his teeth when he mentioned Liang Hucheng and his men.
He said, “We let them escape the last few times. I didn’t expect that they would take advantage of our lack of guards to launch a sneak attack...”
Fang Heng hummed in agreement.
He said, “Okay, take me there.”
A light flashed across Roche’s eyes.
He thought, “Commander was going to help us get back at them!”
Suddenly, Roche and the remaining Scavengers Army members felt a burning desire to fight.
They said in unison, “Yes! Commander!”
Liang Hucheng returned to the shelter with a group of defeated soldiers.
It was a nightmare.
He felt like he had just experienced a nightmare and risked his life to survive on the battlefield.
He was drenched in sweat.
He was sure that the unknown zombies he had encountered before were definitely Tier 5 mutated zombies.
He changed into a clean set of clothes and immediately returned to the shelter’s command post to make arrangements.
He asked, “Have you informed the superiors about the previous battle?”

A Federation soldier said, “Yes, sir. The relevant situation has been reported to our superiors as soon as possible. We are currently gathering a portion of the battlefield footage. Once we are done, we will immediately...
“Report! Anomaly detected outside the shelter!”
Liang Hucheng asked, “What?”
The Federation soldier said, “Anomaly detected! It might be a high-tier zombie.”
Then he switched the large screen image to the one captured by the surveillance camera outside the shelter.
He said, “The anomaly location has been placed on the surveillance screen.”
On the screen, the camera zoomed out.
Liang Hucheng’s eyelids twitched.
He thought, “This...”
He saw the two tall figures once again.
He shouted wordlessly, “That’s right! It’s them!
“The two Tier 5 mutated zombies I had encountered before!
“They had actually chased us to the shelter!
“I can meet them everywhere!”
Liang Hucheng’s expression changed slightly. He was still worried about what just happened, but now he became even more nervous.
He shouted, “Quick! Confirm the zombies’ identity!”

The research personnel of the shelter immediately made a comparison, saying, “Confirm they are high-level mutated zombies. There’s no match in the database. Their size is similar to an increased version of the Tyrant form zombies.
“They seem to stop there and do not attack.
“Sir, the 2 Tier 5 mutated zombies are still outside the effective range of our shelter. Maybe only a long-range sniper rifle and some heavy weapons can hurt them. Should we attack?”
Liang Hucheng thought, “Attack?
“Of course not!”
He immediately rejected this stupid idea.
He had seen the defensive capabilities of Tier 5 mutated zombies.
Even if the two Tier 5 mutated zombies stood still, they would not be severely damaged at such a distance.
He did not know why the two Tier 5 mutated zombies did not attack.
But it would be even more troublesome if they took the initiative to attack and attract them.
So Liang Hucheng said, “No need. Do not attack for now. Everyone enters an advanced state. Send a distress signal to the nearby shelter and continue to observe!”
Others shouted, “Understand!”
A deputy commander felt uneasy and asked, “Do we need to send a team over to take a look?”
Liang Hucheng said, “No need.”
Fang Heng was currently by a road approximately less than a kilometer from the shelter.
He jumped off Tyrant’s shoulder and observed the shelter that belonged to Federation from afar.
From afar, this was a medium-sized shelter.
In theory, a similar shelter would not be equipped with beam weapons.
Roche also jumped off a fusion Tyrant form’s shoulder and followed Fang Heng.
Along the way, Roche was greatly shocked.
This was the first time he discovered that a giant-sized zombie corpse could be used as a driving tool.
After landing, Roche carefully observed the two giant-sized zombie corpses.
He thought, “Are they the ones who wiped out an entire survivor corps?
He unconsciously shifted his gaze to the eyeball on the Tyrant form’s chest.
He felt a strong sense of unease and discomfort from the bottom of his heart, so he hurriedly shifted his gaze away from the eyeball.
They waited on the spot for nearly three minutes, but Fang Heng did not move or speak.
Roche could not help but ask, “Commander, are we still waiting for reinforcements?”
Fang Heng remained silent as usual.
Roche frowned. He realized that Fang Heng seemed to be focusing on controlling something and didn’t have the time to answer his question.
Suddenly, Roche heard several extremely weak sounds.
They were faint rustling sounds.
Looking in the direction where the sounds came from, Roche couldn’t help but swallow.
He thought, “What are those things!”
He squinted at them carefully. Countless dark purple worm bodies about the size of fingernails crawled out from the cracked skin of the two giant-sized zombie corpses.
The purple worm bodies climbed along the zombie corpses’ feet to the ground and quickly spread forward.
Roche was suddenly shocked.
He looked in the direction where the worm bodies were spreading. Then he raised his head to look at the shelter ahead.
“Skill: Mutant worm parasite.”
Fang Heng was highly concentrated.
Controlling the purple worm bodies that crawled out from the fusion Tyrant forms was very difficult, and it required a lot of energy.
He had to give it his all.
Players were still in Federation’s medium-sized shelter.
On top of the towering sentry tower, Federation’s elite players were fully focused, staring at the two black shadows in the distance.
Ten minutes had passed.
The two black shadows did not move at all.
No one realized that there were countless tiny purple worm bodies on the ground rapidly approaching the camp.
The first batch of worm bodies was climbing up the sentry towers of the defensive line outside the shelter.
Lin Yueping was an elite sniper of Federation, and he gained a powerful long-range shooting talent skill after entering the game.
He had been staring at the two Tier 5 mutated zombies for a long time.
He could not help but mutter to himself, “What exactly are the two monsters...”
Through the scope, he could see the eyeball at the heart of the monsters, and he was scared.
One companion said, “I heard they are Tier 5 mutated zombies. Be careful. They are not that easy to deal with.
Another companion said, “I heard that Scavenger Army created them.”
“I’m not sure. But our boss just met them, and he suffered a lot...”
On the sentry tower, Lin Yueping and the other two were staring at the giant-sized zombie corpses in the distance through their scope.
They didn’t notice that a purple worm body quickly climbed up the ladder to the sentry tower.
The worm body crawled along the floor to Lin Yueping’s feet, climbing up his shoes and crawling into his pants.
Suddenly, Lin Yueping shuddered and cried out in shock.
He shouted, “What’s it!”
A game hint quickly flashed across his eyes.
“Hint: You have been attacked by an unknown worm body, receiving two points of damage.”
“Hint: Your infection index has increased slightly.”
“Hint: You have been attacked by an unknown worm body.”
Lin Yueping felt something crawl into his pants. The red warning hint he saw confirmed that he was in trouble.
The other two companions on the sentry tower asked, “What’s Wrong?”
They were puzzled, putting down their sniper rifle and looking at Lin Yueping.
Lin Yueping said, “There’s something crawled up my leg...”

He did not know why the two Tier 5 mutated zombies did not attack.
But it would be even more troublesome if they took the initiative to attack and attract them.
So Liang Hucheng said, “No need.
Do not attack for now.
Everyone enters an advanced state.
Send a distress signal to the nearby shelter and continue to observe!”
Others shouted, “Understand!”
A deputy commander felt uneasy and asked, “Do we need to send a team over to take a look?”
Liang Hucheng said, “No need.”
Fang Heng was currently by a road approximately less than a kilometer from the shelter.
He jumped off Tyrant’s shoulder and observed the shelter that belonged to Federation from afar.
From afar, this was a medium-sized shelter.
In theory, a similar shelter would not be equipped with beam weapons.
Roche also jumped off a fusion Tyrant form’s shoulder and followed Fang Heng.
Along the way, Roche was greatly shocked.
This was the first time he discovered that a giant-sized zombie corpse could be used as a driving tool.
After landing, Roche carefully observed the two giant-sized zombie corpses.
He thought, “Are they the ones who wiped out an entire survivor corps?
He unconsciously shifted his gaze to the eyeball on the Tyrant form’s chest.
He felt a strong sense of unease and discomfort from the bottom of his heart, so he hurriedly shifted his gaze away from the eyeball.
They waited on the spot for nearly three minutes, but Fang Heng did not move or speak.
Roche could not help but ask, “Commander, are we still waiting for reinforcements?”
Fang Heng remained silent as usual.
Roche frowned.
He realized that Fang Heng seemed to be focusing on controlling something and didn’t have the time to answer his question.
Suddenly, Roche heard several extremely weak sounds.
They were faint rustling sounds.
Looking in the direction where the sounds came from, Roche couldn’t help but swallow.
He thought, “What are those things!”
He squinted at them carefully.
Countless dark purple worm bodies about the size of fingernails crawled out from the cracked skin of the two giant-sized zombie corpses.
The purple worm bodies climbed along the zombie corpses’ feet to the ground and quickly spread forward.
Roche was suddenly shocked.
He looked in the direction where the worm bodies were spreading.
Then he raised his head to look at the shelter ahead.
“Skill: Mutant worm parasite.”
Fang Heng was highly concentrated.
Controlling the purple worm bodies that crawled out from the fusion Tyrant forms was very difficult, and it required a lot of energy.
He had to give it his all.
Players were still in Federation’s medium-sized shelter.
On top of the towering sentry tower, Federation’s elite players were fully focused, staring at the two black shadows in the distance.
Ten minutes had passed.
The two black shadows did not move at all.
No one realized that there were countless tiny purple worm bodies on the ground rapidly approaching the camp.
The first batch of worm bodies was climbing up the sentry towers of the defensive line outside the shelter.
Lin Yueping was an elite sniper of Federation, and he gained a powerful long-range shooting talent skill after entering the game.
He had been staring at the two Tier 5 mutated zombies for a long time.
He could not help but mutter to himself, “What exactly are the two monsters...”
Through the scope, he could see the eyeball at the heart of the monsters, and he was scared.
One companion said, “I heard they are Tier 5 mutated zombies.
Be careful.
They are not that easy to deal with.
Another companion said, “I heard that Scavenger Army created them.”
“I’m not sure.
But our boss just met them, and he suffered a lot...”
On the sentry tower, Lin Yueping and the other two were staring at the giant-sized zombie corpses in the distance through their scope.
They didn’t notice that a purple worm body quickly climbed up the ladder to the sentry tower.
The worm body crawled along the floor to Lin Yueping’s feet, climbing up his shoes and crawling into his pants.
Suddenly, Lin Yueping shuddered and cried out in shock.
He shouted, “What’s it!”
A game hint quickly flashed across his eyes.
“Hint: You have been attacked by an unknown worm body, receiving two points of damage.”
“Hint: Your infection index has increased slightly.”
“Hint: You have been attacked by an unknown worm body.”
Lin Yueping felt something crawl into his pants.
The red warning hint he saw confirmed that he was in trouble.
The other two companions on the sentry tower asked, “What’s Wrong?”
They were puzzled, putting down their sniper rifle and looking at Lin Yueping.
Lin Yueping said, “There’s something crawled up my leg...”

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - Infection
paragraphs: Lin Yueping frowned. As he spoke, he immediately took out a combat knife from his backpack and cut open the hem of his pants.
“What’s that?”
After tearing open the leg of his pants, they saw a tiny purple bug on Lin Yueping’s shin!
The sharp mouthpart of the bug had produced a long and thin cut on the skin of Lin Yueping’s shin.
Dark red blood oozed out from the wound.
Lin Yueping felt a chill in his heart.
One of his companions saw this and immediately reached out to grab the insect and tried to pinch it to death.
However, in the next second, the insect seemed to have sensed the danger ahead of time and actually drilled into the wound.
In a flash, a small lump appeared on the skin of Lin Yueping’s shin.
“Hiss!”
The other two companions could not help but be startled when they saw this, and they gasped.
The lump was visibly moving along his chin at a fast speed, then it entered his abdomen, and disappeared.
Both of them looked at Lin Yueping at the same time, their faces filled with horror.
Lin Yueping’s face was even paler than before.
The game Hint kept flashing by.
“Hint: an unknown mutated insect is attempting to parasitize you”
“Hint: your infection has increased significantly... please be careful!”
“Hint: the unknown bug is attempting to control your central nervous system”

“Hint (obtained from low-level game difficulty) : Based on your various basic attribute, your central nervous system will be infected by the unknown bug within 28 seconds. You can choose to consume 1,500 survival points and gain an additional 180 seconds to protect your central nervous system from being infected.”
“Hint: you have consumed 1,500 survival points. Please find a way to remove the infected parasite from your body as soon as possible.”
In an instant, Lin Yueping’s face turned ghastly white.
The other two companions also looked at him in shock.
“What should we do?”
“What did the game Hint say?”
Lin Yueping opened his mouth and was about to say something when suddenly, his pupils dilated several times.
He saw something even more terrifying and raised his hand forward.
“Be careful!”
In the next second, they heard an extremely soft sound of friction.
It was like a squirming worm.
The two of them instinctively turned around and looked in the direction that Lin Yueping was pointing at.
More tiny purple worms climbed up the wall of the sentry tower and quickly gathered towards the three of them.
“What the hell? !”
“Stay back! Stay back!”
Bang! Bang!
In desperation, the two immediately fired, trying to kill the tiny purple worms.
In the command headquarters of the shelter, Liang Hucheng was still anxiously waiting for reinforcements.
A gunshot broke the silence of the night.
Liang Hucheng was shocked and immediately looked out of the window.
He noticed that something seemed to have happened at a sentry tower outside.
“What’s going on over there? Why are they shooting?”
“Trying to contact the communicator.”
As soon as he finished speaking, a series of loud cries for help came from the communicator.
“Bugs! Where did the bugs come from!”
“Infection! Kill them quickly! They will spread the zombie virus!”
Liang Hucheng suddenly had an extremely ominous feeling. He immediately pressed the communication button and shouted into the microphone,”What Bug? Be clear!”
“Purple Bug! Bug! He crawled into Hua Hongliang’s body!”
“Da*n it!”
“Bang, Bang, Bang...”
“Zombie transformation! He’s infected by the zombie virus...!”
The communication device was soon filled with screams and gunshots.
Liang Hucheng looked out of the window again.
In a few seconds, gunshots were heard from almost all the sentry tower.
The sentry tower inside the shelter was in chaos!
However, from the point of view of their command center, the Sentry Tower did not receive any attack from the outside!
Liang Hucheng felt a chill on his back.
He did not even know where the danger came from!
The enemy’s shadow was still far away and did not move. The defense of the Sentry Tower of the shelter had been declared to have fallen.
What should they do next?
Soon, after occupying the sentry tower, the purple worms climbed up the wall behind them.

Ordinary automatic cannons could not detect the tiny worms. They easily broke through the periphery of the defense line, climbed up the wall, and entered the bodies of Federation soldier on the wall..
In the blink of an eye, the shouts and gunshots spread to the defense line of the city wall.
The entire shelter fell into chaos in an instant.
“Can someone tell me what’s going on?”
In the command room, Federation soldiers looked at each other.
No one answered. They all saw the fear in their eyes.
In the silence, one of the soldiers suddenly changed his expression and said,”Sir, there’s something wrong with the Tier-5 zombie.”
Liang Hucheng’s eyes widened in shock, and he turned to look at the big screen.
The two black shadows in the distance began to move.
At this time, the entire shelter was in chaos. They had no time to deal with the two tyrant form!
“Hint: your mutant body has completed parasitizing and has taken control of the central nervous system.”
“Hint: you have gained control of the parasite... the host’s level has been determined — low-level life form, no skills, basic infection ability.”
“Hint: your mental strength has been used up, you can no longer control it.”
“Hint: forcefully using mental strength to control it will cause a backlash, please be careful.”
He felt dizzy.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and gulped down a bottle of coffee.
The good news was that both players and NPCs would become zombies after being infected by the mutated insects!
Although their attribute was no different from the low-level ordinary zombies outside, they came with an additional infection index to their attack.
The tricky part was that Fang Heng found it very difficult to control them.
Under normal circumstances, controlling the fusion of the tyrant form did not require much mental strength.

However, controlling the purple worm that crawled out of the fusion of the tyrant form required a lot of mental strength. As for controlling the zombie body that was controlled by the mutant worm, it required ten times more mental strength than controlling the mutant worm!
Fang Heng realized that his mental strength, which he had never used since entering the game, had been reduced to 0.
After several attempts, Fang Heng chose to temporarily give up.
“Never mind.”
He decided to take a step back so that he did not have to control the zombies that were infected by the mutant worm. Then he only needed to give them an attack order when he wanted.
The ability of mutant worm parasite had already exceeded Fang Heng’s expectations.
It was simply too good!
“Commander.”
Roche, who had watched the whole battle, twitched his lips.
For the first time, he felt fear from Fang Heng.
It was the person in front of him!
He had seen Fang Heng control two mutated zombies and easily turn the entire shelter into ruins.
Only a zombie team was left in the ruins..
Fang Heng slowly looked away.
“Roche, since you’re here, why don’t you clean up the place? You know this area well, right? Take me to the next shelter.”
“Yes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - New Developments
paragraphs: The next day, the sun was high in the sky.
Fang Heng lay on his bed and stretched his arms.
The strength of the fusion with the tyrant form was much better than he had expected!
Last night, he had spent the entire night in twelve small and medium-sized shelters. It was not until dawn that he finally stopped and went offline to rest.
Perhaps it was because controlling the mutant body consumed too much of his spirit, Fang Heng still felt his head swell after he woke up.
He sat on the bed with his legs tucked up under him and meditated for a moment. Then he felt the uncomfortable feeling gradually ebbing away.
After getting up and putting on his coat, Fang Heng was ready to go find something to eat.
Just as he left the room, Xiao Ruoruo and Mo Yunxiao walked over from the other end of the pathway.
“Brother Fang Heng.”
“Hi, how are you?”
Fang Heng saw the two of them and waved to greet them.”Are you going out?”

“Yes, I’m meeting a friend. I’ll bring Ruoruo over to visit her. It might be helpful for her recovery. “Mo Yunxiao nodded, then he continued, “It’s quite a commotion. It seems that you already have a plan, right?”
“Sorry? What?”
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment and did not understand.
“It’s okay. Just do what you think is right. If you need help, I’ll be there.”
Mo Yunxiao patted Fang Heng on the shoulder.
“Good luck. I know you will fight till the very end.”
“Good luck, brother Fang Heng.”
“What was going on? Was it a compliment?”Fang Heng thought.
Fang Heng was baffled. Before he could ask, a loud voice came from the end of the pathway.
“Genius, something big has just happened!”
From far away, Mo Jiawei shouted excitedly and ran from the other side of the pathway.
“Good news! There’s news on the first-generation meteorite research in District 8!”
He just taked about First-generation meteorite!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
Counting his fingers, it had been more than five days since he left.
“Alright, I’ll prepare the devices. Five minutes later, activate the space-time rift and take me back to District 8.”
“No problem!”
After returning to District 8, Fang Heng Handed Qiu Yaokang a stack of file information from his space-time jump backpack.
“What’s this?”

“The research report and preliminary experimental analysis report on the Hila tissue. Professor Ding Min is in charge of conducting the experiment.”Fang Heng Thought for a moment, he added,”Professor Ding Min is quit a peach. I think the two of you will get along well.”
“The research report on the Hila Organization...”
Qiu Yaokang muttered and immediately opened the file to flip through it. He immersed himself reading as if there was no one else around.
A row of game Hints flashed in front of Fang Heng.
“Hint: Your Shelter has obtained a report on Hila’s experiment. You have obtained 10,000 contribution points from District 8’s main task.”
“Hint: Your Shelter has opened a special research project-Hila’s experiment.”
“Hint: you need to obtain more information to unlock the world’s main storyline ending.”
“Fang Heng, take this.”
Beside him, Mo Jiawei threw a pack of facial masks that he had prepared earlier to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng raised his hand to take the mask.
“Item: Deep Blue Enigma-sample (female outfit)”

“Description: an epoch-making facial mask sample developed by the meteorite company. It is made from pure natural ingredients. It is made from the essence of deep-sea seaweed. Fusion with the latest negative ion pore repair technology, it can deeply repair the skin...”
“Effect: It gives a female a chance to increase her favorability rating. Can Restore 3 points of satiety when in a crisis.
“Thanks.”
The dark blue mystery mask could not be found in District 7, which had lost its doomsday decades ago. It could only be found in District 8, which had just entered the world of zombie apocalypse.
Fang Heng realized that S-rank characters always came with some quirks.
Qiu Yaokang was a decent character. He would be satisfied with a little experimental research.
However, Ding Min was a troublesome character.
As long as she stayed up all night, her loyalty would drop.
Right now, he still had to rely on her to nurture the unknown bug body solution. He hoped that the mask could more or less replenish her loyalty.
“Haha, genius, I didn’t expect that this thing would be so hard to find. I finally bought it from a player. Which Beautiful Lady are you going to give it to?”
Mo Jiawei came over with a smile and winked at Fang Heng.
“Let me guess, is it for Lucia?”
Fang Heng was stunned.
“Lucia also needs it? has she been staying up late recently?”
“Probably because she’s a little excited these two days.”
“Huh?”
“A few days ago, Lucia kept coming to look for you. She chased me and asked me if I had hidden you. Well how can I convince her?”
As he thought of the shiny knife in Lucia’s hand, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but shrink his neck.

“I was busy looking for a facial mask at that time, but I didn’t tell her. She probably heard that I was looking for a facial mask and thought that it was you who prepared a birthday present for her...”
Fang Heng looked at Mo Jiawei suspiciously.
“It didn’t make sense. Lucia has always been so careless, how would she come to such a conclusion?” Fang Heng thought.
“Could it be that Mo Jiawei was telling her things in order to ruin my name?”
“Er... genius, what’s this about? Why are you looking at me like that? Did I say something wrong? Are you giving this to another woman?”
“It’s nothing...”
Fang Heng quietly put away the mask.
When he went offline, he would ask the butler, Uncle Sun, to see if he could give Lucia something in the real world.
If it didn’t work, he could give her two fusion Tyrant form to make it up to her.
Qiu Yaokang put away the experiment report and asked,”Fang Heng, are all the experiment logs here?”
“Yes, that’s what we have now so far. How is it? Did you find anything?”
“I’d like to meet Dr. Ding Min.”Qiu Yaokang nodded.”Her experiment design is perfect.”
“Well...”
Fang Heng coughed lightly and asked, “I’m referring to the experiment of Hila’s organization.”
“There’s nothing. We can continue the research according to her experiment design process. Without the relevant sample, I can’t find any clues about Hila’s experiment.”
Victor had just completed the preliminary maintenance of the large-scale space tearing device when he heard the conversation between the three of them.
“Fang Heng, we’ve already tried to gather clues about Hila’s experiment the last time you asked us. We still haven’t found any information related to the fallout shelter of the meteorite company.”

“In addition, I’ve checked the blueprints you gave me in detail. The initial construction was completed last night, but in the actual use process, we didn’t find any signal that contained the metal box of Hila’s organization.”
Fang Heng was puzzled and asked,”You can’t find the signal of the magnetic field? is the search area not wide enough?”
“It’s not like that. I think there’s a problem with the frequency of the magnetic field. We can’t find the corresponding metal box.”
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
The metal box of the meteorite company in District 7 and District 8 was slightly different, so they couldn’t use this bug?
It prevented the first-generation meteorite from being destroyed in the research, so the mystery box was also hidden?
Fang Heng felt a little confused.

“I will continue to follow up on the Hila organization’s experiment. We will search for clues about the meteorite company’s fallout shelter. Currently, we lack Hila organization cells, so it will be difficult for us to make substantial progress in our research. It will only waste manpower and material resources.”
Qiu Yaokang said as he carefully collected the information about the Hila experiment.
“Now, we have more important things to do. There has been a breakthrough in the research of the first-generation meteorite. David is still waiting for us. Let’s go meet him.”
“The portal is ready.”

“Haha, genius, I didn’t expect that this thing would be so hard to find.
I finally bought it from a player.
Which Beautiful Lady are you going to give it to?”
Mo Jiawei came over with a smile and winked at Fang Heng.
“Let me guess, is it for Lucia?”
Fang Heng was stunned.
“Lucia also needs it? has she been staying up late recently?”
“Probably because she’s a little excited these two days.”
“Huh?”
“A few days ago, Lucia kept coming to look for you.
She chased me and asked me if I had hidden you.
Well how can I convince her?”
As he thought of the shiny knife in Lucia’s hand, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but shrink his neck.
“I was busy looking for a facial mask at that time, but I didn’t tell her.
She probably heard that I was looking for a facial mask and thought that it was you who prepared a birthday present for her...”
Fang Heng looked at Mo Jiawei suspiciously.
“It didn’t make sense.
Lucia has always been so careless, how would she come to such a conclusion?” Fang Heng thought.
“Could it be that Mo Jiawei was telling her things in order to ruin my name?”
“Er... genius, what’s this about?
Why are you looking at me like that?
Did I say something wrong?
Are you giving this to another woman?”
“It’s nothing...”
Fang Heng quietly put away the mask.
When he went offline, he would ask the butler, Uncle Sun, to see if he could give Lucia something in the real world.
If it didn’t work, he could give her two fusion Tyrant form to make it up to her.
Qiu Yaokang put away the experiment report and asked,”Fang Heng, are all the experiment logs here?”
“Yes, that’s what we have now so far.
How is it?
Did you find anything?”
“I’d like to meet Dr.
Ding Min.”Qiu Yaokang nodded.”Her experiment design is perfect.”
“Well...”
Fang Heng coughed lightly and asked, “I’m referring to the experiment of Hila’s organization.”
“There’s nothing.
We can continue the research according to her experiment design process.
Without the relevant sample, I can’t find any clues about Hila’s experiment.”
Victor had just completed the preliminary maintenance of the large-scale space tearing device when he heard the conversation between the three of them.
“Fang Heng, we’ve already tried to gather clues about Hila’s experiment the last time you asked us.
We still haven’t found any information related to the fallout shelter of the meteorite company.”
“In addition, I’ve checked the blueprints you gave me in detail.
The initial construction was completed last night, but in the actual use process, we didn’t find any signal that contained the metal box of Hila’s organization.”
Fang Heng was puzzled and asked,”You can’t find the signal of the magnetic field? is the search area not wide enough?”
“It’s not like that.
I think there’s a problem with the frequency of the magnetic field.
We can’t find the corresponding metal box.”
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
The metal box of the meteorite company in District 7 and District 8 was slightly different, so they couldn’t use this bug?
It prevented the first-generation meteorite from being destroyed in the research, so the mystery box was also hidden?
Fang Heng felt a little confused.
“I will continue to follow up on the Hila organization’s experiment.
We will search for clues about the meteorite company’s fallout shelter.
Currently, we lack Hila organization cells, so it will be difficult for us to make substantial progress in our research.
It will only waste manpower and material resources.”
Qiu Yaokang said as he carefully collected the information about the Hila experiment.
“Now, we have more important things to do.
There has been a breakthrough in the research of the first-generation meteorite.
David is still waiting for us.
Let’s go meet him.”
“The portal is ready.”

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - Vaccines
paragraphs: Fang Heng and the other two arrived at the headquarters of the Dark Knights through the portal.
David and a group of elite dark knights were waiting for Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng.”
David went forward and gave Fang Heng a warm hug. His eyes were shining with irresistible excitement.
“Finally you’re here. I guarantee that our research findings will definitely surprise you!”
“I’m looking forward to it!”
“Come on, follow me.”
David led Qiu Yaokang and the other two to put on thick protective isolation suits. After sterilizing them, they arrived at the underground secret research room located in the headquarters.
The first generation meteorites were placed behind the tempered glass.

“With the help of Mr. Qiu Yaokang, we have been researching and developing the first generation meteorites. Overall, the current progress is gratifying. Through the analysis of the sample of the first generation meteorites, we have successfully developed a vaccine for the primogenitor virus.”
Fang Heng’s eyes widened, then he turned to look at Qiu Yaokang.
“Vaccine?” he thought.
“It developed so fast!?”
Mo Jiawei also looked at Qiu Yaokang in surprise.
“Develop a vaccine? Did it mean that they could successfully complete the main task of District 8?”
Qiu Yaokang looked indifferent.
Developing a vaccine was quite an ordinary thing to him.
“Thank you very much for your help, Mr. Qiu Yaokang. Let me introduce the situation of the vaccine.”

David suppressed the excitement in his heart, he continued to explain,”The vaccine can work against the primogenitor virus. Theoretically, all the zombie virus that we know of are mutated from the primogenitor virus. The vaccine that we developed can have a positive effect on the virus.”
“We have carried out clinical trials. The effect is significant. After the vaccine is injected, the human body can be completely immune to the infection of the zombie virus for a period of time.”
Qiu yaokang continued,”But now is not the time to celebrate. This is only theoretically possible. There are still great risks in the actual process.”
“Risks?”
“Yes.” David turned to look at Fang Heng.”Since the outbreak of the zombie crisis, there has been a problem that has been troubling all the research personel in the world.”
“I don’t know if you have realized it, but the number of zombies in the zombie team is still increasing.”

“Every day, countless corpses that have been dead for many years are resurrected from the ground. The resurrected zombies are indeed infected with the zombie virus, but their zombie transformation process is hard to explain with the zombie virus theory. After all, they have never been exposed to the zombie virus.”
Fang Heng glanced at Mo Jiawei, who also looked back at Fang Heng.
The players had discovered this bizarre situation a long time ago.

If not for the fact that a large number of zombies were resurrected from the ground every day, it would have been possible to kill all the zombies wandering around the world with the player’s strength.
However, the player would not think too much about such a situation.
They simply attributed this to a simple rule.
It was the game settings.
It was just like the Blood Moon.
For a long time, the game system would give a Hint of the Blood Moon’s arrival in advance.
Almost no player would think about how the Blood Moon came into being.
When it came to the NPCs, they felt that the Blood Moon and the zombie team were very strange.
Fang Heng was thinking about how to explain the problem to them when Qiu Yaokang said, “Some time ago, I conducted a new test and research on the zombie team that resurrected from the underground.”
“I found traces of the primogenitor virus in their bodies.”
Fang Heng stopped talking and asked in surprise,”Are you saying that the zombies that crawled out of the underground were infected with the primogenitor virus?”
“Yes, it’s very strange. How did the primogenitor virus infect the corpse buried deep underground?”
Qiu Yaokang said in a deep voice, “After several tests, I came to a conclusion that the ground under our feet was contaminated.”
Fang Heng frowned.
He felt that something was wrong.

After listening for a long time, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but say, “But, Qiu, I still don’t understand. What does this have to do with us?” “Haven’t we already developed a vaccine?” “Since the vaccine is effective against the primogenitor virus, what risks are there?” “Why don’t we just inject the vaccine together?”
“That’s what I’m going to explain next.”

“Injecting the vaccine into the human body is only a cure for the symptoms, not the root cause. Only by finding a way to stop the zombies that emerged from the underground can we completely solve the crisis of the human race.”
“According to what I said before, the polluted land is the source of the rising of the dead that are buried deep underground.”
“We have to find a way to solve the root cause.”

“Ideally, the vaccine we have developed can directly destroy the virus. With sufficient doses of the vaccine, we can purify the polluted land, stop the zombie transformation of the dead, and restore peace to the world.”
Mo Jiawei clapped his hands, “Then what are we waiting for? Mass production! What materials do we need? We’ll go and help collect them now.”
“It’s not that simple. The primogenitor virus is very unstable, which is why it split into T virus, G virus, and other virus bodies. The vaccine we developed is still very unstable.”

“To be precise, the vaccine still has a huge safety risk. A large-scale spread of the vaccine may lead to further evolution of the virus body. In extreme cases, a large number of evolved mutated zombie will be resurrected from the contaminated land every day.”
Fang Heng finally understood.
After a long time, this vaccine was still a half-finished product with risks.
One after another, game Hints flashed past Fang Heng’s retina.
“Hint: player has completed the current phase of the mission with the Dark Knights — first-generation meteorite research”
“Hint: player’s behavior has changed the game process, and is in the process of correction...”
“Hint: correction completed. Player has received 20,000 District 8 main storyline contribution points.”
“Hint: player has received 12,000 Dark Knights contribution points. Player’s Dark Knights’honor level has been raised to LV: 23. Vice-commander.”

“Fang Heng, no matter what, we were able to develop the vaccine body largely because of your help all this time. On behalf of the Dark Knights, we thank you for your contribution to saving the world. The commander has personally appointed you as the vice-commander of the Dark Knights.”
As he spoke, David’s expression turned solemn. He saluted Fang Heng and said,”Commander Fang Heng!”
“Uh... well, thank you...”
Fang Heng’s expression was a little awkward.
He thought about how he had just destroyed the branch of the Dark Knights in District 7, and then became the vice-commander of the Dark Knights in District 8.
He was really confused.
“The Night Owl organization would not be so stupid as to kill the commander of the Dark Knights, right?” he thought.

“Fang Heng, we are now divided on what we should do next. Should we use the unstable vaccine immediately or wait a little longer? We should develop and observe it for a while more and analyze it for a while more to ensure the safety of the vaccine.”
